31360.s: The bill amends the Wet financiering decentrale overheden to improve how decentralised governments manage their financing: it removes the fixed-debt concept in favour of total budget expenditure, moves oversight of the cash-credit limit into regular budget supervision, and lets the supervisor set alternative limits for joint arrangements. It also bans municipal contracts providing mortgage loans to own staff and politicians (with a transitional exemption), allows the Minister of Finance to pass on part of an EMU-norm fine to decentralised governments, and removes administrative organisation of the financing function from the statutory municipal, provincial and water board ordinance requirements.
31360.j: The memorandum justifies the new fine-passing power as a last resort (ultimum remedium) and argues that the cash-credit limit oversight was too heavy an instrument, shifting it into regular budget supervision.
q: As already noted in section 2.1 of this explanatory memorandum, the new power must be seen as an ultimum remedium, a last resort instrument.
Zoals al is opgemerkt in paragraaf 2.1 van deze memorie van toelichting, moet de nieuwe bevoegdheid worden gezien als een ultimum remedium, een laatste aangrijpingsmiddel.
d: alternative cash-credit limit percentage for joint arrangements
share of EMU-norm fine borne by decentralised governments
supervisor may require revised plan and set short-term borrowing approval and debt maximum
p: The Minister of Finance may decide the share of an EU fine that decentralised governments must pay, after regular administrative consultation rather than parliamentary approval.
The supervisor gains broader intervention powers over municipalities and provinces exceeding the cash-credit limit, including directives and borrowing approval requirements.
The supervisor may set a deviating cash-credit percentage for joint arrangements after consulting their board.

parties: Asks whether abolishing article 212 Gemeentewet and article 216 Provinciewet leaves municipal councils and provincial states without power to set frameworks and call executives to account over financial management.
If so, can the municipal council or provincial states still hold the college of mayor and aldermen or the provincial executive accountable for that management?
Zo ja, kunnen de gemeenteraad resp. Provinciale Staten over dat beheer dan nog het college van B&W resp. het college van GS ter verantwoording roepen?
Asks whether differences between budgeting on a cash basis and EMU registration affect how EMU penalties are passed on to subnational governments.
Can a deviation between the EMU balance and the budget balance affect how a possible fine for exceeding the EMU norm is passed on to subnational governments?

Kan een afwijking tussen de begrippen EMU-saldo en begrotingsaldo gevolgen hebben voor de wijze waarop een eventuele boete wegens overschrijding van de EMU-norm wordt doorberekend aan de decentrale overheden?
Says some passages of the explanatory memorandum are incomprehensible, impeding its members' oversight task, and questions the minister's power to set subnational shares of EMU fines.
These members would like texts to be provided in such a way that they can carry out their scrutiny task.
Deze leden zien graag dat teksten op een zodanig manier worden aangeleverd dat zij hun controleren-de taak kunnen uitvoeren.

31423.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the Stabilisation and Association Agreement between the European Communities and their member states and the Republic of Montenegro, signed in Luxembourg on 15 October 2007. It enters into force the day after its publication in the Staatsblad.
31423.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rule-making on social security export as a counterpart to EU coordination rules for migrating Community nationals, and notes that bilateral arrangements can still apply.
q: It is prescribed that the Stabilisation and Association Council sets rules on the export of social insurance benefits.
Voorgeschreven wordt dat de Stabilisatie- en associatieraad regels stelt met betrekking tot de export van sociale verzekeringsuitkeringen.
d: export of social security benefits rules set by Stabilisation and Association Council

parties: Asks whether the agreement's timelines imply a predetermined path to EU membership despite unresolved state-building, judicial and corruption problems, and questions the absence of sanction mechanisms.

These members ask whether the government shares this view and why various places in the SAO, such as article 72, contain time references that give the impression that a timetable leads toward Montenegro's EU membership.</br>

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering deze visie deelt en of de regering kan aangeven waarom op diverse plaatsen in het SAO, zoals bijvoorbeeld in artikel 72, tijdsaanduidingen zijn opgenomen die de indruk wekken dat volgens een tijdpad wordt toegewerkt naar een lidmaatschap van de republiek Montenegro van de Europese Unie.
Asks how the agreement handles disputes with neighbouring states and how the Stabilisation and Association Council settles disagreements, and whether the transition period could be extended.
Finally, the members of the SP faction ask what role the Stabilisation and Association Council has in settling disputes with neighbouring countries.</br>
Tenslotte vragen de leden van de SP-fractie welke rol de Stabilisatie- en associatieraad heeft in het beslechten van meningsverschillen met buurlanden.
Presses on judicial dependence on political authorities, police impunity, corruption, and press freedom, asking what objectively measurable reforms justify signing.
The VVD members ask whether Montenegro may have a considerable degree of dependence of the judiciary on the political authorities.</br>
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of in Montenegro wellicht sprake is van een aanzienlijke mate van afhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht ten opzichte van de politieke autoriteiten.
Calls for balanced cooperation including justice, state-building and anti-corruption, and asks about press freedom, religious freedom and the position of refugees and displaced persons.

However, these members believe that cooperation in the areas of justice and social affairs and support for state formation and anti-corruption should have equally high priority, especially given the concerns formulated by the Commission.</br>

Deze leden menen echter dat samenwerking op justitieel en sociaal gebied en ondersteuning bij staatsvorming en corruptiebestrijding even hoge prioriteit dient te hebben, zeker gezien de zorgpunten zoals geformuleerd door de Commissie.

31441.s: The bill amends the Wet werk en bijstand to decentralise the long-term income supplement (langdurigheidstoeslag) to municipalities, letting them set its eligibility and amount through their own rules. It also allows municipalities to grant categorical special assistance in kind for chronically ill, disabled, and school-attending children's participation costs without verifying actual costs.
31441.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by the goal of promoting social participation and giving municipalities room for tailored policy, within a budget-based financing framework.
q: Municipalities can themselves determine what they understand by the term 'long-term'.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf bepalen wat zij onder de term «langdurig» verstaan.
d: I.B (artikel 8, eerste lid, onderdeel d en tweede lid)
municipal rules on the long-term income supplement, its amount and definitions of long-term, low income and lack of labour market prospects
categorical special assistance without cost verification for chronically ill, disabled and school-attending children
municipal discretion to depart from assistance in kind where it is inefficient
p: Allows categorical special assistance without checking whether costs were actually incurred or necessary, reducing individual legal protection and verification by the state's administrative bodies.
Shifts setting of the supplement's scope and amount to municipalities, leaving eligibility details to local rules with limited national standard-setting.

parties: Asks how the government will prevent municipalities from running other forms of categorical policy and what sanctions apply, and asks about objections against decisions and the preparation of municipal ordinances.
However, these members ask how the government ensures that municipalities in practice do not carry out any other form of categorical policy.
Wel vragen deze leden hoe de regering erop toeziet dat er ook feitelijk geen andere vorm van categoriaal beleid door gemeenten wordt uitgevoerd.
Asks why minimum and maximum norms and mandatory ordinances were not included, and questions the consequences of municipal discretion for equal treatment and for the national income policy.
Can the government explain why it has not included minimum and maximum norms for the long-duration allowance in the bill?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij geen minimum- en maximumnormen voor de langdurigheidstoeslag heeft opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel?

Worries that municipal discretion leads to unequal support for similar cases across municipalities, opposes the requirement of in-kind provision and individual application, and asks for evaluation and national frameworks.
Does the government agree with the SP members that this creates the chance that people in equal cases will receive different support in different municipalities?
Is de regering het met de leden van de SP-fractie eens dat hierdoor de kans bestaat dat mensen in gelijke gevallen in verschillende gemeenten andere ondersteuning zullen ontvangen?
Asks how the bill will avoid weakening work incentives and how it reconciles long-term allowances without a general job-seeking obligation.
By making part of the long-duration allowance categorical for people seeking work, the incentive to enter the labour market will also be reduced in the long term.
Door het categoraal maken van een deel van de langdurigheidstoeslag voor mensen die op zoek zijn naar werk zal de prikkel om de arbeidsmarkt op gaan ook «langdurig» verminderen.
Opposes extra financial support for long-term benefit recipients as demotivating and raises the risk of misuse of in-kind goods such as computers.
The PVV members are against providing extra financial support to persons who have been in a benefit situation for a longer period.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zijn tegen het verlenen van extra financiële ondersteuning aan personen die reeds langere tijd in een uitkeringssituatie verkeren.

Asks whether the government will investigate how municipalities implement ordinances, whether lower bounds will be set, whether local client councils are involved, and how appeals against individualised decisions work.
The ChristenUnie members ask whether the government will investigate whether and how municipalities have given content to the ordinance underlying the long-duration allowance.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen of de regering gaat onderzoeken of en zo ja hoe gemeenten invulling hebben gegeven aan de verordening die ten grondslag ligt aan de langdurigheidstoeslag.
Has no further questions at this stage.
At this moment these members have no further questions.
Op dit moment hebben deze leden geen nadere vragen.

31450.s: The bill amends the Nuclear Energy Act, the Extradition Act and the Code of Criminal Procedure to implement the 2005 Vienna amendment to the Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material. It extends security rule-making to installations and certain radioactive substances, adds environmental damage to offences, and makes the new offences extraditable.
31450.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary to meet treaty obligations, with the detailed security rules placed in a ministerial regulation replacing permit-based requirements.
q: To comply with the obligations under the amended convention, the principles from the recommendations will be included in a ministerial regulation.
Ten einde te voldoen aan de verplichtingen uit het gewijzigde verdrag, zullen de uitgangspunten uit de aanbevelingen worden opgenomen in een ministeriële regeling.
d: security rules for designated categories of radioactive substances
storage and security of fissile materials, ores and installations
designation of categories of confidential security information

parties: Welcomes the amendment and asks whether other treaty parties are adapting their national laws.
They can agree to the bill.
Zij kunnen instemmen met het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the new obligations on protection of nuclear material and installations will be put into practice and what happens if a party cannot meet IAEA obligations.
What happens if a treaty party cannot meet the obligations and recommendations of the IAEA?
Wat gebeurt er als een verdragspartij niet kan voldoen aan de verplichtingen en aanbevelingen van de IAEA?
Supports tighter protection but asks how information sharing will be protected against misuse and who coordinates it, including for military material.
How is that information protected against misuse by both terrorists and competitors?
Hoe wordt die informatie daarin beschermd tegen misbruik door zowel terroristen als door concurrentie?
Asks whether lower-level regulations implementing the amendment will be submitted to parliament and why parliament would not be involved in significant changes.
They would like to know whether the various changes in lower legislation will be submitted to parliament in advance.
Zij willen graag weten of de verschillende wijzigingen in lagere wetgeving worden voorgehangen.

31513.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 1896/2006 establishing a European order for payment procedure in the Netherlands, designating the competent courts (rechtbank or kantonrechter), procedures for objection, appeal and enforcement, and fees. It also obliges the Minister of Justice to report to the States General on effectiveness within five years.
31513.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural rules as implementing the EU regulation and as preserving the debtor's procedural guarantees, with no new executive delegation of power.
q: Within 5 years after this act enters into force, the Minister of Justice will send the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice.
Onze Minister van Justitie zendt binnen 5 jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.

parties: Asks whether the electronic filing option should be mandatory for all courts and questions how effective the order is if a defendant can easily object.
However, is this possibility dependent on whether the competent court has included this possibility of electronic filing in its procedural rules?
Echter, is deze mogelijkheid afhankelijk van de vraag of het bevoegde gerecht deze mogelijkheid van elektronische indiening in zijn procesreglement heeft opgenomen?
Worries about misuse by malicious debt collectors and asks that debtors' interests, especially vulnerable debtors who do not open post, are adequately protected.
They ask the government whether it has considered that the scheme could lead to abuse, for example when the European order for payment is issued on a large scale by a malicious debt collector.

Zij vragen de regering of er over is nagedacht dat de regeling mogelijk tot misbruik zou kunnen leiden, bijvoorbeeld wanneer het Europese betalingsbevel (hierna: EBB) op grootschalige wijze zou worden uitgevaardigd door een malafide incasseerder.
Asks what information must be given to the defendant, whether a second language should be designated, and what exceptional circumstances justify review, to protect the defendant.
To what extent does the choice not to admit any language other than Dutch really provide protection for the defendant?
In hoeverre levert de keuze om naast de Nederlandse taal geen andere taal toe te laten echt bescherming op voor de verweerder?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill implementing the EU European payment order regulation but objects to the four-week deadline for requesting review under article 9(2)(c), which deviates from the regulation's 'onverwijld' wording, and recommends aligning it. The minister's reply adds justification to the memorie van toelichting, keeps the four-week term for consistency with the Uitvoeringswet EET, and makes some technical and editorial changes.
concerns: The Raad advised aligning the deadline wording in article 9(2) with the regulation's 'onverwijld' terminology, which the government did not adopt, retaining the four-week term while adding justification.
The Raad questioned the unexplained choice of a fixed four-week deadline for review on the ground of a wrongly granted order, and the government added reasoning to the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad made several editorial comments on articles 5, 6 and 7-8, which the government took into account.

31522.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for EU Regulation 1393/2007 on cross-border service of judicial documents and the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure accordingly, adjusting bailiff roles, languages, a fixed fee of EUR 65 and certificate terminology. It also lets the Minister of Justice change the fee by ministerial regulation no more than once every five years and allows direct service by bailiffs and courts abroad.
31522.j: The memorandum explains the EUR 65 fee is derived from an existing ministerial tariff and that a ministerial regulation allows adjustment, with a five-year limit to give foreign authorities certainty.
q: The bill provides that the amount of the fixed fee can be adjusted by ministerial regulation.
In het wetsvoorstel is voorzien dat de hoogte van de vaste vergoeding bij ministeriële regeling kan worden aangepast.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 6 lid 2 Uitvoeringswet EG-betekeningsverordening)
changing the fixed fee for assistance by bailiffs

parties: Asks why the regulation's scope excludes fiscal, customs and administrative matters and what the differences from the earlier regulation are.
These members ask why the scope has been kept so narrow.
Deze leden vragen waarom het toepassingsbereik zo krap is gehouden.
Asks how a sender can prove the addressee understands a language other than their own and whether the addressee can still object to a document in a foreign language.
The burden of proof that the addressee understands a language other than their own rests on the party requesting service.
De bewijslast dat de geadresseerde een taal begrijpt, die niet zijn eigen taal is, rust op degene die om betekening of kennisgeving heeft verzocht.

Supports the bill but asks how the deadline option on the request form relates to agreed numbers of service attempts and what a reasonable deadline is; welcomes the possibility of curing defective service in the correct language.
The VVD members welcome the possibility to remedy defective service or notification of the document in the correct language, in line with the ruling of the European Court of Justice.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn verheugd met de mogelijkheid van herstel van verzuim ten aanzien van betekening of kennisgeving van het stuk in de juiste taal in lijn met de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie.

31540.s: The bill narrows the scope of the Wet informatie-uitwisseling ondergrondse netten (WION) by excluding house connections (huisaansluitingen) from the definition of underground networks, and removes the transitional provision that postponed application to house connections. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
31540.j: The memorandum justifies the exclusion of house connections by noting that the WION evaluation after five years can consider whether to bring them back within scope; it does not justify any delegation of power.
q: Within the evaluation of the WION after five years, it can then be considered whether it is desirable to bring house connections back within the scope of the WION.
In het kader van de evaluatie van de WION over vijf jaar zal dan kunnen worden bezien of het wenselijk is huisaansluitingen alsnog onder het bereik van de WION te brengen.

parties: Asks whether the minister's answers to earlier questions about a thesis on errors in the excavation law affected the bill, and why the registration duty for cable household connections is not removed.
What reasoning underlies the decision in the bill not to remove the registration obligation for a cable household connection?
Welke redenering ligt eraan ten grondslag dat in het wetsvoorstel de registratieverplichting van een huisaansluiting voor de kabel niet wordt geschrapt?
Welcomes the bill and asks about the differences between it and the Aptroot amendment that would have removed registration of all household connections.

These members ask about the differences between the present bill and the amendment by member Aptroot, which the government advised against, that would remove the registration of all household connections.
Deze leden vragen naar de verschillen tussen het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en het door de regering ontraden amendement van het lid Aptroot

31810.s: The bill implements the Lanzarote Convention on protecting children against sexual exploitation by amending the Criminal Code to add offences for witnessing sexual acts with minors and for grooming, and widens the child pornography offence. It also amends the Code of Criminal Procedure to give investigators extra powers for these offences and extends the Extradition Act and Criminal Code jurisdiction rules.
31810.j: The memorandum justifies the extra investigative powers as necessary to facilitate clarifying suspicions of these offences, and rejects a limitative list of powers as undesirable.
q: As a result, extra investigative powers become available upon suspicion of these offences, which are necessary to facilitate clarifying the suspicion of these offences.
Daardoor komen bij verdenking van deze misdrijven extra opsporingsbevoegdheden beschikbaar die nodig zijn om de opheldering van de verdenking van deze misdrijven te kunnen vergemakkelijken.
p: Adds the new offences in articles 248d and 248e to article 67 Sv, making extra investigative powers available for their investigation without a limitative list of powers.

parties: Broadly supports the bill but asks whether the intent requirement should be strengthened and why the OM suggestion was not adopted.
The CDA members can strongly agree with the Council of Europe Convention on the protection of children against sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
De leden van de CDA-fractie kunnen zich met grote instemming scharen achter het Verdrag van de Raad van Europa inzake de bescherming van kinderen tegen seksuele uitbuiting en seksueel misbruik.
Asks why medical confidentiality rules were not amended to permit reporting of suspected child abuse and questions police enforcement capacity and backlogs.
These members ask why the government refrained from including such a statutory provision in the bill.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering zich heeft onthouden van het plaatsen van een dergelijke wettelijke bepaling in het voorstel.
Worries that the intent requirement is missing, risking prosecution of people who access child pornography unintentionally, and raises enforceability concerns and a possible reversed burden of proof.
Is it thereby sufficiently guaranteed that someone who unintentionally accesses a website with child pornographic images is not punished?
Wordt hiermee voldoende gewaarborgd dat iemand die zich onopzettelijk de toegang verschaft tot een website met kinderpornografische afbeeldingen niet wordt gestraft?
Supports the bill but asks whether criminalising preparation of a meeting with a child is a systematic departure from the general preparation rule in article 46 Sr.

These members can accept this criminalisation but ask the government to explain further to what extent this constitutes a systematic departure from criminalising preparation under article 46 of the Criminal Code.

Deze leden kunnen zich vinden in deze strafbaarstelling maar vragen de regering nader toe te lichting in hoeverre dit een systeembreuk inhoudt met het strafbaar stellen van voorbereiding ingevolge artikel 46 Sr.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill implementing the Lanzarote Convention proceed, but asked that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented and the wording of the offence of corrupting children (art. 248d Sr) reconsidered, because the Dutch 'met ontuchtig oogmerk' arguably duplicates intent and weakens protection compared to the treaty's 'voor seksuele doeleinden'. The minister's reply rejects the objection, arguing that 'oogmerk' is the standard Dutch implementation of purpose language and that it does not create a double intent requirement, while making only minor redactional changes.
concerns: The Raad considers the translation 'met ontuchtig oogmerk' inconsistent with the treaty's 'voor seksuele doeleinden' and creates a double intent requirement, lowering protection of minors; the minister rejects this, arguing oogmerk implies intent by definition.

32035.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 to require grid operators to pay a flat-rate compensation for 2009 and 2010 to small consumers affected by the introduction of the capacity-dependent transport tariff. It also allows the cost of this task to be recovered through tariffs and sets the compensation amounts and administrative rules by ministerial regulation.
32035.j: The memorandum justifies setting the amounts and implementation rules by ministerial regulation as a practical, technical matter following the network operators' existing working methods, and invokes urgency for the bill.
q: The amounts of the compensation will be included in the ministerial regulation.
In de ministeriële regeling zullen de bedragen van de tegemoetkoming worden opgenomen.
d: amount of compensation per consumer category
implementation of payment, information, date and method, and administration of network operators

parties: Asks for justification of the tariff increase, the definition of substantial harm, and why small connections are excluded from compensation.
According to the government, when is there substantial harm, and how is this concept defined?
Wanneer is er volgens de regering sprake van «substantieel nadeel», hoe is dit begrip gedefinieerd?
Asks why only small consumers pay for the compensation, why the costs exceed expected savings, and about data and the NMa's tariff effects.
Why does the government choose this? Why do large consumers not contribute?
Waarom kiest de regering hiervoor? Waarom betalen de grootverbruikers niet mee?

Supports compensation but wants proactive free advice for affected consumers, permanent protection for those who cannot reduce capacity for technical or safety reasons, and network operators to bear connection costs.
The SP members are concerned about disadvantages for users who, due to technical limitations or safety rules, cannot reduce the connection capacity below 3*25A over time.

De leden van de SP maken zich zorgen over de nadelen die betrekking hebben op gebruikers die door technische beperkingen of veiligheidsvoorschriften niet in staat zijn om de capaciteit van de aansluiting op termijn terug te brengen tot minder dan 3*25A.
Asks for justification of the chosen connection capacity thresholds for compensation and whether installation adjustments are feasible during the transitional scheme.
What is the explanation for the choice of these connection capacity values?
Wat is de verklaring voor de keuze van deze doorlaatwaarden?

32044.s: This bill adds a second section to the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure allowing the Supreme Court, on request of the College of Procurators-General, to reopen a final acquittal or discharge to the detriment of the former suspect in narrow cases involving new evidence, false evidence, or a bribed judge. It sets strict conditions, requires prior approval and judicial authorisation for investigative measures against the former suspect, and provides for a full retrial in first instance with appeal and cassation.
32044.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to correct wrongful acquittals and the restrictive conditions attached to them, such as serious offences, strong new evidence and judicial oversight.
q: This bill aims to allow final judgments of the criminal court in cases of serious offences to be reopened to the detriment of the former suspect.
Dit wetsvoorstel heeft tot doel onherroepelijke uitspraken van de strafrechter in geval van ernstige misdrijven ten nadele van de gewezen verdachte te kunnen herzien.
p: Allows the public prosecution service to seek investigative measures against a former suspect after a final acquittal, subject to College approval and rechter-commissaris authorisation, with appeal rights for the suspect.
Creates a narrow ground for reopening an acquittal to the detriment of the former suspect, limited to serious offences and specified forms of new evidence, decided by the Supreme Court.

parties: Worries that individuals may relentlessly pursue acquitted suspects and that safeguards are needed against abuse of the reopened procedure.
An important concern is that individuals (journalists, researchers, etc.) increasingly fixate ruthlessly on a concluded criminal case and do not let go.

Een belangrijk punt van zorg is gelegen in het feit dat het steeds vaker voorkomt dat individuen (journalisten, onderzoekers etc.) zich niets ontziend vastbijten in een afgedane strafzaak en niet meer loslaten.
Questions the necessity of the bill given earlier policy rejecting retrial to the detriment, and asks about the high thresholds and the risk of weak convictions on retrial.
The PvdA members ask what problems the government sees in reopening a criminal case after a long time with regard to the evidence.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen welke problemen de regering ziet in het na lange tijd heropenen van een strafzaak met betrekking tot de bewijsvoering.
Warns that retrial to the detriment could become a slippery slope, undermining the authority of law, and urges extreme restraint and better reasoned judgments.
There is a risk that with the introduction of retrial to the detriment every acquittal will be seen as a provisional acquittal pending new developments in investigation.
Het risico bestaat dat met de invoering van een herziening te nadele iedere vrijspraak wordt gezien als een voorlopige vrijspraak in afwachting van nieuwe ontwikkelingen in de opsporing.

Supports the bill in principle, wants it treated together with retrial in favour, argues scope should be broader for serious crimes and that statute of limitations should be dropped, and questions the lack of advice from police bodies.

The VVD members have noted with approval the government's intention, despite its disadvantages, to introduce the possibility of reviewing final judgments to the detriment of the former suspect for serious offences.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het voornemen van de regering om, ondanks daaraan verbonden nadelen, toch te komen tot de invoering van de mogelijkheid om onherroepelijke uitspraken in geval van ernstige misdrijven ten nadele van de gewezen verdachte te kunnen herzien.
Asks for clarification on what counts as a credible confession and on why the prosecution rather than the Attorney General at the Supreme Court should initiate retrials.

These members request further explanation of this choice and ask whether, given the possible involvement of the prosecution service in how the case was handled up to the non-conviction, the gatekeeping role should not also rest with the Attorney General at the Supreme Court for retrials to the detriment.

Deze leden verzoeken deze keuze nader toe te lichten en daarbij in te gaan op de vraag of gezien de mogelijke betrokkenheid van het OM bij de wijze waarop de strafzaak waarvan herziening ten nadele wordt overwogen tot aan de niet-veroordelende uitspraak van de rechter behandeld is, er niet voor pleit om ook bij de herziening ten nadele de poortwachtersfunctie aan de procureur-generaal bij de Hoge Raad te laten.
Asks whether the omnipresence of particular investigation and the stricter exclusion criteria are justified, and questions the inclusion of the bribed-judge falsa ground given no known Dutch cases.
The SGP members note that the proposed article 482a allows retrial to the detriment for four kinds of falsa, including the case of a bribed judge (second paragraph).

De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat de voorgestelde regeling van artikel 482a herziening ten nadele mogelijk mogelijk bij vier soorten falsa, waaronder het geval van een omgekochte rechter (tweede lid).
Accepts retrial to the detriment of the acquitted, including retroactive application, and asks why victims' relatives cannot themselves request such a retrial.
These members believe the societal interest in being able to revise incorrect acquittals outweighs the interest of the individual suspect.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het maatschappelijke belang om onjuiste vrijspraken te kunnen herzien zwaarder weegt dan het belang van de individuele verdachte.
Asks why the government moved from the original bill to a broader scope and whether retroactive effect combined with lifting limitation periods threatens legal certainty.
Does the government share the view that the combination of retroactive effect for lifting limitation periods and opening retrial to the detriment risks undermining legal certainty?

Deelt de regering de mening dat door de combinatie van het geven van terugwerkende kracht aan zowel het schrappen van verjaringstermijnen als het openstellen van herziening ten nadele de kans bestaat dat het rechtszekerheidsbeginsel wordt aangetast?
Welcomes the retroactive effect so that unsolved cold cases are not excluded, and asks for motivation of the broader offence scope tied to the consequence rather than intent.
It would be very unsatisfactory if, should the cold-case teams succeed in solving cases, these fell outside the scope of this bill.
Het zou zeer onbevredigend zijn wanneer, zo de cold-case-teams erin slagen de zaken op te helderen, deze buiten het bereik van voorliggend wetsvoorstel zouden vallen.
Asks for substantiation of possible conflict with treaty law and the Council of State's concern about immediate effect and legal certainty.
The members request further substantiation of possible conflict with treaty law of the proposed immediate effect.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen om een nadere onderbouwing van mogelijke strijdigheid met verdragsrecht van de voorgestelde onmiddellijke werking.
Warns of a slippery slope, questions the disproportionate retention of DNA and personal data of acquitted persons, and asks for alternatives and the ECHR Article 8 compliance.
Retaining DNA data and other data in all acquittal cases because retrial to the detriment might occasionally be possible in future is, in their view, disproportionate.
Het bewaren van onder andere DNA-gegevens in alle gevallen van vrijspraak omdat in de toekomst in een incidenteel geval herziening ten nadele mogelijk is, is naar hun disproportioneel.
Asks for clear criteria for 'very serious offences' and for 'the interest of good administration of justice', and questions arbitrary selection of offences included and excluded.
Surely it cannot be left entirely to the judge to give content to this concept?
Het kan toch niet volledig aan de rechter overgelaten worden om een inkleuring van dit begrip te geven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises against the second amendment note to the bill on retrial to the detriment of an acquitted person, arguing that giving immediate effect to the regime for acquitted persons and expanding it to manslaughter and violent/sexual offences with fatal outcome undermines legal certainty and should be reconsidered. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the legal certainty objections, maintains immediate effect and the expansion, and explains the interaction with the planned limitation-period changes.
concerns: Immediate effect of retrial to the detriment for acquittals reached before entry into force undermines legitimate expectations of finality, which the government rejects as not absolute.
Expanding retrial to manslaughter and violent/sexual offences with fatal outcome should await clarity on limitation-period reforms, which the government considers the relationship already clear.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill reforming the revision procedure in criminal law but advises revisions on the 'unknown to the judge' requirement, the authority deciding on further investigation in revision to the convicted person's disadvantage, retention of data of acquitted suspects, and splitting the bill in two. The government replies in a nader rapport, largely rejecting the first two points, accepting the splitting and the proportionality point on retention, and agreeing to supplement the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Raad asks what meaning the requirement that the judge was unaware of the novum still has after Lucia de B.; the government retains the requirement, explaining it still has added value.
The Raad advises replacing 'gegeven' with 'feiten of omstandigheden'; the government keeps 'gegeven' for reasons of feitelijke aard and readability.

The Raad holds that the decision on further investigation in revision to the disadvantage should be taken at a higher level, preferably by the procureur-generaal at the Hoge Raad, rather than by the rechter-commissaris; the government declines, citing urgency and collusion risk.

The Raad finds retention of DNA data and fingerprints of acquitted suspects disproportionate under Article 8 EVRM; the government adds justification to the explanatory memorandum and points to re-sampling procedures under the new provisions.
The Raad makes two redactional remarks; the first (appeal terms in art. 482d) is adopted, the second (term 'bewijsmiddelen') is not.
The Raad advises considering splitting the bill into separate bills on revision in favour of the accused and revision to their disadvantage; the government follows this.

32134.s: The bill creates a legal framework for samenwerkingsscholen, schools jointly offering public and special education, to be run by a foundation with supervision by the municipal council and a denominational body. It amends the primary, secondary, and expertise centre education acts and the medezeggenschap law to accommodate such schools.
32134.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by pointing to the constitutional basis in article 23 of the Grondwet and to the need for safeguards such as supervision by the municipal council and the denominational body.
q: A dispute between a municipal governing body and the legal person concerning supervision of the samenwerkingsschool and interpretation of the foundation's statutes is referred to a disputes committee of experts designated by the council and the legal person in mutual consultation.

Een geschil tussen een bestuursorgaan van de gemeente en de rechtspersoon, bedoeld in het vijfde lid, omtrent het toezicht op de samenwerkingsschool en omtrent de uitlegging van de statuten van de stichting die de samenwerkingsschool in stand houdt, wordt voorgelegd aan een geschillencommissie
p: In cases of serious neglect of duties by the board, the municipal council may take measures it deems necessary to safeguard continuity of public education, with a joint decision needed to end cooperation.
The General Administrative Law Act does not apply to decisions of the legal person running the samenwerkingsschool, removing a standard procedural protection against those decisions.
Disputes over supervision and interpretation of the statutes are sent to a disputes committee of experts designated jointly by the council and the legal person, rather than to courts.

parties: Supports joint schools as a last resort to preserve the dual system but asks how the identity of the joint school and governance will be determined in practice, and whether the municipal council's approval and oversight role remains adequate.
To prevent either public or denominational education from disappearing, these members consider the formation of a joint school an adequate solution.
Om te voorkomen dat er of geen openbaar onderwijs dan wel geen bijzonder onderwijs wordt aangeboden, menen deze leden dat de vorming van een samenwerkingsschool een adequate oplossing kan bieden.

Welcomes the statutory basis but asks about safeguards for the public character, the position of the original boards as overseers of identity, the municipal council's powers in case of neglect, and the lack of consent or review for later changes.
How realistic is it to expect that oversight of public education will be guaranteed in the long term?
Hoe reëel is het om te verwachten dat het toezicht op het openbaar onderwijs op lange termijn wordt gewaarborgd?

Questions whether the bill correctly implements the constitutional intent, whether equal standing of public and denominational education is respected, and whether periodic review of the joint school's necessity should be built in.
These members ask whether the bill correctly implements the intent of the Constitution.
Deze leden vragen of het wetsvoorstel een correcte uitwerking geeft aan de bedoeling van de Grondwet.

Asks about confusion for parents, teachers and pupils between legally defined joint schools and existing de facto ones, and about the representation of staff in participation rights when school foundations change.
Is this observation correct? Is this not confusing for parents, teachers and pupils?
Is deze constatering waar? Is dit niet verwarrend naar ouders, docenten en leerlingen toe?

Fears growth in joint schools could erode the dual system, asks for guarantees that denominational education continues to be offered and how the ban on identity-based discrimination and pluralism is protected.
These members point to their fear that growth in the number of joint schools could erode the dual education system over time.
Deze leden wijzen op hun vrees dat een groei van het aantal samenwerkingsscholen het duale onderwijsbestel op termijn uit kan hollen.

v.summary: The Council of State advises on a bill allowing public and special schools to merge into a single cooperation school, raising concerns about scope criteria, staff appointment and co-decision, eigen-wachtgelder rules, termination of cooperation, the planning procedure, and dispute resolution via a expert committee, advising revision. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most points, adding clarifications and changing the prognosis term to six years and the dispute route to ordinary civil courts.
concerns: The open-ended prognosis period for imminent closure could allow cooperation schools to start before actual discontinuity; a fixed objective term is advised, and the government adopted six years.
Staff appointment and denominational conflicts under eigen-wachtgelder rules need a clear regime and guarantees, and the explanatory memorandum should be clarified.

Routing disputes on supervision and interpretation of statutes to the administrative judge conflicts with the private-law character of foundations; the government now provides only a dispute committee without administrative appeal.
The planning procedure and identity of cooperation schools when assessing vacancies and need for new schools need further explanation in the memorandum.
Transitional rules and the consequences of two types of schools, plus termination of cooperation and public-interest intervention, should be explained more clearly.

32161.s: The bill sets out rules for protecting personal data in the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, implementing article 10 of the Constitution and largely mirroring the Dutch Wbp with adjustments for the islands. It creates a Commissie toezicht bescherming persoonsgegevens BES with enforcement powers, grants data subjects access, correction and objection rights, and provides civil and court remedies.
32161.j: The memorandum justifies the deviations from Dutch rules by the islands' economic and social conditions, distance from the European Netherlands, small size and insular character, as foreseen in the Statute, and the delegations are presented as needed for implementation.
q: Given, among other things, the population size of the three islands, the great distance from the Netherlands and their insular character, provisions deviating from Dutch legislation will however be introduced.

Gezien onder meer de bevolkingsomvang van de drie eilanden, de grote afstand met Nederland en het insulaire karakter zullen echter van de Nederlandse wetgeving afwijkende voorzieningen worden getroffen.
d: Artikel 19, eerste lid, onderdeel b; Artikel 21, vijfde lid
further rules on political opinion checks for office and health data processing
other cases where a legally prescribed identification number may be used
Artikel 31, eerste lid; Artikel 32, derde lid
fee amounts for access requests and objections
allowances and rights of commission members
rules on supervision of personal data processing
minister may grant exemption from the prohibition on processing sensitive data, with conditions
p: The Minister of Justice may grant exemptions from the ban on processing sensitive personal data in the public interest, imposing conditions as he sees fit.
The supervisory commission gets powers to enter homes without occupant consent and to impose administrative enforcement orders and penalty payments.
Artikel 2, tweede lid, onderdelen b tot f; Artikel 2, derde lid
The law does not apply to intelligence and security services, police, and military processing when the Minister of Defence decides so, removing data protection oversight for these executive bodies.
Controllers may set aside access and notification rights for state security, crime prevention, and important state economic interests where necessary.
The minister may demand access to documents from the supervisory commission as needed for his duties.

parties: Accepts the temporary arrangement but asks for a horizon clause so the transition ends quickly, and questions why the minister of Justice rather than the independent commission grants exemptions.
These members miss a clear horizon provision in the bill aimed at full functioning on the BES islands of the Wbp applicable in the European part of the Netherlands.
Deze leden missen in het wetsvoorstel een duidelijke horizonbepaling gericht op het volledig functioneren op de BES-eilanden van de in het Europese deel van Nederland geldende Wbp.
Asks why the supervisor on the islands cannot mediate unlike the Cbp, and whether the exemption power was moved from the minister as promised to the Council of State.
The PvdA members also do not see in the bill that not the minister of Justice but an independent commission receives the power to grant exemptions.
Ook de leden van de PvdA-fractie zien in de wet niet terug dat niet de minister van Justitie, maar een onafhankelijke commissie de bevoegdheid krijgt tot het verlenen van ontheffing.

Asks why there is no duty to notify the supervisor of data processing and why the sanction from the European part is not carried over, and what 'disproportionate effort' exempting information duties means in practice.
However these members ask why there is no duty to report the processing of personal data to the supervisory authority, the so-called notification duty.
Wel vragen deze leden waarom er geen plicht komt om verwerking van persoonsgegevens bij de toezichthoudende autoriteit te melden, de zogenaamde meldplicht.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens BES, criticising the adoption of the Wbp model without adequate local analysis, the absence of a defined supervisory framework and the short evaluation period. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks: it creates an independent supervisory commission in the law itself, transfers exemption power to it and extends the evaluation period to five years, while defending the transition periods.
concerns: The Raad doubted whether the full Wbp model is feasible and justified for the BES islands given missing local information, and the government only partly addressed this by promising evaluation.

Supervision was left to a vague delegation to ministerial commission; the Raad required the main lines of supervision to be set out in the law, and the government created an independent commission in the statute.
The Raad objected that essentials of the supervisory arrangement were delegated rather than regulated in the law itself, which the government accepted.
The Raad found the three-year transition and implementation support insufficiently explained, and the government defended the periods while promising to support implementation.
The Raad asked for the evaluation period to be extended from three to five years, which the government adopted.
The Raad gave a list of redactional remarks on cross-references and wording, largely adopted, with one omitted because the article was changed.

32206.s: The bill fully bans stilettos, switchblades and butterfly knives, extends and makes more flexible the ban on folding knives, and clarifies the Weapons and Ammunition Act, including exemptions for recreational activities and annual checks on firearm licence holders by the police chief. It also moves some exemption powers from the Minister of Defence and the police to the Minister of Justice via ministerial regulation.
32206.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial exemption powers as needed to avoid unnecessary trade barriers and legal uncertainty for recreational businesses, and the annual checks as needed to keep oversight of licence holders after the validity extension.
q: To give the Minister of Justice the power to remove this uncertainty and regulate, articles I, parts H and I, of the bill amend articles 26(6) and 27(4) of the Wwm.

Om de Minister van Justitie de bevoegdheid te geven deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen en regulerend op te treden is in artikel I, onderdelen H en I, van het wetsvoorstel voorzien in een wijziging van de artikelen 26, zesde lid en 27, vierde lid, van de Wwm.
d: exemptions from ban on category I weapons
exemption from export consent for weapons to non-EU states
designated recreational activities allowing 16-18 year olds to possess weapons
exemption allowing persons over 18 to carry category IV weapons in recreational activities
information duties of licence holders to the police chief
p: Power to grant exemptions from the category I weapons ban is given to the Minister, with no parliamentary involvement or stated criteria beyond listed purposes.
Minister may by regulation exempt recreational activities from carrying-age rules, widening executive discretion over weapon access.
Licence validity extended from one to five years, with annual police checks and information duties replacing annual applications.

parties: Asks whether the discretionary folding-knife category could be used for knives with a legitimate purpose and what the ministerial regulation on exemptions will contain.
Can the government indicate which kinds of knives it precisely means here?
Kan de regering aangeven welk soort messen zij hier precies mee bedoelt?
Questions the broad delegation allowing exemptions for police and investigators to carry category I weapons and argues this needs democratic scrutiny.

The members find the possibilities to grant exemptions to police officers and investigators for carrying category I weapons so far-reaching that democratic review should take place before such an exemption takes effect.

Voornoemde leden vinden de mogelijkheden om vrijstelling te verlenen aan politieagenten en opsporings- ambtenaren voor het dragen van categorie I wapens zo ingrijpend dat hierop, voor het effectief worden van een dergelijke vrijstelling, democratische toetsing plaats zou moeten kunnen vinden.
Supports the full ban but asks whether enforcement of the broader folding-knife ban is workable and whether police, prosecutors and judiciary were consulted.
Were advice sought on this from the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the judiciary?
Zijn hierover adviezen ingewonnen bij de politie, het Openbaar Ministerie en de rechterlijke macht?
Questions the hockey-stick example in the explanatory memorandum and asks about the treatment of airsoft weapons under the new rules.
Supports limiting availability of weapons suited to threats and sees no reason for further comments.
They currently see no reason to make further comments on this bill.
Zij zien op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het maken van nadere opmerkingen met betrekking tot dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on a bill extending the ban on stilettos, switchblades and butterfly knives and flexibilising the ban on folding knives, asking for stronger justification, clearer legal certainty, a narrower police exemption and an EU notification discussion. The government reply reports that most advice was followed, adding justification, clarifying the criteria, explaining owner surrender and property protection, and addressing EU notification.
concerns: The Council asked for a stronger evidential basis for extending the knife ban, which the government met by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.
The vague criterion of regular socially accepted use for folding knives raised foreseeability concerns; the government clarified it in the explanatory memorandum but did not change the wording.
The Council noted the surrender of knives and loss of ownership raises property concerns and asked for justification, which the government supplemented.
The Council asked for a specific rather than general police exemption; the government clarified that ministerial regulation will determine scope.
The Council asked that the EU notification obligation under Directive 98/34/EC be addressed in the explanatory memorandum, which was done.
The Council recommended replacing an example about a baseball bat in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did.

32215.s: The bill approves the 2009 Dutch-Belgian treaty under which a Dutch prison in Tilburg is made available to enforce Belgian prison sentences. It also excludes Dutch prison law from application there (except medical care), assigns escort duties to Dutch officials under the Minister of Justice, and routes habeas corpus and detention complaints to Belgian courts.
32215.j: The memorandum justifies excluding Dutch courts and prison law by treating Belgian courts as the competent judicial authority and noting similar provisions in other international tribunal laws.
q: Dutch law does not apply to deprivation of liberty resulting from enforcement of Belgian sentences in the Tilburg penitentiary institution.

De Nederlandse wet is niet van toepassing op vrijheidsbeneming ondergaan ten gevolge van de tenuitvoerlegging van bij Belgische veroordelingen opgelegde vrijheidsstraffen in de penitentiaire inrichting te Tilburg.
d: designation of officials to escort detainees
p: Dutch statute does not apply to detention in Tilburg and habeas corpus claims go to Belgian rather than Dutch courts, though the memorandum argues a judicial remedy remains guaranteed.
Escort officials may take any measures deemed necessary to secure detainees and prevent escape.

parties: Asks who bears ultimate responsibility for the prison and detainees, whether the treaty's staffing arrangements are settled, and how jurisdiction over complaints about medical treatment is organised.
Which country then has ultimate responsibility for the penal institution and the detainees?
Welk land heeft dan de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor de penitentiaire inrichting en de gedetineerden?
Welcomes housing Belgian detainees in principle but asks how Dutch staff can exercise influence and co-determination under a Belgian directorate and which language the detainees speak.
These members ask to what extent Dutch staff of the institution can have a say in this cooperation.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre in deze samenwerking inspraak mogelijk is voor de Nederlandse medewerkers van de inrichting.
Supports the treaty in principle but questions which Belgian law and detainee rights apply, the sanctions for Dutch staff, and the escape procedure's clarity.
What are the main substantive differences between the rights of Belgian detainees under Belgian law and the Dutch Pbw?
Wat zijn de belangrijkste materiële verschillen tussen de rechten van Belgische gedetineerden volgens Belgisch recht en de Nederlandse Pbw.
Asks how the surplus capacity relates to sentencing figures and who will conduct appraisal interviews under the Belgian directorate.
Furthermore, the VVD members ask whether the works council of PI Tilburg (and the staff) will also face a Belgian directorate for their employment and legal-status conditions.

Voorts vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie of de ondernemingsraad van de PI Tilburg (en het personeel) ook voor de arbeidspositionele- en rechtspositionele omstandigheden te maken zullen krijgen met een Belgische directie.

32242.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Bolsward, Nijefurd, Sneek, Wûnseradiel and Wymbritseradiel into a new municipality called Súdwest Fryslân, with transitional provisions on tax, joint arrangements, drinking water/energy/gas supply, an interim council election and conforming amendments to judicial district, police and safety-region statutes. The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by the new tasks of local government and the need for a robust administration and democratic control.
32242.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the new municipality's capacity to take on decentralised tasks and by councillors' wish for control over decision-making and democratic legitimacy.
q: With a population of over 80,000, it becomes possible to build in the new municipality an expert and robust administrative organisation suited to these tasks.
Met een omvang van ruim 80 000 inwoners wordt het mogelijk in de nieuw te vormen gemeente een deskundig en op deze taken berekende robuuste ambtelijke organisatie op te bouwen

parties: Supports mergers backed by municipal councils but asks about the open procedure for the mayor, school closures, and the process chosen by the province.
These members in principle support a reorganisation proposal supported by the municipal councils of the municipalities concerned.
Deze leden geven in beginsel steun aan een herindelingsvoorstel dat door de gemeenteraden van de betrokken gemeenten wordt gedragen.
Asks for a regional vision and the province's role in mergers, and whether other municipalities can still reach a balanced division.
To ensure this process leads to a balanced end result, these members attach importance to a region-wide vision that the municipalities can fill in through good consultation and freedom.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat dit proces tot een evenwichtig eindresultaat leidt, hechten voornoemde leden aan een gebiedsbrede visie die de gemeenten in goed overleg en vrijheid in kunnen vullen.
Argues local democracy belongs to residents, not provincial officials, notes weak public support, and calls for a referendum or consultation of residents.
Does the government share the view of these members that local democracy belongs to the residents of the municipalities and not to provincial administrators?
Deelt zij de mening van deze leden dat de lokale democratie van de inwoners van de gemeenten is en niet van de bestuurders van de provincie?
Asks whether the province gave a view (Provinciale Staten not consulted) and requests a provincial reorganisation framework and whether the process should be postponed.
Is the government willing to still ask advice from the Provincial States of Friesland?
Is de regering bereid om alsnog advies aan Provinciale Staten van Friesland te vragen?
Holds that a unanimous local support is required and that the decisions were taken undemocratically without consulting residents.
The decisions in the various Frisian municipal councils were taken in an undemocratic manner, without consulting the citizens.
De beslissingen in de verschillende Friese gemeenteraden zijn op een ondemocratische wijze genomen, waarbij de burgers niet zijn geconsulteerd.
Notes the merger was voluntary after council consent, but asks about the 69 villages, the reduced general grant and the regional impact on neighbouring municipalities.
It is clear that the many villages are an important point of attention and call for an adequate village policy.
Duidelijk is dat de veelkernigheid een belangrijk punt van aandacht is en vraagt om een adequaat kernenbeleid.
Asks what administrative problems exist, the provincial advice details, and whether a total provincial vision exists.
Does the government share the view that it is good when a province does not approach municipalities with such an end picture?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat het goed is wanneer een provincie niet met een dergelijk eindbeeld naar gemeenten toegaat?

32260.s: The bill amends the Wet investeren in jongeren (WIJ) and several related laws mainly to clarify and correct technical points, such as harmonising references to the income support norm, adjusting benefit amounts for young couples, adding a rule on owner-occupied homes, and allowing offsetting of recovered costs. It also adds WIJ decisions to the negative list of the general administrative law and the Beroepswet, which limits appeal rights against those decisions.
32260.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as clarifications and corrections of technical references, with the inspectorate finding no problems for supervision.
q: Articles of the WIJ are added to this list that correspond in substance to articles of the WWB already on the negative list.
Aan deze lijst worden artikelen van de WIJ toegevoegd die inhoudelijk overeenkomen met de artikelen uit de WWB die op de negatieve lijst staan.
d: adjusting income support where a young person shares child care under an agreement
p: Artikel IV (Algemene wet bestuursrecht, bijlage onderdeel F)
Adds WIJ decisions on advance payments, recovery and emergency aid to the negative list, so no ordinary objection or appeal is available against them.
Routes appeals against WIJ decisions to the Centrale Raad van Beroep as a specialised court, a procedural change that narrows the route of appeal.
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 28) and onderdeel J (artikel 36)
Replaces amounts and norms for young couples and refers to a general income support norm, mainly technical alignment without expanding discretion.
Gives young home owners a right to income support where selling or encumbering the home cannot reasonably be required, with the support in the form of a loan.

parties: Asks why joint liability of both partners is not regulated as in the WWB, whether a WWB-style provision on mortgage security should apply, and whether the information duty sanction is intended, pushing for clearer legal grounds for municipal recovery and controls.
The CDA members now ask the government whether this same objective applies under the WIJ.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nu, of deze zelfde doelstelling geldt in de WIJ.

Views the WIJ as a cost-cutting measure that undermines a fundamental right of young people and questions the creation of a new income norm that may create uncertainty and shorten the transitional period.
Moreover, they consider that this law infringes an important fundamental right of young people.
Bovendien vinden zij dat deze wet een belangrijk grondrecht van jongeren aantast.

Asks on what criteria municipalities assess physical, mental or social reasons, how young people can object to decisions and what their rights are, and whether home-equity loans could cause problematic debt.
In what way can a young person object to the decision taken by the college, and what are then that person's rights, they wish to know.
Op welke manier kan een jongere eventueel bezwaar maken tegen het door het college genomen besluit en wat zijn dan de rechten van die persoon, zo willen zij weten.

32305.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for the EU enforcement regulation so that its articles 2 to 6 also implement the 2007 Lugano Convention on jurisdiction and recognition and enforcement of civil and commercial judgments. It adds a new article 6a that reads the convention in place of the regulation in those articles.
32305.j: The memorandum justifies the approach by saying the Lugano Convention can be implemented in the same way as the regulation's provisions, following the Council of State's advice on simplicity and clarity.
q: The implementation of the articles of the Lugano Convention 2007 can be arranged in the same way as the implementation of the provisions of the EC Enforcement Regulation in the Implementation Act EC Enforcement Regulation.

De uitvoering van de artikelen van het Verdrag van Lugano 2007 kan op de zelfde wijze worden geregeld als de uitvoering van de bepalingen van de EG-executieverordening in de Uitvoeringswet EG-executieverordening.

parties: The VVD welcomes simplification of recognition and enforcement of decisions and asks which further simplifications of the exequatur procedure exist and what supplement to internal law is needed.
These members consider it important that simplification of the recognition and enforcement of decisions be increased.
Deze leden achten het van belang dat vereenvoudiging van de erkenning en de tenuitvoerlegging van beslissingen wordt vergroot.

v.summary: The Council of State agreed with the bill implementing the 2007 Lugano Convention on jurisdiction and enforcement of civil and commercial judgments, but advised folding its provisions into the existing Uitvoeringswet EG-executieverordening rather than a separate act for clarity. The Minister followed the advice, adding a provision to the existing Act stating that its articles also serve to implement the Convention, and adjusting the title and preamble.
concerns: The Council of State advised incorporating the bill into the existing Uitvoeringswet EG-executieverordening instead of enacting a separate statute, arguing this serves simplicity and transparency of legislation.

32314.s: The bill establishes a new advisory council, the Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI), to advise the government and parliament on long-term strategic policy for the living environment and infrastructure, and abolishes the VROM-raad, the Raad voor verkeer en waterstaat and the Raad voor het landelijk gebied. It also amends the Wet advies en overleg verkeer en waterstaat and renames it, and sets the entry-into-force rules.
32314.j: The memorandum justifies the new council by reference to the general framework of the Kaderwet adviescolleges and the fee law, and by the need to focus on long-term structural policy problems.
q: finding structural solutions to the problems the Netherlands will face in the longer term sometimes receives less attention
het vinden van structurele oplossingen voor de problemen waarmee Nederland op de langere termijn zal worden geconfronteerd soms minder aandacht kan krijgen
d: Artikel 5 (Wet overleg verkeer en waterstaat, referring to Besluit overleg verkeer en waterstaat 2004)
consultation rules via existing general administrative order

parties: Doubts that the merger delivers efficiency or added advisory value and worries about losing independent expert knowledge in favour of generalists.
The VVD members doubt whether the RLI will add advisory value in this way.
De leden van de VVD-fractie betwijfelen of de RLI op deze wijze meerwaarde in de advisering zal opleveren.
Asks whether the Chamber can directly request research from the advisory council without government involvement and whether decentralisation risks a state-centred tunnel vision.
The CDA members note that the explanatory memorandum does not explicitly clarify whether the Chamber can directly submit a research request to the advisory council without government involvement.

De leden van de CDA-fractie constateren dat in de memorie van toelichting niet expliciet duidelijk wordt gemaakt of de Kamer direct een aanvraag voor een onderzoek, zonder tussenkomst van de regering, kan indienen bij de Adviesraad.
Questions whether the RLI will focus on short-term integrated advice or long-term strategic work, and objects to the gender-balance criterion for council composition.
The PVV members find such forms of 'positive' discrimination outrageous.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vinden dergelijke vormen van «positieve» discriminatie ongehoord.
Generally positive about merging advisory bodies but asks about overlap with the planning bureau, the choice of nine core members and the cap on flexible members.
In principle they are positive about merging advisory bodies but have some questions for clarification.
In beginsel staan zij positief tegenover het samenvoegen van adviesorganen maar zij hebben nog enkele vragen ter verduidelijking.
Raises no comments on the bill itself beyond insisting that the withdrawal of the Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen should be dropped.
The bill gives these members no reason for comment, except for the parts relating to the withdrawal of the Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen, met uitzondering van die onderdelen die verband houden met de intrekking van de Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen.
No comments on the bill beyond the related withdrawal of the Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen, which is covered in a separate report.
The bill gives these members no reason for comment, except for the parts relating to the withdrawal of the Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen, met uitzondering van die onderdelen die verband houden met de intrekking van de Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion finds the Kabinetsnotitie's problem analysis of the advisory system insufficient and advises against proceeding with merging advisory councils until the problems are clarified. The government's reply (nader rapport) disagrees with the Raad's conclusion, defends the bill as a first step, and states that the Raad's remarks on purpose, functions, and side-effects will be taken into account.
concerns: The Raad doubts the problem analysis justifies the restructuring and that the measures will solve the identified problems; the government disagrees and considers the notitie a sufficient basis.

The Raad asks for a full survey of the knowledge and advisory system and clarity on the functions of strategic councils before restructuring; the government rejects the need for a prior survey but promises a later analysis and evaluations.

The Raad warns of side-effects such as loss of differentiation, continuity and historical memory from merging and flexible staffing; the government argues these risks are unfounded but acknowledges the need to monitor them.

The Raad asks that the strategic advisory task of the AGS be shown to be placeable at the RLI at a responsible level; the government's reply largely addresses purpose and role but the Raad's point is only partly answered.

The Raad asks the explanatory memorandum to address the reactions of the three existing councils and to avoid implementing measures before the legislative process ends; the reply adds the advisory domain and functions but treats pre-legislative implementation only in general terms.

32323.s: The bill repeals the Wet Adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen (Advisory Council on Hazardous Substances Act), ending the statutory advisory role the council held on strategic-level hazardous substances policy. The government argues the advisory tasks merit reconsideration given progress made in the policy field and a reassessment of advisory needs.
q: it is therefore desirable to repeal the Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen
het derhalve wenselijk is de Wet adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen in te trekken
p: Repealing the statute removes a statutorily established advisory body on hazardous substances, shifting advisory input away from a legally guaranteed channel and leaving its continuation to executive discretion.

parties: Asks whether the new structure has enough independent experts and whether hazardous substances get sufficient attention.
These members note that the new structure has no independent expert, apart from the chair of the Programme Council of the Dutch Centre for Standardisation (NEN).
Deze leden constateren dat in de nieuwe constructie geen sprake is van een onafhankelijke expert, afgezien van de voorzitter van de Programmaraad van het Nederlands centrum van normalisatie (NEN).
Asks whether municipalities have sufficient expertise to enforce hazardous substance rules after decentralisation and how knowledge infrastructure is preserved.
Control and application of hazardous substances regulation lies largely with local governments, the CDA members note.
De controle en toepassing van regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen ligt grotendeels bij lokale overheden, zo constateren de leden van de fractie van het CDA.
Generally positive on merging advisory bodies but worried that specific knowledge on hazardous substances may be lost, and asks about financial gains.
Is there no risk that abolishing the council could lead to the loss of specific knowledge on handling and policy-making around hazardous substances, the PvdA members ask.

Is er geen risico dat opheffing van de raad zou kunnen leiden tot het wegvallen van specifieke kennis over de behandeling en beleidsvorming rond gevaarlijke stoffen, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de PvdA.
Argues independent expert advice is indispensable for hazardous substances policy and asks how knowledge and expertise will be retained.
Independent expert advice is no superfluous luxury in this debate, the SP members state.
Een onafhankelijk advies van deskundigen is in de discussie hierover geen overbodige luxe, zo stellen de leden van de fractie van de SP.
Has serious doubts about the justification for abolishing an independent advisory council, citing Raad van State criticism and the Peijs evaluation.
These members note that the Council of State raised critical remarks about the justification for abolishing the Advisory Council on Hazardous Substances.
Deze leden constateren dat de Raad van State kritische kanttekeningen geplaatst heeft bij de motivering voor het opheffen van de Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen.
Wants the bill withdrawn, linking knowledge retention to fire safety and inspection shortcomings.
For this reason the GroenLinks members urge that the bill to abolish the Advisory Council on Hazardous Substances be withdrawn.
Om die reden dringen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks er op aan dat het wetsvoorstel om de Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen op te heffen, wordt ingetrokken.
Asks how expertise and networks will be preserved and whether advice stays independent if expertise rests with RIVM, which also works for the government.
These members ask to what extent the independence of advice is still guaranteed if the substantive expertise must mainly come from the RIVM, which also works on commission from the government.

Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de onafhankelijkheid van advies nog gewaarborgd is als de inhoudelijke deskundigheid nog voornamelijk moet komen van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM), dat ook in opdracht van de regering werkt.
Strongly opposes abolition, doubting that advice quality can be guaranteed once tasks are split into smaller platforms.
In short, the Partij voor de Dieren firmly rejects the bill to abolish the Advisory Council on Hazardous Substances and asks the government to seriously reconsider this ill-advised plan.

Kortom, de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren wijst het wetsvoorstel tot intrekking van de Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen resoluut af en vraagt de regering zich nog eens ernstig te bezinnen op dit onzalige plan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill to abolish the Adviesraad gevaarlijke stoffen (AGS), finding the justification insufficient and asking for a fuller explanation of why the AGS's tasks, including management of the PGS hazardous-substances guidelines, could be transferred and continued. The government's nader rapport accepted the request, expanded the explanation, and clarified that the AGS would only be abolished once the new Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur was operational, without changing the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling found the justification for abolishing the AGS unconvincing and asked the explanatory memorandum to show that its tasks can be placed elsewhere and that the downsides of splitting them are removed.
The Afdeling required guaranteed continuity of the management and updating of the PGS guidelines, which the explanatory memorandum did not secure by 1 June 2009.

32332.s: The bill extends indefinitely the temporary power under Article 25a of the Warenwet to designate private-sector employees as inspectors, which would otherwise lapse on 1 January 2011, and adds a legal basis for regulating direct funding of that inspection. It removes the transitional provision (Article IV) of the 2005 amending act and adds to Article 25a(3) a reference to the costs of supervision.
32332.j: The memorandum justifies continuation by the shift in government policy toward a slimmer VWA that no longer performs all inspections itself, making continued private inspection the most efficient arrangement.
q: It is therefore desirable that the designation of COKZ and CPE be continued after 1 January 2011.
Het is daarom gewenst de aanwijzing van COKZ en CPE na 1 januari 2011 te laten voortduren.
d: rules on direct funding of inspection by COKZ and CPE inspectors
p: Removes the sunset provision so that the executive's power to designate private inspectors continues indefinitely without a new parliamentary decision.

32413.s: The bill adds a new chapter to the Wet beheer rijkswaterstaatswerken to implement EU Directive 2008/96/EC on road infrastructure safety management, requiring the Minister of Transport to carry out road safety effect assessments and audits, periodic safety inspections and classification of high-accident road sections. The detailed criteria, procedures, qualification requirements and inspection methods are left to ministerial regulation.
32413.j: The memorandum justifies leaving detailed content to ministerial regulation because the directive's annexes already give detailed content and allow quick implementation of future amendments.
q: It is proposed to implement the core obligations of the directive at statute level, and to leave the more concrete application of these instruments to a ministerial regulation.

Voorgesteld wordt om de kernverplichtingen uit de richtlijn op wetsniveau te implementeren, en de meer concrete invulling van het gebruik van die instrumenten over te laten aan een ministeriële regeling.
d: phase of infrastructure project in which safety assessments and audits are carried out
content of safety effect assessments and audits, auditor competence and certification recognition
criteria, inspection method and remedial measures for high-accident sections
manner in which road safety inspections are performed
