p: Detailed content and recognition rules for safety assessments and audits are left to ministerial regulation rather than the statute itself.

parties: Asks how other EU countries implement the directive given large differences in road safety between countries.
The VVD members ask the government how other European countries implement this directive, given the large differences in road safety between countries.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering hoe de andere Europese landen deze richtlijn implementeren, gezien de grote verschillen in verkeersveiligheid tussen de verschillende landen.
Welcomes the directive as a chance to secure road safety and a standardised, balanced method for assessing safety effects.
According to these members, the Directive offers the chance to secure the level of road safety and a standardised method for, and reporting on, a swift and balanced assessment of road safety effects.

De Richtlijn biedt volgens deze leden de kans om het niveau van de verkeersveiligheid te verzekeren en een gestandaardiseerde methode voor en rapportage over een snelle evenwichtige afweging van verkeersveiligheidseffecten.
Questions whether the bill is necessary given Dutch programmes and the government's regulatory-burden goal, and prefers embedding audits in existing practice over a statutory framework.
Given the government's own ambition to reduce regulatory burden where possible, the members ask the government whether the proposed amendment may be unnecessary.
Met het oog op de eigen ambitie om regeldruk waar mogelijk te verminderen vragen de leden de regering of de voorgestelde wetswijziging wellicht overbodig is.

32422.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2008/122/EC on timeshare, long-term holiday products, resale and exchange contracts by inserting a new title 1A into Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code. It adds consumer protections such as information duties, written contracts, a fourteen-day cancellation right and a ban on advance payments, and amends the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act and the Financial Supervision Act accordingly.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz.

parties: Asks which deviations from the directive are made and how products not covered by the directive, such as hotel timeshare, will be handled.
They consider it important that consumers are protected as well as possible and informed as completely as possible.
Zij vinden het van belang dat consumenten zo goed mogelijk worden beschermd en zo volledig mogelijk worden geïnformeerd.
Welcomes harmonisation but asks whether non-compliance can lead to nullity or annulment of contracts by the courts and how cross-border enforcement by foreign authorities works.
Can non-compliance with such obligations also lead to nullity of the contract or give the consumer grounds to have the contract annulled by the court?
Kan het niet naleven van dergelijke verplichtingen ook leiden tot nietigheid van de overeenkomst of de consument een grondslag leveren om de overeenkomst door de rechter te laten vernietigen?
Worries that full harmonisation removes the possibility of giving consumers further protection in future and that information duties increase costs for business.
They have serious concerns about this starting point.
Zij maken zich ernstig zorgen over dit uitgangspunt.

Asks about the enforcement division between the Consumentenautoriteit and the Autoriteit Financiële Markten, the planned evaluation, and whether consumers can oversee consequences of contract terms and burden of proof.

Can the government elaborate on the proposal in the explanatory memorandum to enforce open norms under civil law and closed norms under administrative law, in line with the current Consumer Protection Enforcement Act?

Kan de regering nader ingaan op het voorstel dat in de memorie van toelichting wordt genoemd, om overeenkomstig de huidige systematiek van de Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, open normen civielrechtelijk en gesloten normen bestuursrechtelijk te handhaven?
Endorses the starting point of the bill and has no questions.
They endorse the starting point of the bill and currently have no questions.
Zij onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van het wetsvoorstel en hebben op dit moment geen vragen.

32431.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the 2009 Framework Agreement on a broad partnership and cooperation between the European Community and its Member States and the Republic of Indonesia. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Is approved for the Netherlands.
Wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Raises concern about military human rights abuses, judicial corruption and weakening of Indonesia's anti-corruption commission, asking how the agreement will address these.
They also express concern about a weakening of the position of Indonesia's anti-corruption commission resulting from legislation passed by the Indonesian parliament.
Daarbij spreken zij ook hun zorg uit over een verzwakking van de positie van de anticorruptie-commissie in Indonesië die het gevolg zou zijn van wetgeving door het Indonesische parlement.
Asks whether Indonesia's human rights situation justifies the partnership and whether human rights violations could lead to suspension.
Is the government of the opinion that Indonesia sufficiently respects fundamental human rights?
Is de regering van mening dat Indonesië in voldoende mate de fundamentele rechten van de mens in acht neemt?
Raises concerns about religious freedom, freedom of expression and the refusal of entry to a democratically elected PVV member.
Nevertheless, Indonesia refuses entry to the PVV party chairman, a democratically elected member of parliament.
Desalniettemin weigert Indonesië de toegang van de partijvoorzitter van de PVV, een democratisch gekozen parlementslid.
Asks how the human rights provisions will work in practice, the protection of Christians and religious minorities, and the commitments on disarmament treaties.
The question remains, however, what these provisions will mean in practice.
Vraag blijft echter wel wat deze bepalingen in de praktijk zullen betekenen.
Raises concern about slow democratic progress, the death penalty, unclear suspension criteria and the joint committee's undefined procedures.
It remains unclear what the assessment criteria are.
Onduidelijk blijft wat de criteria van beoordeling zijn.

32440.s: The bill re-implements EU procurement directives 2004/17/EG and 2004/18/EG into Dutch law, setting rules on equal treatment, transparency, proportionality, value estimation, procedures, and exclusion/qualification criteria for public contracts. It also introduces a uniform self-declaration, a conduct declaration (gedragsverklaring aanbesteden), and delegation to lower-level regulation for technical details and procedural forms.
32440.j: The memorandum justifies delegation for technical detail that must track changing European Commission decisions and forms, and for evaluation-based uniformity rules, with a binding consultation of parliament via voorhang.
d: erkenningsregeling (recognition scheme) for technical procedural rules
procedural rules for uniform tendering if evaluation shows insufficient uniformity
information and models for the uniform self-declaration (eigen verklaring)
additional criminal offences designated as relevant for conduct declaration
exemption of certain activities from special-sector rules, linked to European Commission decisions
p: Allows designation by general order of additional criminal offences that can trigger exclusion from tenders, widening executive discretion over who may be excluded.

parties: Asks questions on the bill's aims of transparent, effective procurement and welcomes a clear uniform framework without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members support the government's intention to provide a clear and uniform framework for procurement.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven de intentie van de regering om een duidelijk en eenvormig kader te bieden voor aanbesteden.

Questions whether the bill achieves uniform rules and asks how effective countervailing power can be created against the contracting authority's dominant position, noting municipal councils are too distant from procurement.
Does the government agree that in this case it cannot be the municipal council, which in practice is too far removed from the procurement process?
Deelt de regering de mening dat dit in dit geval niet de gemeenteraad kan zijn, die in de praktijk te ver afstaat van het aanbestedingsproces?
Argues the bill merely codifies existing case law and EU rules, adding little value and not solving the problems identified by the Raad van State.
In the view of these members, the Aanbestedingswet 20.. bill is also worse than the existing legislation.
Naar het oordeel van deze leden is ook het wetvoorstel Aanbestedingswet 20.. slechter dan de bestaande wetgeving.
Not yet convinced the bill provides sufficient instruments and safeguards for compliance with procurement obligations, and asks how the government will professionalise contracting authorities.
These members ask whether this additional legislation will create more safeguards for compliance with procurement obligations.
Deze leden vragen of met deze extra wetgeving meer waarborgen worden gecreëerd voor naleving van aanbestedingsverplichtingen.
Supports the goal but doubts the bill brings it closer; stresses protection of employees' rights and working conditions when concessions change hands.
These members urge that this bill also pay attention to the position of personnel.
Deze leden dringen aan dat ook in dit wetsvoorstel aandacht wordt besteed aan de positie van het personeel.
Worries that non-binding handreikingen and richtsnoeren for sub-threshold procurement will not ensure compliance; asks for a two-year evaluation and possibly binding rules.
The D66 members request the government to carry out an evaluation after two years instead of the four years proposed in article 4.27.
De leden van de D66-fractie verzoeken de regering een evaluatie te doen plaatsvinden na twee jaar in plaats van de vier jaar zoals voorgesteld in artikel 4.27.
Asks whether a supervisor or enforcement body has been considered for sub-threshold rules and whether oversight of compliance is adequate.
Has the desirability of a supervisor been examined for the rules below the European thresholds?
Is de wenselijkheid van een toezichthouder onderzocht voor de regelgeving onder de Europese drempels?
Asks for the government's underlying vision on market ordering, and notes the Raad van State criticised the lack of analysis of how the bill balances interests.
The Council of State indicates that it lacks an analysis of how the bill balances the various objectives and interests of the parties involved.
De Raad van State geeft aan dat zij een analyse mist van de wijze waarop het wetsvoorstel de verschillende doelstellingen en belangen van betrokken partijen met elkaar in evenwicht brengt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Aanbestedingswet, supporting its aim but objecting that it fails to show how compliance with EU-dimension tender obligations will improve and lacks a market analysis justifying mandatory principles for below-threshold contracts without EU dimension. The government's nader rapport adds analysis of compliance causes, extends the evaluation provision, and makes several textual changes, while not adopting a dwingend procedural framework for below-threshold contracts.
concerns: The Raad finds no adequate analysis of why non-compliance with EU procurement rules occurs and how the proposal will improve it; the government adds a new paragraph 3.7 on causes and drivers.

The Raad finds no market analysis justifying mandatory spontaneous harmonisation of below-threshold contracts without EU dimension, and notes the single-tender option escapes the open-competition goal; the government keeps the choice, citing a balance of interests.
The Raad asks that the terms aanbestedende dienst and speciale-sectorbedrijf be aligned with the Wira definition; the government changes the terminology accordingly.
The Raad asks that the scope of the uniform eigen verklaring information obligation be made explicit so it does not imply additional documents; the government clarifies the wording and delegation.
The Raad asks that the evaluation provision cover all public contracts, not only those outside EU directives; the government adds a new article 4.28 for a four-year evaluation of compliance.
The Raad lists numerous redactional points, including updating treaty references and adjusting scope provisions; the government reports these were followed.

32500-V.s: This bill fixes the 2011 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, covering commitments, expenditure and receipts by policy article, and the 2011 budget of the agency CBI in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January of the budget year, or the day after publication if published later, with retroactive effect to 1 January.
32500-V.j: The memorandum explains the budget's relation to the HGIS policy framework and the end of the budget-reform experiment, and does not justify any new delegation or power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2011, attached to this law, is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32512.s: The bill gives the supervisory board of Dutch public limited companies, and the body setting pay at financial undertakings, explicit power to reduce bonuses to a reasonable level and to reclaim paid bonuses based on incorrect information. It also requires adjustment of bonuses that become unconditional in a public bid and requires financial undertakings' supervisory bodies to contain persons with verified expertise.
32512.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as clarifying existing legal possibilities and strengthening the supervisory board's position in response to excessive bonuses during the financial crisis.
q: The bill clarifies existing legal possibilities and gives supervisory boards more guidance in exercising their powers over directors' pay.
Het wetsvoorstel verduidelijkt reeds bestaande wettelijke mogelijkheden en geeft raden van commissarissen meer houvast bij het uitoefenen van hun bevoegdheden inzake de bezoldiging van bestuurders.
p: Gives the supervisory or pay-setting body discretion to reduce bonuses and to reclaim them, bounded by a reasonableness standard and annual reporting duty.
Extends the bonus adjustment and reclaim powers to all day-to-day policymakers at financial undertakings, assigned to whoever sets their pay.
Artikel II B and C (art. 3:8, 4:9 Wft)
Requires that persons supervising policy at financial undertakings be expert, with the content set by supervisors' policy rules.

parties: Asks whether the new claw back rules are needed before experience with the Code and the monitoring report, whether they create overlap with article 6:248 BW, and what remedies the director has in court.
Why is the monitoring report of the monitoring committee on the new code provisions, due in December 2011, not awaited before deciding on this?
Waarom wordt niet eerst het monitoringrapport van de monitoringcommissie over de nieuwe codebepalingen, welke verschijnt in december 2011, afgewacht alvorens daarover te besluiten?
Regrets that the Tang/Irrgang amendment was dropped and argues that the change-of-control rule is proportionate and not contrary to human rights law.
They remain of the view that the Tang/Irrgang amendment would clearly and objectively prevent directors and shareholders from deciding on a merger or takeover because of personal financial interest.

Zij blijven van mening dat met het amendement Tang/Irrgang ( 31 058, nr. 24 ) op een eenduidige en objectieve wijze voorkomen kan worden dat bestuurders/aandeelhouders vanwege een financieel eigenbelang zullen besluiten tot een fusie of overname.
Supports the claw back as a step against excessive pay, asks about international alignment, the scope for small firms, and the expertise test for supervisory board members by DNB and AFM.
It is good that further initiatives are now being taken with the claw back to limit the possibility of excessive remuneration policy.
Het is goed dat er met de claw back nu verdere initiatieven worden genomen om de mogelijkheid tot een excessief beloningsbeleid te beperken.

Objects to the government dropping an amendment adopted by the Tweede Kamer without consultation, asks which bonuses fall under the rule, and argues the replacement rule does not remove the director's personal financial interest in a takeover.
Supports the aim of the bill and sees no reason for comments at this stage.
These members endorse the objective of the bill.
Deze leden onderschrijven de doel stelling van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State broadly supports the bills on clawback and reasonableness review of executive bonuses in Boek 2 BW and the Wft, but raises concerns about the international and national context, the concretisation of the reasonableness standard, exclusion of pension funds, fitness testing of supervisory board members, and integration of the two bills, advising integration. The government's reply accepts integration into a single bill, adds context and explanation, and largely adopts the Council's suggestions while declining to extend the bill to pension funds.
concerns: The bills overlap and differ in scope and terminology (bonus vs variable remuneration), creating unclear application and staggered entry into force; the Council advised integrating them into one bill, which the government did.

The Council asked for clarification of the reasonableness and fairness standards and their international dimension; the government added explanation that they are Dutch standards taking international context into account.

The Council questioned why legislation is needed now rather than relying on the Corporate Governance Code's comply-or-explain principle; the government justified statutory intervention but did not fundamentally change course.

The Council asked for attention to the international context and EU initiatives and to competitiveness effects; the government added references to the EU capital requirements directive and competitiveness considerations.
The Council asked that pension funds be addressed or included; the government explained why they are excluded given their governance structure and declined to extend the bill.

The Council asked that the expertise requirements for supervisory board members be explained more clearly and that the board as a whole be assessable; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

32521.s: The bill creates a Wet mogelijkheid koopkrachttegemoetkoming oudere belastingplichtigen, letting the SVB pay older taxpayers a compensation for loss of purchasing power caused by policy measures, with amounts and rules set by general administrative order. It also sets rules on recovery, debt settlement, penalties and consequential amendments to other social security laws.
32521.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the amount-setting delegation by saying an annual decision on whether compensation is desirable is needed, and that the rules for non-resident taxpayers are complex and better regulated by decree.
q: This bill provides a scheme that makes it possible to regulate by general administrative order (amvb) a compensation for domestic loss of purchasing power resulting from fiscal policy measures.

Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in een regeling die de mogelijkheid biedt om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) een tegemoetkoming te regelen ter compensatie van binnenlands koopkrachtverlies als gevolg van fiscale beleidsmaatregelen
d: amount, payment and determination of entitlement for non-residents
amount below which recovery is waived
rules on participation in debt settlements
calculation of the SVB payment and required data
p: The amount and eligibility rules of the compensation are left to a general administrative order rather than the statute itself, letting the government decide the size of the payment each year.
The SVB may waive recovery of undue payments on discretionary grounds, and the amount threshold is set by the minister.
Decisions under the act are made open to objection and appeal under the general tax law procedure, strengthening legal protection.

parties: Asks how the government addressed the Raad van State's fundamental objections and the risk that the scheme falls outside EU Regulation 883/2004, which would undermine the savings.
Great interest goes out to the question of what the government has done with the fundamental objections of the Raad van State.
Grote belangstelling gaat uit naar de vraag wat de regering gedaan heeft met de fundamentele bezwaren van de Raad van State.
Asks whether the government had the bill tested by the EU Court of Justice, given it ignores the Raad van State and settled case law.
The government in many cases disregards the Council's comments and also established case law of the Court of Justice of the European Union.
De regering gaat in veel gevallen voorbij aan het commentaar van de Raad en tevens aan vaste rechtspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie (HvJ EU).
Supports compensation in principle but questions the generic character the Raad van State criticised and the tension with fiscal policy itself.
It places question marks at the generic character of the law.(Raad van State)
Zij plaatst vraagtekens bij het generieke karakter van de wet.
Asks whether the government may discretionarily decide not to pay the allowance in a given year and on what grounds, and how annual adjustments are decided and communicated to the Chamber.
Is it conceivable that the government decides not to pay a koopkracht allowance to older taxpayers for one year?
Is het denkbaar dat de regering besluit om een jaar geen koopkrachttegemoetkoming uit te keren aan oudere belastingplichtigen?
Takes the Raad van State's serious criticism seriously, asks whether the bill was reconsidered, and asks whether individual discretionary assessment is involved and the EU-law risk.
They note that the advice of the Raad van State concludes with the fifth dictum.
Zij constateren dat het advies van de Raad van State wordt afgesloten met het vijfde dictum.
Asks why the government expects the EU Court would not treat the allowance as social security, and on what criteria the amount is set and how non-transferability is protected.
want a further explanation of why the government expects the EU Court of Justice will not regard the allowance as a social security benefit

willen van de regering een nadere toelichting ontvangen waarom de regering verwacht dat het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie de tegemoetkoming niet als een sociale zekerheidsuitkering zal beschouwen

v.summary: The Council of State advised against the bill introducing an income allowance for older resident taxpayers, objecting to its open-ended delegation, generic design, unclear EU/export status and implementation risks, and advised reconsidering its form. The government's reply accepted the criteria-based redesign of article 3, the fiscal court route for appeals, and the cost clarifications, but largely kept the generic design and the 90% rule for non-residents.
concerns: Article 3 grants a very open right to an allowance and leaves its full design to an AMvB; the government redrafted article 3 so the right arises by statute and the amount is set by AMvB, with explanatory clarification.

The generic allowance for all older taxpayers regardless of income is costly and unjustified by its purpose; the government considered an income-dependent scheme but rejected it on administrative costs and kept the generic design.

The allowance may be a social security benefit under Regulation 883/2004 so the non-exportability aim is doubtful; the government argued it is a purchasing-power facility tied to Dutch taxation and maintained its position.

Payment without decision, reliance on SVB versus tax data, and the 90% worldwide-income test for non-residents raise implementation problems; the government reworked article 4 and added an AMvB-based proof requirement.
Absence of an article-by-article explanation and unclear legal protection; the government moved appeals to the fiscal court with cassation before the Hoge Raad.
Implementation and appeal costs were not charted; the government added a cost estimate to the explanatory memorandum.

32701.s: The bill repeals the Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars (WWIK), the special social assistance scheme for artists, effective 1 January 2012, and makes conforming amendments to numerous related laws. Artists would then rely on the general WWB or WIJ safety-net schemes like other workers and entrepreneurs.
32701.j: The memorandum justifies repeal by arguing that artists should not have a special benefit regime compared with other occupational groups, and that the state's finances require prioritisation.
q: In the government's view, it is not appropriate for artists with a specific benefit scheme to be subject to different rules than other entrepreneurs and/or employees.
Naar het oordeel van de regering past het niet dat er voor kunstenaars met een specifieke uitkeringsregeling andere regels gelden dan voor overige ondernemers en/of werknemers.

parties: Supports uniform social security rules but asks whether other occupational groups also have separate regimes and how the financial effects are based.

For the VVD members it is important that uniform rules apply in social security and that no exceptional positions are taken by special groups of entrepreneurs or employees based on their occupation or field.

Voor de leden van de VVD-fractie is van belang dat er uniforme regels gelden in de sociale zekerheid en dat er geen uitzonderingsposities worden ingenomen door bijzondere groepen ondernemers of werknemers naar aard van de beroepsgroep of vakgebied.

Regrets the abolition of a successful scheme and questions the government's assumptions on the leakage to other benefits, the number of benefits and implementation costs, and the transitional arrangements.
The PvdA members have noted with disappointment the government's proposal to withdraw the WWIK.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met teleurstelling kennis genomen van het voorstel van de regering om de WWIK in te trekken.
Accepts abolition for equal treatment but asks for confirmation that no acquired rights are removed in breach of the European Charter and asks for the expected savings in figures.
Is the government certain that there is no conflict with the European Charter, since the bill could be read as abolishing already acquired rights?
Is de regering er zeker van dat hier geen sprake is van strijd met het Europees Handvest, omdat in het wetsvoorstel gelezen zou kunnen worden dat reeds verworven rechten worden afgeschaft?

Strongly opposes the abolition and asks detailed questions on income effects, the cost estimates, the basis of the 65% leakage figure, and the reasons for disregarding advice from social organisations.
The SP members have noted with disapproval the government's plan to withdraw the WWIK.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van het plan van de regering om de WWIK in te trekken.
Asks how much discretion municipalities have to apply work obligations to making and selling artworks and compares implementation costs with other safety-net schemes.
The members are curious to what extent the municipality has the freedom to subject the making and selling of artworks to these obligations.
De leden zijn benieuwd in hoeverre de gemeente vrijheid heeft om het maken en verkopen van kunstwerken te laten vallen onder deze verplichtingen?
Agrees with the rationale for abolition but seeks clarity on the leakage estimate, the risk of higher leakage, the margin in the budget, and the discrepancy with VNG's cost expectations.
These members share the government's argument for withdrawing the WWIK because of the inappropriate exceptional position it gives artists in social security.
Deze leden delen de argumentatie van de regering tot intrekking van de WWIK op grond van de niet passende uitzonderingspositie die de WWIK in de sociale zekerheid aan kunstenaars biedt.
Questions the government's arbitrary 65% leakage estimate and the cumulative cultural cuts, and asks for better justification and current figures before withdrawing the scheme.
Therefore, according to these members, the 65% leakage effect from WWIK to social assistance is entirely arbitrary.
Daarmee is volgens deze leden het weglekeffect van 65% van WWIK naar de bijstand volstrekt arbitrair.
Supports the measures regarding the withdrawal of the WWIK without raising further points.
The members support the measures regarding the Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars.
De leden staan achter de maatregelen met betrekking tot de Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars.
Welcomes the government's reply that support programmes continue and asks whether starting artists can use microcredit.
They note with satisfaction that the successful support of artists, guided through courses and training to develop as entrepreneurs, can simply continue.
Zij stellen met genoegen vast dat de succesvolle ondersteuning van kunstenaars, die met cursussen en trainingen worden begeleid om zich als ondernemer te ontwikkelen gewoon door kan gaan.
Challenges the government's claims about artists' ability to earn a living and its basis for concluding the scheme is unnecessary, and asks for a recalculation based on current figures.
On what does the government base its conclusion that 'the artist can often build a professional practice on their own strength' and 'artists are often able to work'?
Waarop baseert de regering de conclusie dat «de kunstenaar veelal op eigen kracht een beroepspraktijk als kunstenaar kan opbouwen» en «kunstenaars veelal in staat zijn te werken»?
Asks how large the risk is that leakage exceeds 65% and what that means for the thin margin in the expected budget savings, and why calculations use 2009 rather than current figures.
In addition, the ChristenUnie members want to know why the government bases the savings calculation on the average number of WWIK benefits in 2009 rather than on more current figures.

Daarnaast willen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie weten waarom de regering de berekening van de bezuiniging baseert op het gemiddeld aantal WWIK uitkeringen van 2009 en niet op basis van actuelere cijfers.

The PvdA questions the government's refusal of transitional law and the absence of a cost-benefit and effects analysis before abolishing an effective scheme, and asks about legal consequences of not respecting existing rights.
The members therefore want the government to give insight into the consequences of its choice for immediate repeal.
De leden willen derhalve inzicht krijgen van de regering in de gevolgen van haar keuze voor directe intrekking.

The SP challenges the government's savings calculation, which assumes 65% benefit leakage over 2,300 benefits while 3,200 WWIK benefits are currently paid, and asks about the consequences for the advisory body Cultuur-Ondernemen.
The calculation of the alleged saving is based on a leakage effect of 65% over 2,300 benefits.
De berekening van de vermeende bezuiniging wordt gebaseerd op een weglekeffect van 65% over 2300 uitkeringen.

32710-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the States General (Parliament) by adjusting the budget lines for the First and Second Chamber, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment legally binding through the Slotwet procedure.
q: The underspending on both expenditure and commitments results from temporarily leaving vacancies unfilled and savings on the project 'live broadcasting of plenary debates'.
De onderuitputting op zowel uitgaven als verplichtingen is het gevolg van het tijdelijk niet vervullen van vacatures en besparingen op het project «Live uitzenden van plenaire debatten».

33007.s: The bill amends the income tax, wage tax, car tax, excise and environmental tax laws to reshape the fiscal treatment of cars, notably tightening CO2-based reductions on the company car addition and car taxes, and ending the exemption for very efficient cars. It introduces a sworn declaration for exclusive business use of vans, with tax-authority checks, and sets a multi-year tariff path for car and fuel taxes, with many details left to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
33007.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to set detailed operational rules for declarations, checks and refunds that will be adjusted in practice.
q: Compliance with that declaration is checked through ambulatory supervision.
Controle op de naleving van die verklaring geschiedt met behulp van ambulant toezicht.
d: Artikel I A, onderdeel 2 and 3 (art. 3.20 lid 12, 15 Wet IB 2001)
withdrawal of exclusive business-use declaration for vans
Artikel I A, onderdeel 3 (art. 3.20 lid 20 Wet IB 2001)
rules for cars with differing first registration dates
when employee must withdraw van declaration; how declarations are issued and confirmed
Artikel XXIV C (art. 71h lid 7, 8 Wet op de accijns)
conditions and restrictions on excise refund for biofuels
Artikel XXIV C (art. 71h lid 8 Wet op de accijns)
detailed rules implementing biofuel excise refund
Artikel XIII B (art. 15 lid 6 Wet OB 1968)
possible further rules on private use of business cars for VAT
p: Tax inspector may presume a private trip and shift the burden of proof to the taxpayer, deeming 500+ km of private use if proof fails.
Inspector may presume private use and recover tax from employee or employer, reversing the burden of proof in a manner that bypasses ordinary assessment rules.
Inspector may by binding decision deem a declaration withdrawn, with the amvb setting the cases in which withdrawal is required.

parties: Asks whether a fixed CO2 threshold in the BPM remains sustainable under technological change and whether periodic review is possible; also flags stacking of fiscal benefits for hybrids.
Can the government explain why it did not choose a flexible threshold under which only the X% most fuel-efficient cars qualify for the BPM exemption?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom niet is gekozen voor een flexibele grens waarbij bijvoorbeeld alleen de X% zuinigste auto’s in aanmerking komt voor BPM-vrijstelling?
Asks the government to make transparent how much of the lower revenue stems from fewer sales versus cleaner cars, and questions the revenue assumptions and fraud safeguards for private car use.
The PvdA members ask the government to make transparent what part of the lower revenue is caused by lower car sales and what part by more fuel-efficient cars.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering feitelijk inzichtelijk te maken welk gedeelte van de lagere opbrengst is veroorzaakt door lagere autoverkopen en welk gedeelte is veroorzaakt door zuinigere auto’s.
Opposes fiscal instrumentalisation and stacking of tax instruments, preferring a single instrument such as the BPM over multiple fiscal interventions.
The car tax bill implementation is a textbook example of using the fiscal system to steer societal developments.}
De wet uitwerking autobrief is een schoolvoorbeeld van het gebruik van het fiscale stelsel om maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen te sturen.
Asks about the treatment of green gas and pure plant oil under energy tax and excise, and how the Tax Authority will assess below-market private-use payments.
What will the government do to keep green gas fiscally attractive?
Wat gaat de regering doen om groen gas ook fiscaal aantrekkelijk te blijven zijn?
Asks why leased cars receive a five-year fixed benefit regime unlike private buyers and asks about revenue lost through this exception.
Why does the reduced benefit for lease cars run for 60 months while BPM efficiency thresholds decline each year?
Waarom geldt er voor de verlaagde bijtelling van de leaseauto's wel een periode van 60 maanden en gaan de zuinigheidsgrenzen in de BPM per jaar omlaag?
Criticises insufficient BPM progressivity and the revenue target of 2.1 billion, and asks for a fiscal green gas stimulus and continued protection for green gas.
The government's intention to set rates so BPM revenue is about 2.1 billion euros cannot count on the approval of the D66 members.
Het voornemen van de regering om de tarieven zo vast te stellen dat de BPM-opbrengsten naar schatting € 2,1 miljard zijn, kan niet op instemming van de leden van de D66-fractie rekenen.
Disappointed by the absence of a structural green tax vision and pay-per-use; questions freezing 2011 BPM revenue and asks for quantified CO2 effects.
The members of this faction are disappointed that a structural vision for greening car taxes is absent and that a gradual shift to pay-per-use is left out of consideration.

De leden van deze fractie zijn teleurgesteld dat een structurele visie op vergroening van de autobelastingen ontbreekt en dat een geleidelijke overstap op betalen naar gebruik buiten beschouwing blijft.
Asks why BPM revenue falls sharply and what the CO2 consequences are, and asks about the impact of the new fourth bracket on minibuses and green gas from manure.
Can the government state the decisive reason for structuring the new BPM system so that it results in a sharp fall in BPM revenue?
Kan de regering aangeven wat de doorslaggevende reden is om het nieuwe BPM-systeem zodanig in te richten dat het gevolg een forse daling van de BPM-inkomsten is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the car tax reform bill but raises concerns about accumulation of car measures, the sunset clause for the zero car benefit, and retroactive VAT on private car use from 1 July 2011. The government's reply accepts or partly accepts most points, adjusting the explanatory memorandum and the sunset horizon while defending the retroactivity and flat-rate arrangements.
concerns: Flat-rate VAT arrangements (2.7%) are set by policy decision rather than in statute, which the Council says cannot cover essential elements of taxation; the government will keep the flat rate but plans to include it in law once the EU approves.
Flat-rate VAT arrangements may conflict with the VAT Directive without EU approval; the government says talks with the Commission are ongoing and it will keep the flat rate.
Retroactive effect of the VAT measure from 1 July 2011 may increase tax burdens and requires substantive justification; the government added a fuller justification in the memorandum.
The objective and expected effectiveness of the zero car benefit were not stated; the government clarified the aim of stimulating breakthrough technologies and planned an evaluation.
The sunset clause for the zero car benefit was described inconsistently as five years; the government confirmed a four-year horizon and corrected the explanatory memorandum.
Transition from the old to the new VAT regime for company cars is unclear in practice; the government explained the transitional rule for Article 5a of the implementing decree.

Accumulation of car-related fiscal measures risks eroding public support and creates administrative burden; the government defended the simplified benefit scheme but did not fully accept the call to fundamentally revisit the environmental goals.

33025.s: The bill merges the Dutch chartered accountants' registry body (NIVRA) and the accountants-administration consultants' body (NOvAA) into a single public-law Dutch professional organisation of accountants, replacing the two existing Acts and consolidating registration, discipline and training rules. It also restructures accountant titles so that only RAs may perform statutory controls at organisations of public interest, and sets out governance, bylaw-making, ministerial approval and oversight of the new organisation.
33025.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to the professional organisation by the value of self-regulation and sector expertise, with ministerial oversight to guard against conflicts of interest.
q: A public-law professional organisation provides a uniform standard for accountants, which promotes recognisability and reliability in social dealings.
Een publiekrechtelijke beroepsorganisatie zorgt voor een eenduidige standaard voor accountants, hetgeen de herkenbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid in het maatschappelijk verkeer bevordert.
d: bylaws (verordeningen) of the professional organisation on conduct rules, complaints, finances, training
delegation of detailed rules (nadere voorschriften) to the board
subject areas of the accountant training
further rules on the accountants register
data to be supplied with registration application
rules on the examination for declaration of professional competence
p: Minister of Finance must approve certain bylaws and rules, and may withhold approval only where they conflict with law or the public interest.
Royal decree may annul decisions of the professional organisation, a form of executive oversight over a body of the profession.
The organisation may share confidential information with the AFM, market bodies, the disciplinary chamber and the appeals court, departing from the general confidentiality rule.

parties: Asks whether the minister's approval powers over bylaws could affect the democratic functioning of the professional body and how individual members can table proposals.
These members ask whether this power affects the freedom of an individual member to place a draft bylaw on the members' meeting agenda.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of deze bevoegdheid invloed heeft op de vrijheid van een individueel lid om een ontwerpverordening te agenderen op de ledenvergadering?
Welcomes clarity in the bill but says the real debate on the future of accountancy should be separated from it; focuses on titles and government accountant representation.
These members see it as positive that some points are clarified, but feel the real discussion about the future of accountancy should be separate from this bill.

Deze leden ervaren het als positief dat er op een aantal punten helderheid wordt geschept, maar vinden wel dat de echte discussie over de toekomst van de accountancy los moet staan van dit wetsvoorstel.
Supports the merger but raises concerns about compulsory membership and monopoly under European human rights law (ECHR art. 11) and the democratic character of the body.
Secondly, the OvRAN states that complaints have been filed in Strasbourg on these matters on the basis that accountancy does not fall under the exceptions of article 11(2) of the ECHR.

Ten tweede stelt de OvRAN dat ten aanzien van voormelde onderwerpen in Straatsburg klachten zijn ingediend met als uitgangspunt dat accountancy niet valt onder de uitzonderingen van artikel 11, tweede lid, van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM).
Supports the merger and stresses public interest in reliable audits; asks about the involvement of government and the adequacy of existing supervision of the profession.
In the explanatory memorandum, the CDA members read that nevertheless two forms of supervision exist.
In de memorie van toelichting lezen de leden van de CDA-fractie dat er niettemin twee vormen van toezicht bestaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Wet op het accountantsberoep merging NIVRA and NOvAA into one professional body, but raises remarks on the hybrid board composition, ministerial supervision of by-laws, use of separate accountant titles, sharing of confidential data, the registration decision procedure and several disciplinary-procedure changes. The minister's reply (nader rapport) accepts most remarks, amending the bill on board majority, by-law approval grounds, confidential data, anonymisation, the single-judge fine ceiling and provisional enforceability with appeal rights, while defending the title proposal and the reference to EU diplomas.
concerns: Board composition with delegates from member groups needs a clearer balance; minister adopted majority of members elected by the members' assembly.
The 'without instruction or consultation' voting rule was outdated and has been adjusted to 'without instruction' only.
Ministerial power to refuse approval of by-laws on inadequate quality is too vague; criterion dropped.
A separate non-statutory accountant title needs justification; minister explains title protection rationale but defers the decision.
Sharing confidential data with other bodies must be limited to what is necessary for their legal tasks; bill amended.
Registration decision deadline of four weeks conflicts with the public preparation procedure; deadline extended to eight weeks.
Naming complainants, witnesses and experts in disciplinary decisions requires separate justification; they are now anonymised and only the accused may be named where proportionate.
Expanding the chair's power to decide complaints without hearing to fines up to EUR 7,500 needs stronger motivation; minister keeps the increase, citing the verzet remedy.

Provisional enforceability of disciplinary sanctions needs justification weighed against the accountant's interests; minister motivates it and adds a suspension possibility, citing comparable rules for doctors.
Exclusion of appeal against provisional enforceability declaration is unexplained; appeal to the College van Beroep allowed with suspension on request.
Various drafting and cross-reference corrections in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

33061.s: The bill amends Book 1 of the Dutch Civil Code and related laws to replace the concepts of ontzetting and ontheffing of parental authority and guardianship with a unified termination of authority (beëindiging van het gezag), adjusts child protection procedures including the new maatregel van opgroeiondersteuning and a dispute regime, and repeals the Pleegkinderenwet while transferring its investigation power to the Raad voor de kinderbescherming. It also contains transitional rules and conforming amendments to several other statutes.
33061.j: The memorandum justifies the new investigation power and measures by reference to Raad van State advice, the need to protect children placed outside official channels, and procedural economy.
q: The seventh paragraph incorporates the Pleegkinderenwet power to investigate where there is a reasonable suspicion that a minor has been placed in the household in violation of a statutory provision.

In het zevende lid is de bevoegdheid uit de Pleegkinderenwet opgenomen om onderzoek te doen indien het redelijke vermoeden bestaat dat een minderjarige in strijd met een wettelijk voorschrift in het gezin is geplaatst.
d: entry into force by royal decree, possibly different per article
p: Gives the Raad voor de kinderbescherming power to investigate family situations of children placed with others on a reasonable suspicion of violating a legal provision, broadening the earlier formulation.
Allows the kinderrechter to impose a maatregel van opgroeiondersteuning ex officio instead of suspending guardianship, expanding the range of child protection measures available.
III, A and C (art. 807 and 810a Rv)
Excludes appeal against kinderrechter decisions on disputes over execution of supervision orders, while giving parents a right to request an expert appointment in opgroeiondersteuning procedures.
Transitional rules apply the new law immediately to existing supervision orders and authority terminations, with pending cases decided under old law.

parties: Asks whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming will still be able to start an investigation when needed after the reporting duty is removed, and whether parents who cannot fulfil a caring role should still control the child's assets.
To what extent can children then still claim their benefit?
In hoeverre kunnen kinderen dan nog aanspraak maken op hun uitkering?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, in March 2011, that the reporting obligation for foster and adoptive parents (title 15A BW, taken from the Pleegkinderenwet) should be dropped because it adds no real value next to the GBA reporting duty and the Wet opneming buitenlandse kinderen ter adoptie, and that the rest should be clarified. The government's reply of October 2011 follows the advice fully: the reporting obligation and its criminal sanction are removed, a general investigation ground is added to article 1:241 BW, and the redactional remark is not followed only because the title falls away.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted the reporting obligation's substantive importance and its practical enforcement, and advised dropping it in favour of existing GBA and adoption-law procedures.
The vague notion of when a foster child is cared for with sufficient permanence makes the criminal reporting duty unclear, contrary to the legality principle.
The adoption-related reporting duty should be placed in the Wet opneming buitenlandse kinderen ter adoptie rather than the BW, and the unclear reference to 'bestaande procedures' should be explained.
Redactional remark to renumber title 15A as 14A; not followed because the title is removed entirely.

33115.s: The bill introduces a levy called the opslag duurzame energie on natural gas and electricity consumption, collected by the Tax Authority, to finance the stimulation of renewable energy production. It largely mirrors the energy tax rules, with set tariffs for 2013 to 2015 and degressive rates by consumption band.
33115.j: The memorandum justifies mirroring the energy tax structure through the horizontal excise directive and the goal of keeping collection costs low, not through any new executive power.
q: To keep these costs as low as possible, the renewable energy levy follows the energy tax in all respects regarding levy and collection.
Om deze kosten zo laag mogelijk te houden volgt de opslag duurzame energie de energiebelasting qua heffing en invordering in alle opzichten.

parties: Asks about cost-effectiveness, possible consumer purchasing-power loss, and effects on international competitiveness and the European level playing field.
For the VVD members it is important that energy costs for citizens and businesses are kept in view.
Voor de leden van de VVD-fractie is het van belang dat de energiekosten voor burgers en bedrijfsleven in het oog worden gehouden.
Asks whether the non-binding change to the explanatory memorandum adequately secures that levy proceeds are used only for renewable energy, and questions the evaluation timing and investor certainty.
The PvdA members ask whether this change adequately guarantees that the proceeds of the levy are used only for stimulating renewable energy as agreed in the coalition agreement.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of met deze wijziging afdoende wordt geborgd dat de opbrengst van de opslag alleen gebruikt wordt voor stimulering van duurzame energie zoals ook in het regeerakkoord is afgesproken.

Argues the levy is in substance a tax increase under another label, that a separate tax conflicts with the government's simplification agenda, and criticises the Council of State's role in tax-quality oversight.
Does the government agree with the PVV members that introducing the renewable energy levy actually amounts to an increase in the normal energy tax, just under a different label or flag?

Is de regering het met de leden van de PVV-fractie eens dat de invoering van de opslag duurzame energie eigenlijk neerkomt op een verhoging van de normale energiebelasting, alleen onder een andere noemer of vlaggetje?
Generally supports the SDE+ and the separate levy for transparency, but asks that the purpose be defined more narrowly and that the EU Commission's possible questions not delay legislation.
The CDA members believe the earmarked purpose should be formulated more narrowly; 'stimulating the production of renewable energy' is currently too broad.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat de bestemming nauwer geformuleerd moet worden, «stimuleren van de productie van duurzame energie» is nu te breed geformuleerd.
Doubts the problem being solved and the transparency rationale, objects to the regressive burden distribution, and asks for detailed impact calculations; withholds support for now.
In addition, the members find the regressive distribution of burdens resulting from the design modelled on the energy tax intrinsically wrong.
Daarnaast vinden de leden de regressieve verdeling van de lasten die volgt uit de vormgeving naar model van de energiebelasting intrinsiek onjuist.

Says the proposal is insufficient to meet the 14% EU target, criticises the degressive tariff structure favouring energy-intensive users, and asks for guaranteed investor certainty against a funding gap.
According to the members, the government should do more to meet the European obligation.
Volgens de leden zou de regering meer moeten doen om aan de Europese verplichting te voldoen.
Asks why a general levy rather than one only on conventional energy, why the 10 million kWh zero rate for large users, and how the bill fits a wider green tax package.
The ChristenUnie members ask why a general levy on the energy bill was chosen rather than only on 'grey' conventional energy.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen waarom wordt gekozen voor een algemene opslag op de energierekening en niet slechts voor «grijze» conventionele energie.
Supports a structural funding base for SDE+, but argues the earmarking should be formally and legally tied to the SDE+ rather than a broad purpose to strengthen accountability.
Secondly, the members invite the government to consider that with a (new) earmarked levy, the spending of these funds must be properly accountable to citizens and businesses.

In de tweede plaats geven de leden de regering in overweging dat bij een (nieuwe) bestemmingsheffing de besteding van deze middelen op goede wijze verantwoord moet kunnen worden richting burgers en bedrijven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet opslag duurzame energie, which creates a new levy on electricity and gas consumption alongside the energy tax, and raised concerns about its standalone character, the vague earmarking of revenue, delegation of tariff-setting by AMvB, and unnotified state aid. The minister's reply accepted the tariff and state-aid points (tariffs now set in the statute, Commission notification only) and kept the separate levy while amending the explanatory memorandum on earmarking.
concerns: Tariffs for the levy should not be delegated by AMvB because they are essential elements of taxation; they must be set in the statute itself, which the minister did for 2013-2015.

The separate levy conflicts with the government's own simplification goals in the Fiscale Agenda and should be replaced by a higher energy tax rate; the minister kept the standalone levy for transparency.

The levy is a new state aid measure requiring formal Commission approval, which the minister declined to seek, arguing it is financed from general funds and only notified under the energy tax directive.

The earmarking of revenue in the statute is too broad and should be made concrete with reference to the SDE+; the minister removed it from the statute and clarified the explanatory memorandum instead.
Redactional remarks on the wording of the mutatis mutandis reference and the exceptions to the Wbm provisions, and on who sets lower regulation, were accepted.

33124.s: The bill amends the Dutch Housing Act to require energy performance certificates for buildings sold, rented or occupied by public bodies, with a 10 percent rent withholding for tenants when the landlord fails to provide one. It also gives the VROM-Inspectie enforcement powers and allows the Minister to impose penalties, implementing EU Directive 2010/31/EU.
33124.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations largely as technical detail required by the EU directive and says such rules are already set out in the existing Building Decree and regulations.
q: Such regulations are now contained in the Energy Performance of Buildings Decree and the Building Decree 2003.
Dergelijke voorschriften zijn nu opgenomen in het Besluit energieprestatie gebouwen, het Bouwbesluit 2003
d: content and format of certificate, calculation method, reference values, expert quality requirements
designating certificate components that must be displayed
p: The Minister may impose a penalty order on building owners who fail to display certificates, expanding enforcement discretion over private owners.
The VROM-Inspectie is given supervisory competence over display obligations, centralising enforcement instead of municipalities, which the memorandum says would otherwise have checked themselves.

parties: Asks whether the bill infringes property rights and why the basic-label alternative was not adopted, and seeks clarity on vague terms such as 'veelvuldig'.
Can the government ensure there is really no infringement on property rights?
Kan de regering verzekeren dat er echt geen sprake is van inbreuk op het eigendomsrecht?
Finds the implementation too minimal, objects to exemptions and the four-month rule, and argues the sanction should be applied earlier in the sales process to protect buyers.
The PvdA members also point to the Council of State's criticism that the proposed sanction is disproportionate.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie wijzen in deze ook op de kritiekpunten van de Raad van State die de voorgestelde sanctie disproportioneel vindt.
Strongly objects to blocking sales as disproportionate, asks whether less intrusive sanctions were considered, and worries about delays in forced sales.
The PVV members have serious objections to blocking the sale of homes and buildings.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben grote bezwaren tegen het blokkeren van de verkoop van woningen en gebouwen.

Challenges the necessity and proportionality of the sanction, asks for alternatives less restrictive of property rights, and questions whether the State inspecting itself through VROM-Inspectie is appropriate.
These members challenge the government to come up with a simpler sanctions system for the energy label on rental and sale.
Deze leden dagen de regering uit om te komen met een zo eenvoudig stelsel van sanctionering van het energielabel bij verhuur en verkoop.

Asks for justification of differing enforcement approaches, equality before the law, the underlying ACTAL and administrative burden studies, and whether less burdensome indicative certificates are legally possible.
These members ask the government to justify why a different approach has consistently been chosen.
Deze leden vragen de regering te beargumenteren waarom er steeds gekozen is voor een verschillende aanpak.
Questions the proportionality of blocking deeds given that the certificate does not itself achieve energy savings, and asks why the Belgian sanction model is not used and how sellers can be traced.
The SGP members note that the requirement for an energy performance certificate at transfer does not in itself contribute to the energy-saving objective.

De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat het vereiste van de aanwezigheid van het energieprestatiecertificaat bij overdracht van de woning in zichzelf niet bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van energiebesparing.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the proposed sanction for lacking an energy performance certificate (blocking registration of the deed of transfer) was disproportionate, along with several definitional and scope issues in the Energy Performance of Buildings bill. The government's reply replaced the registration-blocking sanction with a rule that the notary may not execute the deed while the certificate is missing, and adopted most drafting and definitional recommendations.
concerns: The sanction of refusing registration of the deed of transfer was held disproportionate given its severe effects on seller and buyer, and was replaced by a non-execution rule while the certificate is missing.
The advisory division asked for consideration of less far-reaching alternatives such as penalty payments or administrative fines, which the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to address.
The proposed requirement that the deed of transfer contain a statement about delivery of the certificate fits poorly with the purpose and system of the Cadastre Act and was withdrawn.
Definition of energy performance was aligned with the directive, and the building definition and the industrial-function exemption were revised to match the directive's wording.
The delegation clause in the Housing Act was changed from general administrative order to ministerial regulation, as the matters are technical.

Unclear scope for executory sale, expropriation and apartment certification was clarified in the explanatory memorandum, though the government disagreed on some points such as the agricultural exemption.

33133.s: The bill removes phrases allowing lower regulations (AMvB or ministerial regulation) to deviate from several social security and labour statutes (ANW, AOW, Arbowet, WW, WAO/WIA, ZW, Wajong, WFSV, and others), in line with the Jurgens motion. It also restructures some delegation powers, moving certain deviations and delegations to clearer statutory form.
33133.j: The memorandum justifies retaining or reshaping delegation powers to avoid excessive detail in statutes, preserve administrative practice, and allow sector-specific adaptation, while removing deviation clauses to comply with the Jurgens motion.
q: From the standpoint of clarity and accessibility of regulation, it is desirable to bring the delegation provisions in the Ministry of Social Affairs' field as far as possible into line with the existing Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving.

Het is vanuit een oogpunt van overzichtelijkheid en kenbaarheid van de regelgeving wenselijk ook de in de lijst opgenomen delegatiebepalingen op het terrein van het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zoveel mogelijk in overeenstemming te brengen met de thans bestaande Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving op dit punt.
d: entitlement to survivors' benefits for persons working abroad or living in Caribbean parts of the Kingdom
Artikel II, A and B (art. 8a(4), 9a(3) AOW)
entitlement to old-age supplements and pension for persons abroad
exempting or adding occupational health rules for specific sectors
calculation of 26-week employment requirement and equalisation of weeks
rules for cases where holiday restriction does not apply due to disaster
further rules on combined wage and social insurance benefit receipt
rules on sector affiliation criteria for employer categories, differing from statutory criteria
entitlement to disability benefit while living abroad for public-interest work or Caribbean residence
further rules on the first Wajong provision and prevention of overlap with other disability benefits
further rules on wage-cost subsidy for reintegration, including overtake of business and drop of threshold
benefit entitlement for persons performing public-interest work or living in Caribbean parts
sickness benefit entitlement for persons abroad doing public-interest work or living in Caribbean parts
p: Artikel I, A; Artikel II, A-B; Artikel IV, A; Artikel X, A
Removes the words permitting lower regulations to deviate from statute in several provisions, tightening statutory primacy rather than expanding executive discretion.
Artikel XII, D; Artikel XIII (art. 19a) and Artikel III/XII provisions shifting general delegation to AMvB
Expands executive power to set benefit entitlement rules for persons abroad or in the Caribbean through AMvB without a specified statutory framework beyond the general criteria stated.

parties: Supports keeping some provisions unchanged to avoid over-detailed legislation and preserve room for tailored solutions, and asks for examples of deviations by decree in experimental or emergency situations.
These members support the government in not amending certain provisions, because otherwise there would be excessive detail in legislation.
Deze leden steunen de regering om bepaalde bepalingen niet te wijzigen, omdat er anders sprake zal zijn van doorgeschoten detaillering in wetgeving.
Asks why so many discretionary deviation provisions exist in social security law and whether the proposed changes could cause problems in implementation.
The PvdA members read little in the explanatory memorandum about why so many deviation-authority provisions exist in social security.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie lezen in de memorie van toelichting weinig over de redenen waarom op het terrein van de sociale zekerheid zoveel bepalingen met afwijkingsbevoegdheid bestaan.

Supports limiting delegation to avoid lower rules deviating from higher regulation, but asks for justification of remaining deviation powers, financial and administrative effects, and why the power to set the daily wage was removed.
They endorse the reason for this bill, namely that as far as possible delegation provisions should prevent lower regulations from deviating from higher regulation.
Zij onderschrijven de aanleiding van dit wetsvoorstel, namelijk dat zoveel mogelijk moet worden voorkomen dat door delegatiebepalingen lagere regelingen afwijken van hogere regelgeving.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division endorsed the bill aligning social affairs statutes with the Jurgens motion banning delegation of power to lower regulations to deviate from formal law, but objected that several retained deviation powers (Arbowet art. 16(6), ATW art. 5:12, dagloon and Schattingsbesluit grounds, WAO art. 40(5), Wet arbeid en zorg art. 3:18) were insufficiently justified or unconditional. The minister's reply narrowed the Arbowet and ATW powers, removed the unconditional ministerial delegations for the dagloon regulations, and kept the Schattingsbesluit powers after consultation with UWV, while removing the WAO 40(5) power and deferring the Wet arbeid en zorg provisions to a separate bill.
concerns: Retained deviation powers in the Arbowet and ATW lack adequate justification and are unconditional delegations to the minister; the minister narrowed the Arbowet power and kept the ATW power with a fuller motivation.
Unconditional delegation to the minister for setting and revising the daily wage in the dagloon regulations; the grounds were amended to remove ministerial delegation.
Schattingsbesluit powers in WAO art. 18(8) and Wet WIA art. 6(4) are unconditional and insufficiently limited; the minister maintained them, arguing the listed examples were not exhaustive.
WAO art. 40(5) and Wet arbeid en zorg art. 3:18(7)-(8) were not addressed in the bill; the WAO power is removed, while the Wet arbeid en zorg provisions are deferred to another bill.

33151.s: The bill introduces mandatory minimum prison sentences under the Criminal Code for repeat offenders who commit a serious bodily-integrity offence within ten years of a prior conviction for an offence carrying twelve or more years' imprisonment. Judges may go below the minimum only in exceptional individual circumstances, must give reasons in the judgment, and the regime is excluded for juveniles and in certain other cases.
33151.j: The memorandum justifies the minimum sentences as the legislature exercising its own responsibility to set norms for sentencing in serious recidivism cases, in line with the coalition agreement.
q: The judge's freedom in sentencing forms an essential element of our criminal justice system.
De straftoemetingsvrijheid van de rechter vormt een wezenlijk element van ons strafrechtelijk stelsel.
p: Mandatory minimum sentences narrow the sentencing discretion of judges, shifting sentencing setting from the courts to the legislature, with only a narrow exception permitted and a duty to give reasons.
Judges must give specific reasons in the judgment when applying the exception to the minimum sentence.

parties: Supports the bill's aims but asks how the hardship clause works and whether prosecutors and judges will evade minimum sentences through acquittals or lesser charges.
These members are concerned about reports that judges and the Public Prosecution Service would look for ways not to impose or demand the minimum sentences.
De leden van de VVD-fractie maken zich zorgen over de geluiden die zij horen dat de rechters en het OM naar mogelijkheden zouden gaan zoeken om niet de minimumstraffen op te leggen dan wel te eisen.
Argues the bill undermines the judiciary's primacy in sentencing, that the hardship clause is insufficient, and that necessity and effectiveness have not been demonstrated.
First, they find that for imposing sentences for serious offences, primacy lies and must remain with the judge.](We note the sentence is truncated) ]
Op de eerste plaats vinden zij dat voor het opleggen van straffen voor zware misdrijven het primaat bij de rechter ligt en dient te blijven liggen.
Supports minimum sentences as a step in the right direction and asks how the judiciary and prosecution will be prevented from avoiding them.
These members ask how it will be prevented that the judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service might avoid imposing minimum sentences, for example by not prosecuting or by improper acquittal.

Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat de rechterlijke macht en het OM eventueel het opleggen van minimumstraffen ontwijken door bijvoorbeeld niet over te gaan tot vervolging of door een oneigenlijke vrijspraak.
Views the bill as a democratically legitimate signal and stresses its strict limits, including the judicial power to deviate in hardship cases.
Moreover, an explicit judicial power is provided to nevertheless depart from the indicated minimum sentence in cases of special hardship.
Bovendien is voorzien in een uitdrukkelijke rechterlijke bevoegdheid om in gevallen van bijzondere hardheid toch af te wijken van de geïndiceerde minimumstraf.
Finds the necessity unproven and considers the bill an unnecessary restriction of judicial sentencing freedom, questioning the exemption for offenders with mental disorders.
Above all, they believe this bill unnecessarily and undesirably restricts judicial sentencing freedom.
Bovenal zijn zij van mening dat dit wetsvoorstel op een onnodige en niet wenselijke wijze de rechterlijke straftoemetingsvrijheid inperkt.
Rejects the claimed need and effectiveness, stresses the importance of judicial sentencing discretion, and asks for empirical justification.
They attach great value to the primacy of individual sentencing lying and remaining with the independent judge.
Zij hechten er grote waarde aan dat het primaat van de individuele sanctietoemeting bij de onafhankelijke rechter ligt en blijft liggen.
Doubts effectiveness and proportionality, warns of risks to the separation of powers and to judicial fairness, and suggests changing prosecution guidelines instead.
Sees a risk of blending legislative and judicial power and questions whether judicial independence can be guaranteed; asks why alternatives such as prosecution guidelines are insufficient.
These members see a wrong development in this amendment, namely an entanglement of legislative and judicial power.
Deze leden zien in deze wijziging een verkeerde ontwikkeling zich voordoen, namelijk een verstrengeling van de wetgevende en rechtsprekende macht.
Sees value in clear norms and firm sentencing for recidivism but asks for the precise arguments and evidence of need.
They would like to hear from the government what the precise arguments are for introducing those minimum sentences.
Graag vernemen zij van de regering wat nu de precieze argumenten zijn om te komen tot de invoering van die minimumstraffen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against the bill introducing mandatory minimum sentences for recidivist serious offences, arguing it substantially disturbs the balance between legislature and judiciary and that the problem and effectiveness are not sufficiently demonstrated. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the systemic-breach objection, accepts several drafting changes, and maintains the core of the bill while justifying the ten-year recidive period and the minimum-sentence height.
concerns: The combination of past conviction based on statutory maximum, fixed minimum, and limited hardship clause substantially disturbs the balance between legislature and judge; government denies a systemic breach.

The problem the bill addresses is not clearly defined or substantiated and effectiveness of minimum sentences in reducing recidivism is not demonstrated; government asserts an expected deterrent effect without empirical support.

The fixed minimum of half the statutory maximum may lead to disproportionate sentences; alternative of one-third was suggested, and the hardship clause is too narrow; government rejects reconsidering the height but adds clarification.
Risk that in some cases the minimum sentence violates the proportionality principle under Article 6 ECHR; government disagrees.
The prior-conviction condition should clarify whether suspended sentences qualify and the explanatory memorandum should be amended accordingly; government followed this.
Recidive period of ten years is insufficiently justified and departs from the usual five-year term; government added a justification but kept ten years.
Financial and prison-capacity effects were summarily treated; government added estimates of short and longer-term effects on prisons.

33240-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement (Slotwet) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' offices of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, by adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power.
33240-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by higher-than-budgeted case volumes at the Raad van State and related staffing costs, funded through the implementation notes.
q: In 2011 the number of incoming, handled and decided cases at the Administrative Jurisdiction Division was considerably higher than the budgeted numbers.
In 2011 is het aantal in binnengekomen, in behandeling genomen en afgedane zaken bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak fors hoger dan de begrote aantallen geweest.

33241.s: The bill amends the Sickness Benefits Act and related laws to limit sickness absence and incapacity among uninsured-type workers (vangnetters) by tightening the income-based benefit criterion for employees without an employer after 52 weeks, lowering benefit levels and introducing activation and re-integration duties. It also restructures premium financing and the Werkhervattingskas fund, and extends several benefit waiting periods from three to six months.
33241.j: The memorandum justifies the stricter criteria and delegations by the need to reduce long-term sickness absence and benefit inflow among vangnetters, and says delegated rules are needed for operational detail and for possible future use.
d: further and deviating rules on assessment of earning capacity
definition of income for benefit calculation, including imputed income
qualifying care years and counting of working days
further rules on re-integration duties and exemptions
exempting groups of workers from duties
premium surcharge or discount rules by category of employer and sector
which fund bears benefit costs of certain former-employer cases
annual contribution to sector fund for temporary-agency employers
p: Introduces a stricter earnings-capacity test after 52 weeks of sickness for workers without an employer, shifting the determination of entitlement toward administrative medical and labour assessment by the UWV.
Assigns the UWV the task of setting the earning-capacity percentage and checking entitlement for benefit recipients beyond 52 weeks.
Allows detailed rules and individual exemptions from re-integration obligations to be set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation without parliamentary involvement.
Reduces benefit levels after three months to a formula based on minimum wage and imputed income, with the income definition left to administrative rules.

parties: Supports a more activating sick-pay scheme but asks for quantified employment effects and clarification of the 35% threshold and premium rules.
They see the need to tighten the Ziektewet by making it more activating.
Ze zien de noodzaak van aanscherping van de ziektewet door deze meer activerend te maken.
Objects that flexible workers receive fewer social security rights than permanent staff and asks the government to justify the widening gap, citing the Raad van State.
They find it truly incomprehensible that flexible workers receive fewer social security rights than workers with a permanent contract.
Zij vinden het echt onbegrijpelijk, dat flexwerkers minder sociale zekerheidsrechten krijgen dan werknemers met een vast contract.
Questions whether the UWV failed in its duty to prevent long-term sickness and whether the unequal income protection is justified.
Does the government acknowledge with this bill that the UWV has seriously failed in this?
Erkent de regering met de indiening van dit wetsvoorstel, dat het UWV daarin ernstig is tekortgeschoten?
Accepts the need for measures but doubts their effectiveness, asks for a justification of breaking the principle of equal sickness benefits, and welcomes the UWV pilot.
Why is this principle being abandoned, these members ask?
Waarom wordt van dit principe afstand gedaan, zo vragen deze leden?
Finds the Raad van State's criticism insufficiently rebutted and requests that the ILO review the bill before further debate.
They ask the government to request that the ILO review this bill and inform the Chamber of the ILO's views before further consideration.

De leden van de SP-fractie verzoeken de regering de ILO te vragen het onderhavige wetsvoorstel te toetsen en de Kamer op de hoogte te stellen van de opvattingen van de ILO voorafgaand aan verdere behandeling van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the two-tier system affects the equality principle and why vangnetters get no independent advice or stronger position in reintegration.
Can the government argue what consequences the two-tier division within the ZW between people with temporary and permanent contracts has for the equality principle.

Kan de regering beargumenteren welke gevolgen de tweedeling die zo binnen de ZW tussen mensen met tijdelijke arbeidscontracten en mensen met vaste arbeidscontracten ontstaat heeft voor het gelijkheidsbeginsel.
Acknowledges the aim of limiting inflow but regrets tightening after a period of limited reintegration efforts and asks for evidence of behavioural effects.
They find it unfortunate, however, that the proposed tightening follows a period in which reintegration efforts for the target group were in many cases limited.

Zij vinden het echter ongelukkig dat de voorgestelde aanscherpingen volgen op een periode waarin de re-integratie-inspanningen ten behoeve van de doelgroep in veel gevallen juist beperkt zijn gebleken.
