v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division doubted the effectiveness of the bill tightening sick pay for temporary workers (vangnetters) and advised reconsidering it, especially on intensive UWV guidance, employer incentives and inequality between insiders and outsiders. The government's reply accepts parts (UWV improvements, dropping the two-week wage obligation for temp agencies) but maintains the core package and rejects several objections.
concerns: The Council doubts the proposed measures will effectively reduce long-term sickness and WIA inflow among vangnetters given their specific characteristics, and advises intensive UWV guidance instead.
The Council questions the necessity and effectiveness of the two-week wage continuation obligation for temp agencies, given the existing decline in short-term sickness absence.
The Council asks for better justification of the effectiveness of activation through sanctions and the period during which work at own level may be sought.
The Council notes that the bill further widens the gap between workers with and without permanent contracts, which is undesirable given future labour market demands.
The Council doubts the effectiveness of employer financial incentives and asks for their justification and possible reconsideration.
The Council flags income fluctuations between the second sickness year and the first WIA year and asks for justification of differing offset rules.

33250.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994, Wet luchtvaart, Organisatiewet Kadaster and several other transport-related laws to bring the zelfstandige bestuursorganen (ZBOs) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment under the framework of the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen. It strengthens ministerial powers over appointments, approvals, budgets and information while narrowing the roles of supervisory boards, and reorganises exam bodies for maritime professions.
33250.j: The memorandum justifies the shifts as necessary to bring the agencies in line with the Kaderwet, to ensure ministerial accountability to Parliament, and to give the minister the powers recommended by the Commissie Gerritse, while keeping the supervisory boards as internal check bodies.
q: In addition, the Minister of IenM, taking into account the type of organisation, will as far as possible receive the same powers over the various zbo's.

Daarnaast zal de Minister van IenM, rekening houdend met de soort organisatie, hetzij voltijd- of deeltijd-zbo, hetzij publiekrechtelijk of privaatrechtelijk zbo, bij de verschillende zbo's zoveel mogelijk dezelfde bevoegdheden krijgen.
d: policy rules on tasks entrusted to the Dienst Wegverkeer under other laws
policy rules on tasks of CBR under other laws and tariff rules for other assigned tasks
rules on supervision of the Dienst Wegverkeer by the minister and supervisory board
rules on structure of the multi-year financial plan and audit focus points
appointment of LVNL supervisory board members, one nominated by the Defence minister
rules on supervision of LVNL and information statute
information statute and supervision rules for the Kadaster
requirements for exemption certificates (opleiding, kundigheid, ervaring, geschiktheid) and conditions attached
requirements for training, competence and experience for pilotage in designated waters
amounts for costs of examinations and documents
rules on admission requirements and examination for registerloods
registration rules for loodsen set by verordening instead of amvb
p: Appointment, suspension and dismissal of directors and supervisory board members moved from the supervisory board to the minister, and the minister gains approval powers over budget, annual accounts and agreements, reducing the board's independent oversight of management.
The minister appoints, suspends and dismisses LVNL supervisory board members and may require prior consent of the board, limiting the board's independence as an internal check.
Art. IV.F, IV.H, IV.J (Organisatiewet Kadaster art. 1-13)
Minister takes over appointment of board members and gains approval over Kadaster internal decisions, while the supervisory board's role is narrowed.
Art. I.P (art. 4x WVW) and Art. I.R (art. 4au CBR)
Minister may take necessary measures if an agency no longer performs a task properly, after consultation with the responsible minister, without a stated procedure or judicial review.
Art. VIII.A, IX.C (Scheepvaartverkeerswet art. 10, Loodsenwet art. 5)
Qualification requirements for pilots and exemption certificates are delegated to general administrative orders with specified content areas.

parties: Asks whether transferring supervisory powers from boards to the minister affects board composition and whether the framework adds bureaucracy.
Regarding the transfer of some powers from the supervisory board to the minister, the VVD members ask whether this still has consequences for the composition of the supervisory boards.

Met betrekking tot de overheveling van enkele bevoegdheden van de raad van toezicht naar de minister hebben de leden van de VVD-fractie de vraag of dit nog consequenties heeft voor de bezetting van de raden van toezicht.
Asks which supervisory tasks the various boards retain and questions why the minister does not oversee SACN's budget despite the Raad van State's request for justification.
The CDA members miss in the explanatory memorandum the explanation requested by the Raad van State for the absence of ministerial control over the budget of SACN.

De leden van de CDA-fractie missen in de MvT de door de Raad van State gevraagde toelichting op het achterwege blijven van ministeriële controle van de begroting van de Stichting Airport Coordination Netherlands (SACN).
Welcomes the move of CBR to public law but argues it should be under direct democratic control by the minister, and asks whether the minister can steer slot allocation at SACN.
More democratic control is good and desirable.
Meer democratische controle is goed en gewenst.

33322.s: The bill replaces the Meststoffenwet's manure-production rules with a system in which farmers may produce manure only up to their placement space, and must deliver a set percentage of their surplus to processors, backed by processing-capacity limits and fines. It also lets the minister set herd ceilings, transfer processing duties between farmers by general administrative order, and abolish the poultry and pig rights regime by royal decree.
33322.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need for technical and administrative detail, to the EU derogation conditions and to the need to adjust rules to ongoing evaluation of the system.
q: Whether this basis is used depends on whether the benefits of such an option for farmers outweigh the disadvantages in terms of administrative and compliance costs for business and implementation and enforcement costs for government.

Of van deze grondslag gebruik wordt gemaakt, hangt af van de vraag of de voordelen die een dergelijke mogelijkheid biedt voor veehouders opwegen de nadelen in verband met administratieve lasten en nalevingskosten aan de kant van het bedrijfsleven en uitvoerings- en handhavingslasten aan de kant van de overheid.
d: placement space calculation for natural terrain and grazing animals
counting manure applied on German or Belgian land near the border
rules and categories for processing and placement contracts
minister sets maximum animal numbers for farms that exceed placement space
exempting farms below a threshold manure quantity from processing duty
transferring processing duty between farmers and conditions on such transfers
exempting new farms below a threshold quantity from processing duty
setting processing percentages by animal category, manure type and area
method and information requirements for processing capacity determination
deadlines for meeting the processing obligation
royal decree sets date for abolishing poultry and pig rights chapter
transitional rules for 2013 processing and contract deadlines
p: The minister may impose herd-size ceilings on farms that exceeded placement space, for up to three years renewable without a fixed limit.
Limits manure import contracts to a farm's placement capacity as calculated under rules the ministry sets.
General administrative order may impose processing duties on farmers who take over another farmer's obligation.

parties: Asks for analysis of feasibility, costs, administrative burden and whether the government will verify compliance with manure production limits.
At the end of the calendar year it will be checked whether manure production has actually stayed within the limits of the manure placement space.
Aan het einde van het kalenderjaar zal worden gecontroleerd of de mestproductie daadwerkelijk binnen de grenzen van de mestplaatsingsruimte is gebleven.
Supports holding farmers responsible for their manure but fears increase in livestock, prefers reducing animal numbers, and asks how actual disposal will be guaranteed.
Regarding manure disposal, the members ask how it is ensured that manure is actually disposed of and processed or applied elsewhere.
Wat betreft de mestafzet vragen de leden hoe wordt zeker gesteld dat mest daadwerkelijk wordt afgezet en elders verwerkt of toegepast.
Prefers animal rights system limiting livestock numbers at source rather than end-of-pipe solutions; questions about export destinations and enforcement.
Expresses interest in the bill without raising specific check-related concerns in the excerpt.
The CDA members have taken note with interest of the proposal to amend the Meststoffenwet.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het voorstel tot wijziging van de Meststoffenwet.
Worries about negative effects on farming and nature, asks for decentralised steering by provinces and a consultation obligation between national government and provinces.
Asks whether environmental effects are sufficiently assessed and about incentives, the legal consequences of contract breach and the basis for mandatory processing.
The said members ask whether sufficient attention is given to the environmental effects.
Genoemde leden vragen of voldoende wordt gekeken naar de milieueffecten.
Critical of manure placement contracts and the speed of mandatory processing; cites the Raad van State's advice on necessity and proportionality.
The Council of State therefore emphasises in its advice the importance of a good justification: are the requirements of necessity and proportionality sufficiently met?
De Raad van State benadrukt in haar advies daarom het belang van een goede onderbouwing: wordt voldoende tegemoet gekomen aan de eisen van noodzaak en proportionaliteit?
Opposes the bill as it does not resolve the manure surplus and argues for closed nutrient cycles rather than incineration and imported feed.
The members of the Partij voor de Dieren are of the view that the current manure surplus and the associated environmental and nature problems will not be solved by the present bill.

De leden van de fractie van de Partij voor de Dieren zijn van mening dat het huidige mestoverschot en de daarmee gepaard gaande milieu- en natuurproblemen niet worden opgelost door middel van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill's aim of managing manure surplus after quota abolition, but questions the necessity and EU-law justification of a mandatory manure-processing obligation and asks for adaptation. The government's reply addresses the points by clarifying the processing obligation as enforcement of the Nitrates Directive, adding justification, and making technical amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the necessity of the mandatory manure-processing obligation over alternatives such as market-based contracts, and the government reply justifies it as needed to guarantee actual processing, without changing the instrument.
The EU-law justification (free movement of goods, services and Services Directive) is found insufficient, and the reply adds justification and references to Article 16 of the Services Directive.

The Afdeling notes the processing obligation may cause scarcity, higher prices and administrative burdens, and the reply argues it is proportionate and differentiates percentages by region and category.

Point on the market for manure-processing products and the Europe-wide recognition of mineral concentrates is addressed in the reply by noting that processing removes manure from the surplus count and updating the memorandum.
Criteria for choosing a single processing percentage when several apply should be set in the bill, which the government followed by amending article 33h.
Several redactional remarks, including definitions and wording changes, were incorporated into the bill.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the nota van wijziging to the Meststoffenwet, which removes the requirement for pre-concluded manure placement contracts and loosens manure processing obligations, warning this weakens enforcement of the Nitrates Directive. The state secretary's nader rapport largely rejects the advice on the instrument-weakening and fraud points, accepts the advice on delegation levels and penalty provisions, and accepts drafting remarks.
concerns: Removing pre-concluded manure placement contracts and relying only on processing obligations makes compliance with the Nitrates Directive more vulnerable; the government disagrees and cites the ex-ante evaluation and dierrechten as backstop.
Manure processing obligation risks fraud via transport documents and added intermediary links; government disputes the fraud sensitivity of transport documents and points to AGR/GPS controls.
Registration of intermediaries and refusal/suspension grounds under Bibob must be set by general administrative order rather than a lower-level rule; followed.
Penalty maxima for manure processing overtreding were inconsistent with the statutory tariff structure and were adjusted as advised.
Redactional remarks on the definition of mestverwerkingsovereenkomst were incorporated into the bill.

33400-V.s: The bill sets the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) and the 2013 budget statement for the CBI trade-promotion agency, in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2013. It is a pure budget-approval law with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2013 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the nota van wijziging splitting the foreign trade and development cooperation budget from the Foreign Affairs 2013 budget cannot serve as a standalone bill, since the Constitution and Comptabiliteitswet provide no route to split a pending budget bill outside the amendment procedure, leaving no budget authorisation for the programme minister. In its nader rapport the government accepts the advice, withdraws the separate bill, and proposes a second nota van wijziging creating a separate budget statement within the Foreign Affairs budget act for 2013 only.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that a text in bill form is not a bill unless submitted via the constitutional procedure, so the separation of the budget via Article III cannot create a valid budget authorisation.
The Constitution allows splitting a bill only for constitutional amendments, so splitting a pending ordinary budget bill by amendment is not permitted and the chosen route must be abandoned.

Without a regular budget bill the programme minister would have no spending authority for 2013, so the status quo ante must be restored by a new amendment; the government accepts this but adopts a different workaround.
The Afdeling suggests a provision in the Foreign Affairs bill defining the minister's responsibility for specific budget items, and the government considers the programme budget question for 2014.

33520.s: The bill transposes the EU Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU into the Dutch Civil Code (Books 6 and 7) and the Consumer Protection Enforcement Act, creating a new title on distance and off-premises contracts with withdrawal rights, information duties and bans on certain practices. It also repeals the Colportage Act, moves financial-services withdrawal rules into the Civil Code, and adjusts enforcement by the Consumentenautoriteit and AFM.
33520.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated detail mainly by the need to implement the directive's full harmonisation and technical requirements, without elaborating on the scope of the ministerial powers.
q: By ministerial regulation further rules on the composition and level of the basic tariff may be laid down.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels over de samenstelling en hoogte van het basistarief worden vastgesteld.
d: detailed rules on composition and level of basic telephone tariff
designating further financial product contracts excluded from withdrawal right

parties: Questions the role of civil courts applying open consumer norms and the pressure on the Dutch judge from EU case law, asking whether Article 24 Rv should be revised.
Is the government willing to assess separately from this bill whether the position of the first-instance judge can become more active?
Is de regering bereid separaat van dit wetsvoorstel te beoordelen of de positie van de rechter in eerste aanleg actiever kan worden

Asks about enforcement capacity, the planned dismantling of the dual enforcement system, and whether the government will adopt the Consumentenautoriteit's proposal on payment during the cooling-off period.
How many FTE are available for enforcing this bill and the other consumer legislation?
Hoeveel fte is beschikbaar voor de handhaving van dit wetsvoorstel en de overige consumentenwetgeving?
Worries that the full harmonisation approach prevents stricter Dutch consumer rules and that nullity for missing written form limits consumer choice.
These members fear that Dutch consumers may suffer disadvantages from this in the future.
Zij vrezen dat Nederlandse consumenten hier in de toekomst nadeel van kunnen ondervinden.
Asks how compliance with information duties will be effectively supervised by the consumer authorities and whether the cost estimates are realistic.
The CDA members ask how it will be ensured that traders and code holders actually comply effectively with this information duty in practice.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen op welke wijze erop wordt toegezien dat handelaren en houders van gedragscodes in de praktijk daadwerkelijk op effectieve wijze aan deze informatieplicht voldoen.
Welcomes the bill as a step toward European integration of consumer rights and asks for clarification of cost figures and the number of affected firms.
These members realise this is an implementation bill and that there is therefore little room for adjustments and improvements.
Deze leden beseffen dat hier sprake is van een implementatiewet en dat er derhalve weinig ruimte is voor aanpassingen en verbeteringen.
Welcomes the translation of a motion on signature requirements but asks why the scope is limited and about double written-confirmation burdens for businesses.
These members consider it positive that the Aasted-Madsen motion is translated into this bill.
Deze leden achten het positief dat de motie Aasted-Madsen (Kamerstuk 27 879, nr. 29 ) in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel wordt vertaald.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the Implementatiewet richtlijn consumentenrechten (Consumer Rights Directive) to remove the distinction between revocable and irrevocable offers in art. 6:230q BW, since the directive requires unrestricted withdrawal, and to add further technical changes. The minister's nader rapport accepts the advice on the revocation rule, the essential information reference, the 7:19a BW point and the transposition of article 18(3), and the redactional remarks are largely adopted.
concerns: The revocation regime for offers in art. 6:230q BW deviates from the directive, which requires unrestricted withdrawal of offers; the government clarified the provision so consumers may withdraw at any time before conclusion of the contract.
Art. 6:193f BW should refer to art. 6:230v(7) BW for essential information, which the government added.

Art. 7:19a(2)(a) BW goes beyond the directive's full harmonisation by covering all cases where the buyer may infer non-performance, and should be limited to refusal to deliver; the government amended the provision.

Article 18(3) of the directive (immediate refund after termination) must be implemented for all sales contracts, not only distance and off-premises sales, which the government added as a new paragraph in art. 7:19a BW.
Redactional remarks are almost entirely adopted, except the government did not replace 'duurzame gegevensdrager' with 'duurzaam medium', retaining terminology consistent with the BW.

34015.s: The bill creates a new income supplement paid from the Ouderdomsfonds to AOW pensioners, linked to years of AOW insurance, and excludes it from general assistance and rent allowance calculations. It also amends the Wfsv, Participatiewet and Wet op de huurtoeslag accordingly and withdraws the Wet mogelijkheid koopkrachttegemoetkoming oudere belastingplichtigen.
34015.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the long-term sustainability of public finances and rising costs from population ageing, and states that a general administrative order sets the supplement's details.
q: By general administrative order, rules are laid down concerning the amount, indexation and manner of payment of the income supplement.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de hoogte, de indexering en de wijze van betaling van de inkomensondersteuning.
d: amount, indexation and payment of the income supplement

parties: Supports the goal and asks whether the non-income-tested design is the only reason for its choice; sees AOW accrual as a neutral criterion.
The VVD members have read this bill with interest. They endorse the aim of the bill and have some further questions and remarks.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van dit wetsvoorstel. Ze onderschrijven de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel en hebben nog enkele vragen en opmerkingen.
Welcomes the benefit for the lowest-income pensioners and asks about the costs of income-related design and export issues.
They are glad that pensioners with the smallest purse will be better off from 2015 onward.
Zij zijn blij dat ouderen met de allerkleinste beurs er vanaf 2015 op vooruit gaan.
Argues the compensation is incomplete and not targeted at those most in need, and asks the government for full data and alternatives.
They note that the compensation for the withdrawal of the MKOB via the AOW income support is not complete.
Zij stellen vast dat de compensatie voor de intrekking van de MKOB 1 via de inkomensondersteuning AOW niet volledig is.
Finds it logical that the support depends on AOW accrual and residence, but presses the government on legal advice and past court losses.
They find it logical in itself that the purchasing-power allowance is based on the number of AOW accrual years and on living in the Netherlands.
Zij vinden het op zich logisch dat de koopkrachttegemoetkoming gebaseerd wordt op het aantal jaren AOW-opbouw en op het woonachtig zijn in Nederland.
Asks for updated income and wealth data and whether independent experts such as the Landsadvocaat or College voor de Rechten van de Mens were consulted on discrimination risks.

Given the experiences with the AOW and the MKOB, these members ask whether the government obtained advice from independent experts, for example the Landsadvocaat or the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights.

Gelet op de ervaringen met de AOW en de MKOB vragen deze leden of de regering ter zake advies heeft ingewonnen van onafhankelijke deskundigen, bijvoorbeeld de Landsadvocaat of het College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Asks why people without AOW accrual but low incomes are excluded, why existing entitlements are affected, and how the net savings compare with the new costs.

The ChristenUnie members ask the government for a substantiated response to the relation between the structural saving of EUR 1.1 billion from withdrawing the MKOB and the costs of the new AOW income support of EUR 1 billion structurally.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om een onderbouwde reactie op de verhouding tussen de structurele besparing van € 1,1 miljard door het intrekken van de MKOB en de kosten van de nieuwe inkomensondersteuning AOW die structureel € 1 miljard bedragen.
Argues the AOW is a universal insured right protected as property under the ECHR and that existing MKOB recipients should keep their non-accrual-linked support.
The member believes that the price-indexed universal insurance character of the AOW must remain intact.
Het genoemde lid vindt dat het welvaartsvaste volksverzekeringskarakter van de AOW recht overeind moet blijven.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill replacing the MKOB older-taxpayer allowance with an AOW-linked income support, criticising its lack of targeting to need, its weak link to the intended savings, its effects on people with incomplete AOW, and its exportability. The State Secretary's reply explains the design choices and says the explanatory memorandum was supplemented but largely maintains the proposal.
concerns: The bill is untargeted, applies to all AOW recipients regardless of means, and contributes only modestly to the intended savings; the reply explains the choice and adds explanation but does not change the design.

The bill reduces support for people with incomplete AOW, who are more often in poverty; the reply quantifies the loss and justifies it by migration patterns, with the explanatory memorandum supplemented.
The Council asked why the design makes the allowance exportable; the reply explains the link to a social insurance benefit and the alternatives, and the explanatory memorandum was clarified.

34024.s: The bill amends the Postwet 2009 to modernise the universal postal service: it moves concrete requirements on delivery speed and the number and spacing of post offices and letterboxes from statute down to a general administrative order (AMvB), and adds periodic evaluation, a new tariff-room regime with ACM calculation, and revised fining powers. It also removes some earlier statutory tariff and network provisions in favour of executive regulation.
34024.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to an AMvB by the need for flexibility to respond quickly to market changes and secure the financial sustainability of the universal service.
q: By no longer laying down the concrete requirements at statutory level but at the level of a general administrative order, faster and more effective intervention is possible when market conditions require it.

Door de concrete eisen niet langer neer te leggen op het niveau van de wet maar op het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur kan sneller en effectiever worden ingegrepen indien de marktsituatie daarom vraagt.
d: concrete delivery speed and network of letterboxes and post offices
periodic evaluation of universal postal service requirements
further rules on tariffs and conditions of universal service
I-I (art. 25, eerste, vierde en vijfde lid)
tariff room for universal postal service, incl. deviation for a single year
p: I-D (art. 16, zesde tot en met achtste lid)
Concrete service and network requirements move from statute to a general administrative order, with only a material norm and a four-week voorhang left in the law.
The Minister may set a different tariff room for a single year by ministerial regulation, departing from the general rules, if needed for cost-based tariffs.
Adjusts the scope of ACM supervision and fining powers over several postal provisions.

parties: Asks whether the ACM should get ex-ante powers and fines to enforce UPD rules, and questions the perverse incentive in cost allocation.
The higher the UPD costs, the higher the return in euros the UPD provider can receive within the set maximum.
Hoe hoger het bedrag van de kosten van de UPD, des te hoger het rendement in euro's dat de UPD-verlener binnen het gestelde maximum kan ontvangen.
Objects that the norms for post offices and letterboxes are moved to an AMvB rather than the statute, reducing parliamentary control, and considers an amendment.
Why should this norm only be laid down in a general administrative order (AMvB) and not in the law itself?
Waarom zou deze norm slechts in een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) moeten worden vastgelegd en niet in de wet zelf?
Worries about access for vulnerable groups and opposes abolishing the contribution of all postal operators to net costs.
They therefore propose to retain articles 30 and 31.
Zij stellen daarom voor om artikel 30 en 31 te handhaven.
Argues that essential accessibility safeguards should be in the statute, that parliament loses a key controlling role, and questions the reliance on company-supplied cost figures.
Does the Tweede Kamer not lose an important controlling function if part of article 16 is transferred to the level of an AmVB?
Verliest de Tweede Kamer niet een belangrijke controlerende functie verliest indien een deel van artikel 16 wordt omgezet op het niveau van een AmVB?
Accepts the need for modernisation and asks about delivery days, cost per item and the stamp price calculation.
They acknowledge the need to modernise the postal law, nevertheless these members have some questions.
Zij erkennen de noodzaak om de postwet te moderniseren, desalniettemin hebben deze leden enkele vragen.
Asks why the number and spread of post offices is set in an AMvB rather than in law as essential public infrastructure, and how vulnerable groups are protected.
Should this not be laid down in law, as an essential part of public infrastructure?
Zou dit niet in de wet vastgelegd moeten worden, als essentieel onderdeel van de publieke infrastructuur?
Broadly supports the changes but values good spread and accessibility for vulnerable groups, welcomes consultation duty and asks whether municipalities should be consulted.
These members welcome the provision requiring the universal service provider to consult consumer organisations representing vulnerable groups.
Deze leden vinden het positief dat een bepaling is opgenomen die de verlener van de universele postdienst verplicht om consumentenorganisaties die kwetsbare groepen vertegenwoordigen te consulteren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill modernising the universal postal service (UPD) should clearly define the limits of adjustments and essential access guarantees in law, explain how costs would be covered if profitable operation fails, and move the removal of court-document delivery to a separate bill. The government reply largely accepted these points by supplementing the explanatory memorandum, introducing a material norm in law, and moving the court-document provision, though it did not add a funding mechanism to the bill itself.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the essential features and minimum access guarantees of the universal postal service be fixed in law so they cannot be eroded for profitability reasons, and the government added a material norm in law and clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the funding of the UPD if profitable operation is no longer possible be provided for in the bill itself rather than left to a vague promise of a suitable solution, and the government only addressed this in the explanatory memorandum without adding a mechanism to the bill.

The Afdeling objected to removing the court-document delivery duty from the postal law ahead of a separate bill, and the government moved the matter into the modernisation bill so parliament can debate it there.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on references and provisions, of which some were adopted and others, such as on article 16 paragraphs and article 17, were not.

34042.s: The bill amends the Wet personenvervoer 2000 to add statutory bases allowing general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial rules on cross-concession aspects of public transport ticketing, payment methods and electronic payment services, including market access, cost-based fees, revenue allocation, data sharing and cooperation among concession parties. It gives the ACM market supervision and enforcement powers (periodic penalties and administrative fines) over the new payment-market rules, and gives ILT supervision over the ticketing rules.
34042.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying self-regulation among concession parties through the NOVB has not produced enough safeguards for national interests, so the state as system authority needs regulatory powers.
q: This is in cases where self-regulation between the concession parties in public transport does not provide sufficient guarantees for national interests that transcend the transport concessions.
Dit in gevallen waarin zelfregulering tussen de concessiepartijen in het openbaar vervoer onvoldoende waarborgen oplevert voor nationale belangen die de vervoersconcessies overstijgen.
d: rules on ticket issuance, quality, functionality, tariffs, travel conditions, information and complaints
rules on payment-service providers, market access, cost-based fees and revenue allocation
admission and acceptance of payment methods
obligation on concession holders to jointly maintain a payment system and functional requirements
cooperation and procedures between concession authorities, holders and payment providers
p: Broad open-ended authority for the executive to regulate payment market access, fees and revenue distribution by general administrative order, with ACM ex ante approval of some elements as a partial safeguard.
Allows the executive to impose a joint payment-system obligation on concession holders when a minimum offer is absent or threatened, with the trigger defined in the regulation.
Extends ACM enforcement tools to include periodic penalties and administrative fines for breaches of the new rules.

parties: Supports ministerial intervention power only while the rail market is a near-monopoly, and wants the legislation to lapse once full market competition exists; also wants caution on tariffs becoming political.

In a system where we have a monopolist with 80% of the rail network and hardly any market competition, these members consider it justifiable for the Secretary of State to receive enforcement power over payment systems.[…]

In een systeem waarin we te maken hebben met een monopolist op 80% van het spoor en waarbij er dus nauwelijks sprake is van marktwerking, is het volgens deze leden te billijken dat de Staatssecretaris doorzettingsmacht krijgt
Asks why the minister initially refrained from delegation provisions, which scope of cooperation lacks ministerial power, and questions the overlap of ACM and ILT supervision.
These members ask whether the situations mentioned are an exhaustive overview, or whether other situations are conceivable in which the Secretary of State would still use her power.

De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen of de genoemde situaties een uitputtend overzicht zijn, of dat ook andere situaties denkbaar zijn waarbij de Staatssecretaris toch gebruik zal maken van haar bevoegdheid.

Welcomes faster problem-solving via general administrative order but regrets that regional authorities' tariff powers are placed above the traveller's interest and asks about tariff differences and a maximum tariff.
These members regret that the bill does not make it possible to set city and regional transport tariffs, thereby placing the authority of regional government above the interest of the traveller.

De leden van de SP-fractie betreuren dat het wetsvoorstel het niet mogelijk maakt om tarieven van stads- en streekvervoer vast te stellen en dat hiermee het belang van de bevoegdheid van het regionale bestuur boven dat van de reiziger wordt gesteld.
Asks whether the House will be involved in lower regulation through a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure for each delegation provision.
The CDA members ask whether the House will be involved in the making of lower regulations based on all delegation provisions, for example through a pre-consultation procedure.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de Kamer betrokken wordt bij de totstandkoming van lagere regelgeving op basis van alle delegatiebepalingen, bijvoorbeeld via een voorhangprocedure.

Argues the bill does not yet enable real roaming or open access under ACM supervision, and asks for a draft general administrative order before plenary debate and whether NS can unilaterally cancel contracts.

To properly assess whether these arrangements are sufficient, these members ask whether a draft of these general administrative orders can be sent to the House before the plenary treatment of the bill.

Om goed te kunnen overzien of deze regelingen voldoende zijn, vragen genoemde leden of een concept van deze algemene maatregelen van bestuur vóór de plenaire behandeling van het wetsvoorstel naar de Kamer kan worden gestuurd.
Finds the vague 'reasonable period' for self-regulation too non-committal and asks for objective, hard criteria for when the minister will intervene with regulation.
The member of the independent 50PLUS/Klein group believes this is too non-committal.
Het lid van de onafhankelijke fractie 50PLUS/Klein is van mening dat dit te vrijblijvend is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill amending the Wet personenvervoer 2000 on delegation powers for ticketing, payment and payment services in public transport, but raises two objections to the proposed article 30b on a fallback obligation to maintain a minimum payment service, namely that the trigger should not be modelled on emergency-law conditions and that functional requirements for the payment system lack a legal basis. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport reports that both points were adopted by restructuring article 30b into a single paragraph covering functional requirements, with minor drafting changes.
concerns: The proposed trigger for imposing the maintenance obligation resembles Dutch emergency legislation, which could create confusion; the Afdeling advises limiting the condition to the specific situation of an incomplete minimum payment service.

Article 30b, second paragraph, provides no legal basis for functional requirements on the payment system, which the explanatory memorandum assumed; the Afdeling advises creating that basis in the statute.
Deletion of the words 'in elk geval' in article I, part B, and redistribution of the explanatory memorandum with some renumbering to improve readability.

34060.s: The bill makes a set of purely technical corrections to several Dutch education laws (primary, expertise centres, secondary, adult and vocational education, school participation, and the education inspection act) and to the subsidy act for national education support activities, fixing outdated cross-references, article numbers and ministry names. It does not create new powers or delegations for the executive.
q: This bill makes a number of purely technical amendments to the following education laws
In dit wetsvoorstel wordt een aantal wijzigingen van puur technische aard in de volgende onderwijswetten doorgevoerd

34114.s: This bill approves on behalf of the Netherlands the EU-Moldova Association Agreement (including its Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area) signed in Brussels on 27 June 2014, for the European part of the Netherlands. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
34114.j: The memorandum justifies approval by stating that the agreement underlines the importance the Netherlands attaches to relations with Moldova and that Moldovan standards will be aligned with EU rules to remove trade barriers.

parties: Asks whether future accession to the Eurasian Economic Union would be incompatible with the Association Agreement and how the agreement is enforced in Transnistria without effective Moldovan authority.

Are the European Union and/or Georgia in talks with the Chisinau authorities to guarantee implementation and compliance with the Association Agreement in Transnistria, since the Republic of Moldova has no effective authority there?

Zijn de Europese Unie en/of Georgië in gesprek met de autoriteiten in Chisinau om de implementatie en naleving van de Associatieovereenkomst te garanderen in Transnistrië, aangezien de Republiek Moldavië hier geen effectief gezag heeft?

Asks whether the agreements allow raising fundamental European norms such as human rights and the rule of law, including minority language rights, and about the ratification status ahead of the Riga summit.
More specifically, these members ask to what extent language issues in relation to the protection of minority rights in the countries concerned can also be raised.](Sentence is partially verbatim.)
Meer specifiek vragen deze leden in hoeverre ook taalkwesties in relatie tot de bescherming van de rechten van minderheden in de betreffende landen aan de orde gesteld kunnen worden.

Asks whether the agreement can be suspended for breaches of democracy, human rights and rule of law, and how serious corruption and judicial problems in Moldova are, questioning whether conditions are met.
Can it also be indicated to what extent combating corruption is a condition for implementing (parts of) the agreement?
Kan ook aangegeven worden in hoeverre corruptiebestrijding een voorwaarde is voor implementatie van (onderdelen van) de overeenkomst?
Supports the Eastern Partnership but questions whether Moldova meets the political criteria given persistent judicial and banking-sector problems, and calls for a risk analysis.
That raises the question whether Moldova currently even meets the political criteria to qualify for an Association Agreement.
Dat roept de vraag op of Moldavië op dit moment überhaupt voldoet aan de politieke criteria om in aanmerking te komen voor een Associatieakkoord.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, in a single remark, that the explanatory memorandum to the bill approving the EU-Moldova Association Agreement should address the current situation in Moldova, given the agreement's aims. The government replied that the current situation was deliberately left out of the static memorandum, but has been added in the nader rapport, with parliament to be kept informed of developments.
concerns: The Afdeling advised adding discussion of Moldova's current situation to the explanatory memorandum, which the government met by adding it in the nader rapport and undertaking to inform parliament.

34123.s: The bill creates a separate Dutch Act on the reuse of government information, implementing the 2013 EU amending directive, and makes reuse of public-body information a right that must be granted unless a limited exception applies. It sets fee rules (marginal cost, or cost-plus for museums, libraries and some registers), limits exclusive reuse rights, and repeals the reuse chapter of the Wob.
34123.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of fee criteria as a way to allow uniform criteria if practice shows a need for them, given the directive's requirement of objective, transparent and verifiable criteria.
q: Article 9, fifth paragraph, of the bill contains a delegation basis allowing further rules on these criteria to be set by general administrative order or ministerial regulation.

In artikel 9 van het wetsvoorstel is in het vijfde lid evenwel een delegatiegrondslag opgenomen die het mogelijk maakt om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur of bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels te stellen omtrent deze criteria.
d: criteria for calculating fees for reuse of information
criteria for calculating fees for reuse of information

parties: Asks how the re-use law relates to the Wob, whether refusals of re-use can be appealed, and whether the dwangsom regime should apply, focusing on the legal protection of requesters.
What objection and appeal options a requester has if a request for re-use is rejected by an institution to which the law applies.
Welke bezwaar-en beroepsmogelijkheden een verzoeker heeft als een verzoek om hergebruik wordt afgewezen door een instelling waar de wet betrekking op heeft.
Asks how often the discretionary power to refuse data is used, now that the directive makes disclosure the rule unless an exception applies.
The new directive introduces the obligation to make government information available unless an exception applies.
In de nieuwe richtlijn is de verplichting opgenomen om overheidsinformatie ter beschikking te stellen, tenzij zich een uitzonderingsgrond voordoet.
Asks which bodies refuse re-use and why, and whether refusals are practical or principled, along with the societal consequences of extending the law to schools and hospitals.
They ask whether such discussions could also arise after adoption of this law in public broadcasting, education, housing, culture and healthcare more broadly.
Zij vragen of dergelijke discussies zich ook voor kunnen doen na aanname van deze wet in de sectoren publieke omroep, onderwijs, huisvesting, cultuur en in de zorg in bredere zin.

Asks how the bill relates to the Wob amendment and the Wet open overheid, including the dwangsom, and warns that outsourcing public information to commercial publishers could weaken citizens' access and trust.
Is there not a danger that source, ownership and trust become unduly detached from one another?
Bestaat niet het gevaar dat bron, eigenaarschap en vertrouwen zo op ongewenste wijze los van elkaar komen te staan?
Asks why the government sees no value in a general right-to-re-use provision and why the re-use rules are exempt from the dwangsom regime while other requests are not.
They wonder what the underlying reasons are and why one type of request should be exempted while another should not.
Zij vragen zich af wat de daaraan ten grondslag liggende redenen zijn en waarom het ene type verzoek wel uitgezonderd zou moeten worden en het andere niet.
Shares D66's questions on a general re-use right, the separate treatment of archives, and the dwangsom exemption, and asks whether third-party personal data re-use is restricted.
They cannot find in the bill or the explanatory memorandum an explicit confirmation that re-use is not permitted where third parties have indicated they object to certain forms of re-use.

Zij kunnen in het wetsvoorstel noch de toelichting een expliciete bevestiging vinden dat hergebruik niet is toegestaan voor zover de met een publieke taak belaste instelling bij het verstrekken van de informatie heeft aangegeven dat deze derden kenbaar hebben gemaakt dat zij geen prijs stellen op bepaalde vormen van hergebruik.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the reuse of government information be regulated in a separate law rather than in the Wob, and asked for a dynamic reference to the directive's definition of 'openbaar lichaam' and for the cost rules to be set out in binding legislation rather than administrative practice. The minister's reply adopted the separate-law advice and the dynamic reference, and added the cost-setting criteria to the explanatory memorandum, while retaining the term 'met een publieke taak belaste instelling'.
concerns: The advisory division found that administrative practices cannot substitute for binding rules on the cost of reuse, so the cost framework must be in generally binding instruments; the government deferred to a tariff decree or regulation in the explanatory memorandum.

The advisory division advised that the reuse rules be placed in a separate law, since the reuse provisions no longer fit the openness purpose of the Wob and the scope now extends to semi-public bodies.
The advisory division advised a dynamic reference to the directive's definition of 'openbaar lichaam' to avoid national demarcation problems with existing concepts.

34204.s: The bill amends the Wft and related laws to implement EU Regulation 909/2014 on central securities depositories, giving the AFM and DNB supervisory and sanctioning powers, higher fines, and bans on leadership roles. It also adds licensing fees, notification duties and a reporting-procedure obligation for CSDs.
34204.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to meet the minimum sanctioning and fine requirements that the EU regulation imposes on national supervisors.
q: The regulation requires that the maximum administrative fine the supervisor may impose for a single serious infringement by a CSD or designated credit institution be at least 5 million euros.

Zo bepaalt de verordening dat de maximaal door de toezichthouder op te leggen bestuurlijke boete voor een afzonderlijke zware overtreding door een centrale effectenbewaarinstelling of een aangewezen kredietinstelling ten minste 5 miljoen euro bedraagt
d: fine amounts for CSDs and designated credit institutions
further rules on imposing leadership bans
ARTIKEL I, F (artikel 1:94 / kennisgeving via AMvB)
procedure for notifying changes to CSD operations
p: ARTIKEL I, E (artikel 1:87, tweede en derde lid)

Allows the supervisor to impose leadership bans on individuals for up to a year, or indefinitely for repeat offences, restricting their freedom to work, subject to general principles of good administration.
Raises the maximum administrative fine ceiling for CSDs and designated credit institutions, giving the supervisor greater sanctioning discretion.
Makes binding recommendations between supervisors excluded from appeal, removing a judicial remedy for disputes between DNB and the AFM.

parties: Asks what administrative and compliance costs the EU regulation causes for business, whether the impact assessment's 'no significant increase' is meaningful, and why no consultation took place on the implementing act.
What are the administrative costs and substantive compliance costs that flow from it?
Wat zijn de administratieve lasten en de inhoudelijke nalevingskosten die daaruit voortvloeien?
Asks whether the supervisor always vets the suitability and reliability of (day-to-day) policymakers of these institutions in advance.
The PvdA members ask whether the supervisor also always checks the suitability and reliability of (day-to-day) policymakers of these institutions in advance?
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de toezichthouder ook altijd vooraf de geschiktheid en betrouwbaarheid van (dagelijkse) beleidsbepalers van genoemde instellingen toets?
Welcomes risk-reducing legislation but questions the six-month licensing period and asks whether a temporary ban of one year is adequate for serious cases, rather than a longer or permanent ban.
Can the government indicate whether it considers it appropriate to ban persons from holding management positions for a longer period or even permanently in a serious case?
Kan de regering aangeven of zij het gepast vindt om – in een ernstig geval – personen voor langere tijd of zelfs permanent te verbieden leidinggevende functies uit te oefenen?

Asks where the regulation transfers powers to Europe, which Dutch standards become European ones, the conditions for banking ancillary services, the timetable for the supervision cost-recovery amendment, and the Financial Transaction Tax.
The CDA members ask the government to state exactly where this regulation transfers powers to Europe.'
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering exact aan te geven waar deze verordening zorgt voor een overdracht van bevoegdheden aan Europa

Asks whether the fine of 10% of turnover applies to institutions with EUR 200 million turnover, when a 'serious offence' occurs, what the maximum licensing and supervision costs are, and what the Commission's impact assessment found.
In addition, the PVV members ask when there can be a 'separate serious infringement'.
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie wanneer er sprake kan zijn van een «afzonderlijke zware overtreding».

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill implementing EU regulation 909/2014 on central securities depositories, asking for clarification of the relation with the Wge and adjustments to the ban on managerial functions and the maximum fine. The government's reply accepts most points, adds a paragraph on the Wge relationship, amends articles 1:87 and 1:81, and makes further drafting changes.
concerns: The Wge overlaps and conflicts with the regulation, so the Wge must be amended or its provisions removed; the government adds a paragraph explaining the relation and points to the parallel Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2016.

The temporary ban on managerial functions required by article 63(2)(d) of the regulation was not provided for less serious infringements; article 1:87 is amended to add a temporary ban and a new third paragraph.
The maximum fine in article 1:81(6) is narrower than the regulation's requirement of at least twice the profit; the government extends the power to twice the gain.
Editorial comments and a definition of central securities depository in article 1:1 are adopted, and the explanatory memorandum is supplemented with a transposition table.

34210-V.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting obligations, expenditure and revenue lines in the spring supplementary budget. It is a budgetary adjustment under the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, with the statement fixed by law and effective from 1 June 2015.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2015 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2015 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

34300-V.s: This bill fixes the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at EUR 9,044.1 million in expenditure and EUR 2,467.8 million in receipts, in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2016. The explanatory memorandum excerpts concern foreign-policy priorities and ministerial coordination tasks rather than any delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2016 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34303.s: The bill exempts payments under the Article 2 Fund (German-funded compensation for Holocaust victims) from Dutch income tax, with retroactive effect to 1 January 2016 possible by royal decree. It also removes the knock-on effects of those payments on income-dependent schemes.
34303.j: The memorandum justifies the tax exemption as a legislative choice within the legislature's wide margin of discretion, which courts are expected to respect, since the Hoge Raad held that only the legislator can decide whether such payments should be taxed.
q: It expects that the court in a possible procedure will also be able to follow this choice and the arguments put forward, and will rule that the legislator has not exceeded its wide margin of discretion.

Het verwacht dat ook de rechter in een mogelijke procedure deze keuze en de aangevoerde argumenten zal kunnen volgen en zal oordelen dat de wetgever niet zijn ruime beoordelingsvrijheid heeft overschreden.
d: effective date and retroactive effect of the Act

parties: Welcomes the bill and asks only for clarification of the date from which the payments are actually exempt for benefit-entitlement purposes.
These members had already asked in earlier written questions about the possibilities to exempt these payments and are satisfied that the government is giving effect to this through this bill.
Deze leden hebben al eerder via schriftelijke vragen gevraagd naar de mogelijkheden om deze uitkeringen vrij te stellen en zijn tevreden dat de regering via dit wetsvoorstel daar invulling aan geeft.
Endorses the bill as legally sound and workable and raises no further questions.
They thank the government and in particular the State Secretary for the efforts to find a solution that both does justice to the war victims and offers a legally sound and workable situation.

Zij danken de regering en in het bijzonder de Staatssecretaris voor de inspanningen om een oplossing te vinden die zowel recht doet aan de oorlogsslachtoffers, alsook een juridisch houdbare en werkbare situatie biedt.
Asks why the exemption took so long, whether it could be extended to victims in Indonesia, and about budgetary effects and retroactivity, probing the government's reasoning.
Why does the Netherlands not come up with a similar arrangement for these victims, all the more so since Dutch responsibility is also at stake there?
Waarom komt Nederland niet met een soortgelijke regeling voor deze getroffenen te meer omdat daar ook een Nederlandse verantwoordelijkheid te nemen is?
Supports the exemption but questions the government's justification and budgetary reasoning, and notes that ultimately a judge will decide whether the arguments hold.
These members, however, miss the argument that Germany specifically agreed with the Netherlands that the payment is untaxed.
Deze leden missen echter het argument dat Duitsland specifiek met Nederland afgesproken heeft dat de uitkering onbelast is.
Asks whether the taxing right lies with Germany under the treaty, whether other war-victim groups could claim the exemption via equality, and whether a court would ultimately judge the justification.
Is it correct that the final judgment rests with the court on whether the arguments cited by the government are sufficiently sound to justify the exemption, ask the members of the PVV faction.
Klopt het dat het uiteindelijk oordeel bij de rechter ligt of de door de regering aangehaalde argumenten voldoende steekhoudend zijn voor de vrijstelling, vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Welcomes the exemption and has no additional questions.
The members of the D66 faction have read with pleasure the bill by which the payments from the Artikel 2-Fonds are tax-exempt.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben verheugd kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel waarmee de uitkeringen uit het Artikel 2-Fonds fiscaal worden vrijgesteld.
Supports the exemption but asks how other European countries handled the risk that the distinction could fail under the ECHR.
In what way did they take into account the risk that the distinction made in tax laws might not withstand scrutiny under the ECHR, ask these members.

Op welke manier heeft men hierbij dan rekening gehouden met het risico dat het gemaakte onderscheid in belastingwetten op grond van het EVRM mogelijk niet stand zou kunnen houden, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that the bill exempting Artikel 2-Fonds benefits from income tax can be justified under the equality principle given the exceptional circumstances and the wide margin granted to the fiscal legislator, but asks for alternatives to be examined and the explanatory memorandum supplemented. The government's reply accepts the request to add alternatives and explains why fiscal alternatives such as bruteren or eindheffing were rejected, and it made redactional changes and an addition to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum examine and motivate alternatives to a tax exemption, since the choice is not substantiated; the government explains non-fiscal and fiscal alternatives were considered and rejected, and the memorandum was supplemented on this point.

The Afdeling assesses the bill against the equality principle (art. 1 Grondwet, art. 26 IVBPR, art. 14 EVRM) and finds the differential treatment plausibly justifiable, though whether the situations are comparable remains uncertain for the courts.

34321.s: The bill amends the Wet privatisering ABP to make technical changes and to allow employers of public-sector workers, on request, to be exempted from mandatory participation in the ABP pension fund for net pension, with conditions set by the fund. It also adds a provision on how already-granted pensions are adjusted when the indexation method changes.
34321.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as following from decentralisation of collective bargaining in education and as needed to avoid competition on employment conditions, without explaining the delegated indexation or exemption rules in detail.
q: To prevent this from leading to competition on employment conditions, the permission is tied to the condition that an alternative chosen must allow accrual of an entitlement equivalent to the ABP's.

Om te voorkomen dat hiermee op arbeidsvoorwaarden wordt geconcurreerd wordt de toestemming gebonden aan de voorwaarde dat bij een te kiezen alternatief een aan het ABP gelijkwaardige aanspraak kan worden opgebouwd.
d: conditions for exemption from ABP net pension scheme
change or replacement of indexation method by sector employers and union centrals
p: Allows indexation of already-granted pensions to be changed by agreement between sector employers and public-sector unions, departing from the statutory rule without statutory limits on the change.
Lets the fund set the conditions for exemption from the net pension scheme, subject to the requirement that alternative schemes be at least equivalent to the fund's benefits.

parties: Asks why the bill came so late, why the statutory changes were not made earlier, whether legislation is needed for indexation choice, and what conditions the ABP foundation sets for exemptions.
Why is this change only now being made for civil servants in the Wet Privatisering ABP, the VVD members ask.
Waarom wordt deze wijziging nu pas voor ambtenaren in de Wet Privatisering ABP aangebracht, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.

Asks whether the pensioen-age provision should be deleted because it could encourage dismissal and rehiring, and whether the Act contains legal barriers to frequent changes of indexation method; questions why the ABP rather than social partners assesses exemptions.
Moreover, it could tempt employers to dismiss someone at the AOW age and rehire them without the obligation to accrue pension.
Sterker nog: het zou werkgevers in de verleiding kunnen brengen iemand op de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd te ontslaan en daarna weer in dienst te nemen zonder de verplichting tot pensioenopbouw.

Opposes the switch from wage to price indexation as a worsening of pension terms, questions the limited bargaining room implied by the continuity remark, asks for figures on past outcomes, and wants the bill postponed until the wage agreement effects are clear.
They are of the view that this is a worsening of the pension conditions of (former) employees.
Zij zijn van mening dat dit een verslechtering is van de pensioenvoorwaarden van de (voormalige) werknemers.

Leaves the substance of social partners' agreements to them but asks whether switching pension indexation could amount to expropriation under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR for rights accrued before 1996, and whether the government obtained legal advice.
They do, however, ask the government whether, for example, Article 1 of the First Protocol to the ECHR could involve expropriation of pension rights accrued before 1996.
Zij vragen echter aan de regering of er bijvoorbeeld onder artikel 1 van het eerste protocol EVRM sprake zou kunnen zijn van onteigening bij pensioenrechten die voor 1996 zijn opgebouwd.

Questions the consequences of switching to price indexation for pension outcomes across age groups, notes the government cannot say the effects for 25-year-olds, asks whether the change is consistent with the ABP privatisation promises and the Act's aim, and presses the government on FNV's arguments.
The 50PLUS member also observes that paying less premium appears in any case to pose a risk to indexation in the future.
Het lid van de 50PLUS-fractie stelt ook vast, dat het inleggen van minder premie hoe dan ook een risico lijkt te vormen voor het kunnen indexeren in de toekomst.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet privatisering ABP can proceed to the Tweede Kamer, but that the entry-into-force provision should be adapted by dropping the Wrr article 12 expedited procedure for article I, since retroactive effect does not require it. The minister's reply states that the advice was followed by deleting the application of article 12 Wrr in article II and making some technical improvements.
concerns: The Afdeling advised dropping the application of the expedited procedure of article 12 Wrr, because retroactive effect can be granted within the normal procedure and the exception should be applied restrictively.

34330.s: The bill adds a statutory basis to the Wet BIG allowing the BIG number to be used for transparency about financial relations between health professionals and companies, via a register set by general administrative order. It also introduces a ban on inducements (gunstbetoon) for medical devices, with exceptions, and extends the IGZ's fine power to cover breaches of the new article 10h.
34330.j: The memorandum justifies the BIG-number basis by transparency about financial relations and the need to give the IGZ a legal basis for supervision, following advice from the Raad van State.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order it may be determined that the number referred to in article 3(2) is used to promote transparency regarding financial relations between professionals and companies.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kan worden bepaald dat het nummer, bedoeld in artikel 3, tweede lid, wordt gebruikt ter bevordering van transparantie inzake financiële betrekkingen
d: use of BIG number for financial transparency register
p: Inducement ban with enumerated exceptions and administrative fines, with details of fine levels left to ministerial policy rules.

parties: Asks who decides whether hospitality stays within reasonable limits and subordinate to purpose, and how oversight of this exception works.
Criticises the lack of transparency, the delayed publication in the register, the weak Transparantieregister geneesmiddelen, and the limitative exceptions, and asks for more control.
Why has the IGZ's supervision of advertising and gunstbetoon decreased so much and why is no annual thematic investigation carried out anymore?
Waarom is het toezicht van de IGZ op reclame en gunstbetoon zo veel minder geworden en waarom wordt geen jaarlijks thematisch onderzoek meer gedaan?
Finds the bill vague and open to interpretation, wants concrete limits and a full ban rather than many exceptions, and doubts the IGZ can enforce it.
Why does the government not choose a complete ban on gunstbetoon?
Waarom kiest de regering niet voor een volledig verbod op gunstbetoon?
Asks what triggers IGZ enforcement, whether it has discretion to skip lighter violations, the fine level, the IGZ's capacity, and where the mandate from the minister to the IGZ is regulated.
Where is the delegation of this power from the Minister to the IGZ regulated?
Waar is de mandatering van deze bevoegdheid van de Minister aan de IGZ geregeld?
Welcomes IGZ enforcement and fines but wants fines high enough to deter and stricter exceptions, especially for training events.
Gifts in the form of goods, services or money should never be allowed, and certainly not in the context of (post-)training.
Geschenken in de vorm van goederen, diensten of geld mogen nooit toegestaan worden, en al helemaal niet in het kader van (na)scholing.
Supports the bill as an extra step against undesirable influence, asking for comparison with the Geneesmiddelenwet and warning about effects on independent research sponsorship.
Because they find this undesirable, they support this proposal.
Omdat zij dit onwenselijk vinden staan zij achter dit voorstel.

34402.s: The bill tightens requirements for examination committees in Dutch senior vocational education (mbo) by setting out their mandatory composition, independence, and tasks and powers in the Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, and by adding an institutional certificate for partially completed programmes. It applies the same changes to the Caribbean Netherlands version of the law and makes transitional and technical amendments.
34402.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by stating that the Algemene maatregel van bestuur can add detail and that the quality of examinations has long been inadequate, so statutory clarity is needed.
q: Because of the public importance of diplomas, parliament gains a say over these tasks and requirements through inclusion in the WEB.
Vanwege het maatschappelijk belang van diploma's krijgt het parlement – door opname in de WEB – zeggenschap over deze taken en eisen.
d: central examination committee tasks assigned by the competent authority
further rules on examination committee tasks and powers, additional tasks
examination committee rules on performing its tasks and measures against candidates
examination committee may bar fraudulent candidates from exams for up to one year
p: Bars board members and financially responsible persons from examination committees unless conflict-of-interest rules are adopted, with the committee itself setting those rules.

Examination committee may exclude a candidate from examinations for up to a year and the competent authority may end enrolment on committee proposal in cases of serious fraud, without judicial review specified.

parties: Doubts that the bill plus mandatory purchase of certified exams will bring real change, and asks why an accreditation-style system giving examination committees a stronger role was not chosen.
Asks whether examination committee members with management roles and financial responsibility could create conflicts of interest with the independence the bill seeks.
Could the fact that they also bear financial responsibility sometimes conflict with the wish to prevent conflicts of interest?
Kan het gegeven dat dezen ook financiële verantwoordelijkheid dragen, wel eens op gespannen voet staan met de wens om belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen?
Questions the added value of the bill over existing measures and asks why stricter inspectorate supervision or sector agreements would not suffice.
What is the reason that stricter supervision by the Inspectorate of Education on the problems named in the bill cannot suffice?
Wat is de reden dat niet volstaan kan worden met scherper toezicht van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (onderwijsinspectie) op de in het wetsvoorstel genoemde knelpunten?
Questions why additional exam requirements are imposed only on mbo rather than emphasising quality management, noting the inspectorate's criticism and the risk of two standards.
Is this not measuring with two different yardsticks, these members ask.
Wordt er zo niet met twee maten gemeten, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether clearer statutory tasks for examination committees are the main remedy for their inadequate functioning and how professionalisation will be pursued.
In what way, for example, is work being done on the professionalisation of examination committees, they ask.
Op welke manier wordt bijvoorbeeld werk gemaakt van de professionalisering van examencommissies, zo vragen zij.

Objects that the mandatory purchase and external validation are to be set by general administrative order rather than in the formal statute, seeing it as a substantial infringement on freedom in examining, and questions its fit with the WEB framework.

34411.s: The bill approves the 2013 Brussels Agreement creating a Unified Patent Court (EOG), a court common to the participating EU member states, for the European part of the Netherlands. It establishes the court's jurisdiction over European patent disputes, with transitional opt-out and national-court options, and its entry into force is tied to the Agreement and the application of the EU unitary patent regulations.
34411.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer of patent jurisdiction by citing efficiency gains, reduced risk of divergent rulings, and legal certainty for businesses.
q: The UPC holds exclusive jurisdiction over specified disputes concerning European patents with and without unitary effect.
Het EOG beschikt over een exclusieve bevoegdheid voor met name genoemde geschillen met betrekking tot Europese octrooien met en zonder eenheidswerking.
p: Approval of the agreement transfers exclusive jurisdiction over European patent disputes from Dutch national courts to the supranational Unified Patent Court, removing those cases from the national judiciary.

parties: Asks why national judges cannot keep patent jurisdiction and whether the court's judges are strictly independent and how Dutch interests can be protected if they are harmed.
These members ask why another model was not chosen, in which national judges remain competent for the European patent.
Deze leden vragen waarom er niet is gekozen voor een ander model, waarbij nationale rechters bevoegd blijven inzake het Europese octrooi.
Asks about the likelihood of timely entry into force given the UK's position, effects on business and innovation, employment and the division of patent revenues.
How large does the government consider the chance that the unified patent court will start in 2016 or early 2017.
Hoe groot acht de regering de kans dat het eengemaakt octrooigerecht nog in 2016 of begin 2017 van start gaat.

Asks whether the court's powers, including home searches under Article 60, are necessary, whether they could conflict with national judges, whether subsidiarity and proportionality were tested, and why there is no evaluation clause.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the Unified Patent Court Agreement is acceptable but that the explanatory memorandum should justify that approval does not deviate from the Constitution (arts. 17 and 112) and that the use of the fast-track entry into force under art. 12 of the Referendum Act needs substantive justification. The government's reply (nader rapport) added explanation on constitutional compatibility and on the urgency of early entry into force, and partly rebutted the fast-track concern.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address whether conferring civil jurisdiction on an international court deviates from Constitution arts. 17 and 112, and the government added this analysis.
The international court must meet independence and impartiality requirements under Constitution art. 17 and ECHR arts. 5 and 6, and the memorandum now explains compliance.

The use of the accelerated entry-into-force procedure under art. 12 of the Referendum Act must be substantively justified, or be dropped; the government reasoned urgency but kept the procedure in substance.
Redactional remarks on the explanatory memorandum were incorporated.

34475-I.s: This bill adopts the final budget adjustment (slotwet) to the 2015 budget of the Crown (begrotingsstaat van de Koning), amending expenditure and revenue figures in three articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved, as We hereby deem fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

34475-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statements (slotwet) for the ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs and for its executive agencies, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue figures after the supplementary budgets. It sets the implementation date as the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year, and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and the budget statement on the executive agencies, both for the year 2015.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de baten-lastenagentschappen, alle voor het jaar 2015.

34501.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act and the Aviation Act for the BES islands to implement EU aviation security regulations (EG 300/2008 and related implementing rules), assigning responsibilities for airports, airlines and entities to the Minister of Security and Justice and the Royal Marechaussee. It also introduces continuous screening of airport personnel with access to restricted zones and broadens ministerial authority to grant exemptions and issue binding instructions.
34501.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to operationalise EU security standards and to allow flexible, rapid responses to new threats and modus operandi.
q: Because of constantly new threats and modus operandi, it is also necessary that European regulation be flexible enough to respond quickly by drafting new security measures.

Vanwege steeds nieuwe dreigingen en modus operandi is het daarnaast noodzakelijk dat de Europese regelgeving zodanig flexibel is dat hierop snel kan worden ingespeeld door het opstellen van nieuwe beveiligingsmaatregelen.
d: content of security programmes and monitoring methods
detailed rules on access control, security screening and irregularities
procedure for approval of detection equipment
requirements on training institutions' organisation and management
detailed rules on background checks and training/career review
categories of persons subject to continuous screening
exemptions from and derogations of basic security standards
exemptions from screening of cargo and post
exemptions from security measures for certain airports
p: The Minister may issue binding instructions to airport operators, airlines and entities on compliance with security obligations, broadening executive direction over private actors.
Introduces continuous screening of airport workers' criminal records by the Justice Ministry, with access to justice data, subject to a proportionality assessment and a privacy impact assessment.
Ministerial power to grant exemptions from basic security standards, revocable when conditions are not met or security requires it.
Authorises administrative enforcement by order under administrative coercion and penalty payments for breaches of the Act and EU regulation.
Allows opening of letters entrusted to airlines for transport, without consent of sender or addressee, on order of an examining magistrate where prohibited items are suspected.

parties: Asks whether national measures exceed EU minimum standards, who defines proportionality, and whether the implementation changes anything in practice.
To what extent has the implementation in national legislation deviated from the prescribed European minimum standards?
In hoeverre is met de implementatie in nationale wetgeving afgeweken van de voorgeschreven Europese minimumnormen?
