Doubts the relaxation of screening for a group of airport staff and proposes a limited role for the AIVD via a notification duty from Dienst Justis.
The aforementioned members are not yet convinced that this is a correct adjustment.
Voornoemde leden zijn er nog niet van overtuigd dat dit een juiste aanpassing is.
Asks the government to reconsider not applying continuous screening to all airport staff holding a VGB, citing security risks at public areas after the Zaventem attacks.
In short, the CDA members would like the government to take the safe option on this point and legally secure general continuous screening of airport personnel.

Kortom, de leden van de CDA-fractie zouden graag zien dat de regering juist op dit punt wél het zekere voor het onzekere neemt en een algemene continue screening van luchthavenpersoneel wettelijk borgt.
Questions the reliability of self-signed declarations of criminal history, the scope of exemptions, and why continuous screening cannot be linked to VGB holders under the Wet veiligheidsonderzoeken.
How reliable does the government consider a person's own signed statement about possible criminal antecedents?
Hoe betrouwbaar acht de regering een verklaring van een persoon over zijn eventuele criminele antecedenten die hij of zij vervolgens zelf ondertekent?
Supports uniform EU security but asks for safeguards on privacy, BSN use, the convenant, and procedures and remedies for staff whose access is blocked after a signal letter.
However, it is of the utmost importance that the use of the BSN is handled carefully, in order to minimise the risk of fraud and identity falsification.
Het is echter van het grootste belang dat met het gebruik van het BSN zorgvuldig wordt omgegaan, teneinde het risico van fraude en identiteitsvervalsing te minimaliseren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill implementing EU aviation security Regulation 300/2008 but requested changes on the competent authority designation, transitional law, background screening, continuous screening, privacy safeguards, delegation clauses and consultation of Bonaire bodies. The government's nader rapport reports that most points were followed, with the privacy safeguards request not followed because existing GDPR-based obligations were deemed sufficient.
concerns: The bill's exception clause 'tenzij bij deze wet anders is bepaald' in designating the competent authority was contrary to the EU regulation and was removed.
Transitional provisions were unclear and seemed to suggest EU obligations need not yet be met; the government removed the unnecessary transitional rules on applications and appeals.
Continuous screening was limited to VOG-holders after the government explained the rationale, though the Afdeling questioned excluding other vetted groups.
The Afdeling asked that privacy safeguards on use of the citizen service number for continuous screening be anchored in an AMvB; the government declined, citing existing Wbp obligations.
Delegation clauses were to be limited more concretely and precisely; the government narrowed them and removed one delegation clause.
Consultation of Bonaire government bodies and Flamingo Airport was to be arranged before sending the bill to parliament; this was done.
Several technical and redactional corrections were proposed and incorporated in the revised bill.

34960-J.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) by a first supplementary budget, shifting amounts between articles and years via a cash-flow reallocation within the fund. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
34960-J.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments by the need to reallocate available funds through a cash-flow shift within the Deltafonds to the correct years.
q: To finance this, available funds are moved to the correct years within the Deltafonds through a cash-flow shift.
Ter financiering hiervan worden beschikbare gelden middels een kasschuif binnen het Deltafonds naar de juiste jaren gebracht.

35000-X.s: This bill formally adopts the 2019 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Defence and the 2019 budget statement for its agencies, setting expenditure and receipt amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 January 2019, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.

35005.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bankruptcy Act so that transfer orders entered into payment and securities settlement systems, and certain other agreements, under the law of non-EU states supervised by an authority meeting conditions set by general administrative order (AMvB), are final and not retroactively undone by a participant's bankruptcy. It also lets the Minister of Finance designate such systems and requires De Nederlandsche Bank to notify systems of bankruptcies, with rules to be set by AMvB.
35005.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB and ministerial designation powers by the need for quality-controlled systems and practical notification arrangements that DNB cannot achieve by itself.
q: In this way a safeguard is built in that the systems concerned are of sufficient quality and function adequately.
Op die wijze wordt een waarborg ingebouwd dat het gaat om systemen die voldoende kwaliteit hebben en adequaat functioneren.
d: ARTIKEL I A (artikel 212a, onderdeel b, onder 3°)
conditions for supervisory authority of non-EU systems
conditions for supervisor of other agreements
rules on DNB notification of bankruptcy to systems
p: Non-EU systems and agreements become exempt from the midnight retroactivity rule, with the supervisory conditions left to an AMvB rather than the statute.

parties: No concerns raised; the VVD sees no reason for further questions and looks forward to swift further parliamentary treatment.
They currently see no reason to ask further questions on this and look forward to a swift continuation of the parliamentary process.
Zij zien thans geen aanleiding hierover nadere vragen te stellen en zien uit naar een spoedig vervolg van de parlementaire behandeling.
Recognises the bill contributes to a more robust financial system and has no further questions.
They acknowledge that this bill contributes to a more robust financial system.
Zij erkennen dat dit wetsvoorstel bij draagt een robuuster financieel stelsel.
Supports the stability goals but asks about the causes of Dutch banks' use of third-country systems, whether this poses risks, and the legal regime applicable to foreign system operators.
They support the underlying goals of stability in the international financial system.
Zij steunen de achterliggende doelen van stabiliteit van het internationale financiële systeem.
Questions why the expansion of the finality rule is not limited, whether stakeholder lobbying shaped the bill, and why structural solutions to bank problems are not pursued.
These members ask the government why it did not limit the expansion of the scope of the finality rule.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom zij de uitbreiding van de reikwijdte van de finaliteitsregel niet begrensd heeft.

35032.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU Directive 2017/2455 on VAT for cross-border services and distance sales of goods, creating a small-business threshold of EUR 10,000 for cross-border B2C digital services and changing invoicing rules and non-EU trader definitions, effective 1 January 2019. It mostly sets rules in statute and leaves only procedural details of the notification to the tax inspector and ministerial regulation.
35032.j: The explanatory memorandum says the tax inspector and a ministerial regulation may set procedural details of the notification, especially deadlines, without giving a substantive reason for the delegation.
q: By ministerial regulation further rules may be set concerning the notification.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de melding.
d: further rules on notification of election to apply the Netherlands rule
manner of notification set by the tax inspector

parties: Asks why the EUR 10,000 threshold was chosen and how the claimed regulatory burden reduction will be monitored and secured.
How is it monitored and ensured that the proposal actually leads to regulatory burden reduction and fewer administrative costs?
Hoe wordt gemonitord en geborgd dat het voorstel daadwerkelijk tot regeldrukreductie en minder administratieve lasten leidt?
Accepts the burden reduction but questions the fairness of shifting VAT to the supplier's country and asks the government to justify the directive's logic.
Can the government therefore address the fairness of the shift from the consumer's country to the entrepreneur's country that follows from the directive?
Kan de regering daarom ingaan op de rechtvaardigheid van de uit de richtlijn volgende schuif van het land van de consument naar het land van de ondernemer?
Asks how large rate differences between member states are and how much revenue the Netherlands loses when suppliers pay VAT in lower-rate states.
how much tax revenue the Netherlands annually loses because entrepreneurs pay VAT in a member state with a lower rate.
hoeveel belastinginkomsten Nederland jaarlijks misloopt doordat ondernemers btw betalen in een lidstaat met een lager tarief.
Asks why the EUR 10,000 threshold is fixed at the 5 December 2017 exchange rate and the effect of Brexit-related currency changes.
What is the reason for choosing this? After all, a possible devaluation of the euro due to Brexit could have considerable consequences.
Wat is de reden om hiervoor te kiezen? Immers kan een eventuele devaluatie van de euro door de Brexit flinke gevolgen hebben.

35041.s: The bill abolishes the legal personality of the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven so it fits the framework law on independent administrative bodies, and extends the fund's assistance to victims of violent crime in the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba). It also clarifies how benefits are paid, that the fund's payments do not reduce victims' claims against third parties, and allows ministerial regulations to set rules for decisions on other victims.
35041.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation power by saying temporary arrangements may be needed in the future that the fund would implement, which cannot be delegated under existing law.
q: It is conceivable that temporary arrangements will need to be made in the future, implemented by the Schadefonds, for which, unlike the example given, there is no legal basis for mandating.

Het is denkbaar dat in de toekomst tijdelijke regelingen moeten worden getroffen, die worden uitgevoerd door het Schadefonds, waarbij er – anders dan in het gegeven voorbeeld – geen rechtsgrondslag is voor mandatering.
d: detailed rules on commission decisions for victims other than those in article 3 and 20
p: Allows the minister to set by ministerial regulation who may receive compensation from the fund outside the statutory categories, with the scope left to the regulation.

Lets the commission require victims to assign claims against third parties to the State and to recover benefits after payment, while the memorandum states that bezwaar and beroep remain open against such decisions.

parties: Asks whether the fixed maximum payment amounts have been adjusted for inflation since 2012 and why the amendment to article 4(2) was not included in the version sent to the Council of State.
Is it correct that the amounts have not been changed since 1 January 2012?
Is het juist dat de bedragen sinds 1 januari 2012 niet meer zijn gewijzigd?
Asks why the 2012 reform did not check the additional requirements for autonomous administrative bodies and how the fund's data exchange with police and prosecutors will be legally grounded.
Does the government acknowledge the problems outlined by the Schadefonds?
Erkent de regering de door het Schadefonds geschetste problematiek?
Asks how the extension to the public bodies relates to existing damage-claim options there, whether overlaps are efficient, and how the open-ended budget and procurement cost risk will be managed.
Can the government further explain its risk assessment on this point?
Kan de regering haar risicoafweging op dit punt nader toelichten?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet schadefonds geweldsmisdrijven: removing the fund's legal personality, clarifying that payments do not limit full compensation, extending the law to Caribbean Netherlands, and narrowing a broad delegation for data exchange. The government's reply accepted most points, including dropping the 'fonds' label, adding a transitional retroactive date of 1 January 2017 for the Caribbean islands, and amending the delegation article, while declining to set a fixed reclaim period.
concerns: The Afdeling advised removing the fund's status as a legal entity ('fonds') from the law, since in practice it is only a budget line and the label causes confusion; the government adopted this and amended articles 1, 3, 8 and 13.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of how the budget line is managed if payments exceed or threaten to exceed the appropriation; the government added explanation to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling noted that fund payments are not full compensation and asked how deductions from other compensation are handled; the government explained the approach in the commentary on article 6, third paragraph, without changing the text otherwise.
The Afdeling advised deleting the last sentence of article 6(3) requiring notice of the offset decision, as general administrative law already covers notification; the government removed it.

The Afdeling asked how long recovery of overpaid amounts may take place; the government considered a five-year limit but decided not to fix a period, given offenders may be found years later and the principle that the offender pays.

The Afdeling objected that a ministerial regulation was too broad a basis for data exchange and that such matters belong in a general administrative order; the government amended article 19 and clarified existing data-exchange rules.

The Afdeling observed that limiting payments to injuries from offences committed after entry into force was unexplained and suggested retroactive effect as at the earlier Caribbean extension; the government agreed and set retroactive effect from 1 January 2017.

35050.s: The bill replaces the planning system for starting new public and private primary and secondary schools with a new application procedure, under which a school is funded if the expected pupil numbers (via parental declarations or market research) and a quality check by the inspectorate support it, rather than the school's denominational orientation. It also adds integrity requirements (certificates of conduct, bans after orders) and amends related school-law provisions, with transitional rules and ministerial rule-making on procedures and thresholds.
35050.j: The memorandum justifies the new quality-based start procedure by Article 23 of the Constitution's requirement of government care for education quality and the need to better match school starts to genuine parental demand.
q: That responsibility can be better fulfilled if a quality check is already part of the start procedure.
Aan die verantwoordelijkheid kan beter invulling worden gegeven als een kwaliteitstoets al deel uitmaakt van de startprocedure.
d: application procedure, model forms, belangstellingsmeting rules, correction factor, stichtingsnorm
conditions for spinning off a school location
procedures for new secondary schools and belangstellingsmeting, model application
detailed rules and model for application to receive funding
p: The minister may refuse a new school application from legal entities previously subject to an order under the school-law enforcement provisions, giving discretion to refuse funding.`
Extends the period in which new schools must reach enrolment norms before closure from five to eight school years, and adds closure triggers for schools below half the norm in the fourth year.
Allows the minister in special cases to permit maintenance of a public school or funding of a private school outside the normal statutory rules.

parties: Supports more room for new schools but wants quality guaranteed through a pre-start check by the Inspectorate and scrutiny of prospective board members.
They agree that the freedom of education guaranteed in Article 23 of the Constitution must not be a licence to provide poor-quality education.
Zij onderschrijven dat de vrijheid van onderwijs die gegarandeerd wordt in artikel 23 van de Grondwet geen vrijbrief mag zijn om kwalitatief slecht onderwijs te geven.

Supports the freedom of education and the goal of better matching parental wishes, but worries about quality checks being reduced to procedural checks and about the consequences for schools in shrinking regions.
At the same time they see tension regarding the requirements arising from Article 23 of the Constitution as to when a quality check actually adds value.
Tegelijkertijd zien zij spanning ten aanzien van de eisen voortvloeiende uit artikel 23 van de Grondwet ten aanzien van het moment waarop een kwaliteitstoets daadwerkelijk toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Supports modernising the rules but asks about competition, fragmentation of provision, and whether a pre-start quality test can predict real quality.
These members want to prevent the advance quality test from creating a paper reality that barely predicts the actual quality of education.
Deze leden willen voorkomen dat er met de kwaliteitstoets vooraf een papieren werkelijkheid ontstaat die nauwelijks voorspelt wat de werkelijke kwaliteit van onderwijs wordt.
Worried the bill increases segregation and commercial interests in education and asks for safeguards such as a check on segregation and open access.
These members have great concerns that this bill will increase segregation in education even further.
Deze leden hebben grote zorgen dat dit wetsvoorstel de segregatie in het onderwijs nog meer vergroot.
Asks many questions on competition, marketing spending, voluntary parental contributions, teacher shortages and effects on existing schools, and on access rights of pupils.
These members are also concerned about the (high) voluntary parental contribution that may arise from, for example, innovative schools.
Deze leden maken zich ook zorgen over de (hoge) vrijwillige ouderbijdrage die kan ontstaan als gevolg van bijvoorbeeld innovatieve scholen.
Fears segregation through single-group schools and asks how all children can meet diverse backgrounds; also questions the abandonment of richting and the role of commercial actors.
How does the government assess the risk that this will reinforce segregation in education through so-called single-purpose schools for every possible specific target group?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering het risico dat hiermee de segregatie in het onderwijs wordt versterkt doordat er zogenoemde «hokjesscholen» voor alle mogelijke specifieke doelgroepen worden opgericht.
Welcomes modernising the start procedure and keeping richting legally protected, but asks whether all boards should face the same pre-start checks, especially existing school boards.
Should existing school boards not be exempted from the obligation to undergo a quality check and provide a certificate of conduct before starting a new school?
Zouden bestaande schoolbesturen niet uitgezonderd moeten worden van de verplichting om voor het starten van een nieuwe school een kwaliteitstoets te ondergaan en een VOG af te geven?
Sees risks in loosening founding possibilities, doubts the value of a paper-based quality check, and asks why the founding norms are not part of the bill.
These members note that copying such a system a century later in a society that has changed in character is not without risks.
Deze leden constateren echter dat het niet zonder risico’s is om een dergelijke systematiek een eeuw later te kopiëren in een samenleving die van karakter is veranderd.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill 'Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen' should not be sent to parliament until its remarks are addressed, notably on broadening the concept of 'richting', the reliability of enrolment forecasts, impacts on existing schools, municipal housing timelines, leerlingenvervoer, and a pre-start quality test. The minister's nader rapport reports that most points were followed, including deleting the broadened richting passages, retaining substitute core objectives, adding detail on forecasts and quality test, but rejected the transitional arrangement for existing schools.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that passages broadening the concept of richting, which would affect the freedom of richting under Article 23 Constitution, be removed; the government agreed.

Key conditions for the new planning system, including reliability of forecasting methods, should be set out in the statute rather than only in ministerial regulation; the government added main lines to the bill.
The added value of the proposal was insufficiently justified given parental satisfaction and low school founding numbers; the government expanded historical context and justification.
The pre-start quality test and its criteria were not shown to be necessary, relevant, objective and proportionate; the government narrowed the test and expanded justification.
The Afdeling advised a transitional arrangement protecting good existing schools from falling below closure norms, especially in shrinking areas; the government declined..
Municipal timelines for providing housing were considered unrealistic; the government adjusted deadlines to align with municipal budget cycles while keeping existing housing provisions.
Effects on leerlingenvervoer and on the scope of recognised religious or philosophical groups were unclear; the government clarified that existing recognised richtingen remain relevant for transport.
Retaining the substitute core objectives in primary education (WPO) was advised and adopted by the government.

35104.s: The bill abolishes the ministerial fusion test (fusietoets) for schools in primary, secondary and special education, replacing it with a mandatory fusion-effect report that boards must prepare and that is no longer approved by the Minister. It amends the Wet op het primair onderwijs, Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs, Wet op de expertisecentra and Wet medezeggenschap op scholen accordingly.
35104.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing the fusion test by arguing that it duplicates existing local checks and that the medezeggenschapsraad and internal supervisory boards should bear horizontal accountability instead.
q: It no longer fits that the Minister passes a final judgment on a merger, when the works council, as representative of the school community, has already agreed to it.
Hier past niet langer bij dat de Minister een eindoordeel velt over een fusie, waar de medezeggenschapsraad – als vertegenwoordiging van de gemeenschap van de school – reeds mee heeft ingestemd.
d: model form for fusion-effect report in secondary education
model form for fusion-effect report in expertise centres
Artikel II, D (art. 72 lid 1 sub a WVO)
percentage of pupils from same postcode areas required for funding of merged schools
Artikel II, E (art. 72a lid 1 sub a en b WVO)
percentage of pupils from same postcode areas for vertical school communities
p: Artikel I, A-D; Artikel II, A-C; Artikel III, A-D
Removes the Minister's approval power over school mergers in primary, secondary and special education, eliminating an ex ante ministerial check on institutional and administrative fusions.
Artikel II, D en E (art. 72, 72a WVO)
Lets the Minister grant funding to merged schools based on postcode-area percentages set by ministerial regulation, while retaining a municipal-proximity alternative.

parties: Asks what impact abolishing the fusion test will have on medezeggenschapsraden and whether they are equipped for the added pressure.
Does abolishing the fusion test lead to more pressure on the medezeggenschapsraden?
Leidt het afschaffen van de fusietoets tot meer druk op medezeggenschapsraden?
Supports the bill's aims but asks how the menselijke maat is safeguarded and what role parents' councils play, and whether regions with a single dominant board limit parental choice.
These members request further explanation from the government on how this is then safeguarded.
Deze leden vragen een nadere toelichting van de regering op hoe dit dan geborgd wordt.
Favours giving schools room and trust with local checks and balances, but asks how the government will oversee the supply of public education and choice after the national test disappears.
These members ask the government to explain how, from its system responsibility, it will supervise coverage of public education and a broad offer so pupils and parents keep choice.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe het vanuit de stelselverantwoordelijkheid gaat toezien op de dekking van openbaar onderwijs en een breed aanbod
Critical of growing consolidation in education; warns that removing the fusion test may foster monopoly positions (e.g. LVO Maastricht) and asks how diversity and parental choice will be guaranteed.
How does the government prevent similar scenarios in other shrinking regions, and does the proposed abolition of the fusion test not encourage them?
Hoe voorkomt de regering soortgelijke scenario’s in andere krimpgebieden en werkt de voorgestelde afschaffing fusietoets deze niet in de hand?

Finds abolishing the fusion test undesirable; questions the strict role of the CFTO, warns of pseudo-fusions that bypass parental and staff participation, and doubts medezeggenschap's capacity to resist mergers.
They find abolishing the fusion test in foundational education undesirable and are therefore very critical of the proposed amendment.
Zij vinden het afschaffen van de fusietoets in het funderend onderwijs onwenselijk en zijn daarom zeer kritisch op de voorliggende wetswijziging.
Supports abolishing the fusion test in its current form and asks about the status of alternative governance constructs and the legal dispute over fusion compensation.
These members support the proposal to abolish the fusion test in its current form.
Deze leden steunen het voorstel om de fusietoets in de huidige vorm af te schaffen.

35122.s: The bill amends the Penitentiary Principles Act and the Criminal Code to restructure detention phasing, replacing automatic conditional release with individual assessment by the public prosecutor, shortening the maximum conditional release period to two years, and introducing a detention and reintegration plan. It also abolishes the penitentiary programme for sentences over one year and adds rules for data sharing with municipalities.
35122.j: The memorandum justifies the shift by arguing that individual assessment and a two-year cap better support reintegration and reduce recidivism, while the Constitution and ECHR are said not to require a judge to decide revocation.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 4, vijfde lid Pbw)
content, conditions, electronic supervision and legal position of penitentiary programme
Artikel I, F (art. 18a, zesde lid Pbw)
requirements for detention and reintegration plan and data exchange with municipalities
Artikel I, K (art. 47, vierde lid Pbw)
rules on prison labour and wage levels
Artikel II, C (art. 15b, vierde lid Sr)
rules on decision-making on conditional release and supervision by reclassering
p: Conditional release is no longer granted automatically by law; the public prosecutor decides individually, and revocation can be ordered on a suspicion rather than a judicial finding, with only a later judicial check on request.
The public prosecutor, rather than a judge, decides on granting, revoking and setting special conditions for conditional release, subject to reasoned decisions and judicial review on objection.
Conditional release for sentences over one year becomes discretionary, with broad factors including victims' interests and the offender's behaviour, and the maximum period is capped at two years.
Participation in the penitentiary programme is subject to conditions and may be terminated by the prison director within statutory limits.

parties: Asks the government to explain how the Public Prosecution Service's advice was followed and whether an early-release anomaly for life sentences should be corrected.
It pleases them that the College is generally positive about the bill.
Het verheugt hen dat het College in het algemeen positief tegenover het wetsvoorstel staat.
Welcomes the capping of conditional release and removal of automatic release, asking mainly clarifying questions on phasing for short sentences.
With the capping of the conditional release period and the removal of its automatic character, more justice is done to the purpose of a custodial sentence.
Met de maximering van de periode van voorwaardelijke invrijheidsstelling en het schrappen van het automatische karakter wordt er meer recht gedaan aan het doel van een vrijheidsbenemende straf.
Questions the government's justification for the balance between retribution and recidivism and asks how individual interests of detainees and victims are weighed.
These members have a number of questions, in particular about the justification of the government's choices for this balance between retribution and recidivism.
Deze leden hebben een aantal vragen over met name de motivering van door de regering gemaakte keuzes voor deze balans tussen vergelding en recidive.
Doubts the bill balances retribution and prevention, asks for scientific validation of the claim that current enforcement falls short, and cites warnings from the Council of State and the RSJ.
The members ask whether this bill strikes an adequate balance between retribution and prevention, particularly given the absence of a sound analysis of current sentencing practice.

De leden vragen of dit wetsvoorstel wel een adequate balans tussen schuldvergelding en preventie weet te vinden, zeker in het licht bezien van het ontbreken van een steekhoudende analyse van de actuele sanctietoepassing.
Argues the two-year cap makes society less safe and that the government's premise that current conditional release is automatic is wrong; asks why judges should not decide the executed sentence.
Asks clarifying questions on the bill without stating a position.
They still have a few questions about this.
Zij hebben hierover nog enkele vragen.
Supports rightful punishment balanced with rehabilitation but asks how the individual approach accommodates vulnerable detainees with debts, addiction or intellectual disabilities.
However, these members ask the government to explain how account is taken of the complexity of the target group.
Wel vragen deze leden de regering toe te lichten hoe hierbij rekening wordt gehouden met de complexiteit van de doelgroep.
Sees the bill as a step forward but insufficient; asks for more attention to sentencing transparency, safety of society as a criterion and escape attempts as grounds for refusal.
The aforementioned members believe the present proposal is a step in the right direction, but not yet sufficient.
De voornoemde leden vinden dat het voorliggende voorstel een stap in de goede richting betekent, maar nog niet voldoende is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises reconsidering the proposed two-year cap on conditional release for long-sentenced prisoners, and objects to unlimited extension of the probation period under art. 15c(3) Sr as possibly violating ECHR art. 8 and Protocol 4 art. 2, plus raising delegation and integral-system concerns. The government reply largely rejects these objections, defending the two-year cap and arguing extensions are judicially reviewed and proportionate, while adopting the data-exchange delegation and Rijkswet changes.
concerns: The two-year maximum on conditional release risks leaving long-sentenced prisoners without adequate reintegration support, which the government rejects as sufficient.

Unlimited extension of the probation period under art. 15c(3) Sr may conflict with ECHR art. 8 and Protocol 4 art. 2; the government rejects amendment but adds reasoning on necessity and proportionality.
The broad ministerial delegation for data exchange with municipalities in art. 18a(6) Penitentiary Principles Act is too wide and was narrowed as advised.
Amending a Rijkswet (Uitvoeringswet Internationaal Strafhof) through a lower-level bill is not permitted and the change was removed as advised.
The Afdeling missed an integrated view of the sentence-execution system and the relation between modalities; the government added passages on leave and the relation to conditional sentences.

35200-V.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by enacting a supplementary closing budget law (slotwet) that adjusts appropriations and actual expenditure figures. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35203.s: The bill amends the Muntwet 2002 to replace national coin categories with EU-defined ones, abolishes investment coins and the KNM and muntmeester marks on ducats, and removes the article on the KNM's role as national mint. It also changes the award of coin-minting contracts to a tender procedure.
q: it is desirable to award the commission to strike coins by a tender procedure from now on
het wenselijk is de opdracht tot het slaan van munten voortaan middels een aanbestedingsprocedure te vergeven

parties: Asks whether DNB has enough capacity to steer the coin tender from 2020 and whether the coin advisory committee's composition must change after KNM's privatisation.
Does DNB have sufficient capacity to steer the coin tender process from 2020 properly, the VVD members ask.
Heeft DNB voldoende capaciteit om het aanbestedingsproces van munten vanaf 2020 in goede banen te leiden, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Has read the bill and has no further questions.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill and have no further questions about it.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel hebben hier geen verdere vragen over.
Asks why no investment coins were issued despite stated market demand, and whether the coin advisory committee's composition will change and who will sit on it.
The D66 members ask whether the government plans to change the composition of the coin advisory committee and, if so, who will sit on it.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering van plan is om de samenstelling van de muntadviescommissie te wijzigen en zo ja, wie hierin zitting zal nemen.
Criticises privatisation of public tasks and asks who will oversee coin quality and safety at KNM and after the tender, and how social responsibility and fair pay are addressed.
Who oversees quality and safety at the Royal Dutch Mint (KNM), which currently strikes the coins?
Wie ziet er toe op de kwaliteit en veiligheid bij Koninklijke Nederlandse Munt (KNM), die nu deze de munten slaat?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Muntwet 2002 on tendering the minting of coins and abolishing investment coins, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport notes a correction adding a subsection replacing 'Rijkswapen' with 'Klein Rijkswapen' in article 5 of the Muntwet and some redactional improvements.

35302.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax laws for 2020 onward, including lowering income tax brackets and personal allowances, adjusting excise duties, and introducing a minimum capital rule limiting interest deductions for banks and insurers. It also makes changes to housing-related tax reliefs, the wage tax, and Caribbean tax laws, and sets dates for tax changes through 2028.
35302.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegations mainly by administrative practicality, such as avoiding separate calculations and simplifying regulation.
q: It is proposed to remove the delegation basis in Article 2, sixth paragraph, of the Wage Tax Act 1964.
Voorgesteld wordt de in artikel 2, zesde lid, Wet LB 1964 opgenomen delegatiegrondslag te laten vervallen.
d: ARTIKEL XI, onderdeel A, punt 2 (art. 2, zevende lid Wet LB 1964)
ARTIKEL XIV, onderdeel B (art. 1.6 Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II)
revocation of declarations for temporary housing exemption
ARTIKEL XII, onderdeel G (art. 18, vierde lid Wet Vpb 1969)
rules for equivalent leverage or capital ratio of foreign head offices
correcting conflicting or erroneous article references in tax laws
Memorie van toelichting: algemene maatregel van bestuur on pension equalisation (afrekenverplichting)
provision of data to the tax authority for settling saldolijfrenten
p: ARTIKEL XIV, onderdeel B, punt 2 (art. 1.6 lid 6 Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II)
The minister may revoke a housing tax-exemption declaration when the conditions are not met.

parties: Asks for a total overview of measures and their timing, evaluation dates, and the distributional and budgetary effects of the package.
The VVD members ask whether the government can give a complete overview of the measures, their entry-into-force dates and evaluation timing for all measures effective 1 January 2020, 2021 and 2022.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering een totaaloverzicht kan geven van maatregelen, de datum van inwerkingtreding en het moment van evaluatie van alle maatregelen die ingaan per 1 januari 2020, 2021 en 2022.

Criticises the complexity of the tax and allowance system and the debt problems it causes for citizens, and asks about agreed safeguards such as the beslagvrije voet and transparency of toetsingsinkomen.
However, the tax and allowance system has become so complex for both the Tax Authority and citizens that they can get into trouble because of it.
Echter, zowel voor de Belastingdienst als voor de burger is het belasting- en toeslagenstelsel zodanig complex geworden dat zij erdoor in de problemen kunnen komen.
Welcomes the relief for households but flags the complexity of the system, toeslagen debts and unequal tax burdens between employees, self-employed and dga's, and requests further data.
The tax system is very complex and seems almost overstimulated.
Het belastingsysteem is zeer complex en lijkt haast overprikkeld.
Opposes the two-bracket system and the planned corporate tax cut as unequal, and asks for detailed analyses justifying the measures before they proceed.
They see a step towards a two-bracket system that hardly reduces the complexity of the system but does lead to greater inequality in society.
Zo zien zij een stap naar een tweeschijvenstelsel die de complexiteit van het stelsel niet of nauwelijks vermindert, maar die wel leidt tot grotere ongelijkheid in de samenleving.
Strongly opposes the accelerated two-bracket change and the rate shifts as burdening low incomes, and asks the government to justify its priorities and distributional choices.
These members are seriously worried about the accelerated introduction of the two-bracket system in income tax.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich ernstige zorgen over de versnelde invoering van het tweeschijvenstelsel in de inkomstenbelasting.
Asks how the enlarged tax credits fit with earlier advice on broadening bases and lowering rates, and why business and citizen taxation are treated differently.
These members ask the government how this fits with the tax reform advice of the past ten years, with the common thread of broadening bases and lowering rates.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe dit past bij de belastinghervormingsadviezen van de afgelopen tien jaar met als rode draad «grondslagen verbreden, tarieven verlagen».
Wants labour taxed less and scarce resources taxed more, and questions the rate increase for low incomes and the differential treatment of self-employed.
These members ask the government why it chose to raise taxes for low incomes and lower them for high incomes.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij heeft gekozen voor het verhogen van de belastingen voor de lage inkomens en heeft gekozen voor het verlagen van de belasting voor de hoge inkomens.
Asks for data on non-utilised tax credits, the faster phase-out of the elderly credit, and working pensioners' entitlement to the labour credit.
The 50PLUS members ask on what principle it was chosen to phase out the elderly credit three times as fast as the labour credit and the general tax credit.
De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie vragen op basis van welk principe ervoor gekozen is om de ouderenkorting drie keer zo snel af te bouwen als de arbeidskorting en de algemene heffingskorting.
Asks why the tax credits are raised rather than bracket rates lowered, the effects on marginal tax burden and innovation box, and why the self-employed deduction is cut before the Borstlap advice.
Why is this step being taken now, and why is the government not waiting for the recommendations this commission will make?
Waarom wordt nu al deze stap gezet, en wordt niet gewacht op de aanbevelingen die deze commissie zal doen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in September 2019 that the Belastingplan 2020 proposal to exclude administrative penalty payments (bestuursrechtelijke dwangsommen) from tax deduction insufficiently justifies the breach of fiscal neutrality, and advised adding a motivation or dropping the measure. The government's reply of September 2019 added justification on effectiveness and consistency, explained why the measure was not included in the evaluation section, and made a redactional change.
concerns: The Afdeling found the justification for excluding administrative penalty payments from deduction insufficient, lacking evidence of the scale of the problem and of effectiveness; the government added general background but did not provide systematic evidence on scale.

The Afdeling questioned whether the breach of fiscal neutrality is justified given the unclear scale of the problem and whether non-fiscal measures such as higher penalties would be more appropriate; the government explained the rationale but did not fully resolve this.
The Afdeling asked that the measure be explicitly covered in the evaluation section; the government disagreed that it is a substantial policy change and did not include it.
The Afdeling advised placing the exclusion for administrative penalty payments in a separate subsection rather than with fines; the government followed the redactional advice.

35311.s: This bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure and related laws to implement the new Act on enforcement of criminal decisions (Wet herziening tenuitvoerlegging strafrechtelijke beslissingen), reallocating enforcement responsibilities to the Minister and revising the rules on TBS (ter beschikking stelling), forensic detention, conditional release, and behavioural/liberty-restricting measures. It also makes numerous technical and consequential corrections across the Criminal Code, Penitentiary Principles Act, and other statutes.
35311.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as codifying existing case law, correcting technical errors and aligning with the new enforcement act, and it cites the need for effective recidivism control and protection of victims.
q: The proposed article XLIVa, first paragraph, means that imprisonment or substitute detention imposed in a judgment rendered before the amendment of articles 36e and 36f of the Criminal Code continues to be applied as such after that amendment takes effect.

Het voorgestelde artikel XLIVa, eerste lid, heeft tot gevolg dat een lijfsdwang of vervangende hechtenis, opgenomen in een uitspraak die is gewezen vóór inwerkingtreding van de wijziging van de artikelen 36e en 36f Sr, ook ná deze inwerkingtreding nog als lijfsdwang respectievelijk vervangende hechtenis wordt toegepast.
d: allocation of enforcement responsibilities between Minister and prosecution
further rules on pro Justitia psychiatric/psychological report
p: Expands prosecutorial and court power to impose and extend behavioural and liberty-restricting measures, including conditions such as residence bans and travel restrictions, extendable repeatedly on prosecutor request.[sic] Appeal to the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court is provided, but decisions take effect immediately.
Artikel I, onderdeel QQ (art. 6:6:10 lid 1 onder f, 6:6:10 lid 4 Sv)
Allows temporary admission of a TBS patient up to seven weeks, extendable by seven weeks on prosecution request, without the patient's consent.
Reformulates the TBS order criteria so the judge's own legal judgement is central and a formal diagnosis is no longer strictly required, broadening the basis for imposing TBS.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the abolition of execution time limits, included in a technical implementing act for the Wet USB, be removed because it is a substantive matter, and found its necessity and effectiveness insufficiently motivated. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted removal from the implementing act and announced a separate bill that will be resubmitted for advice.
concerns: Substantive abolition of execution time limits does not belong in a technical implementing act and should be removed from the bill.
The necessity of abolishing execution limitation periods and its expected effect on the number of executed sentences are not convincingly motivated.
No justification is given why punishment of offenders for less serious offences after very long periods remains desirable, nor for disregarding the time elapsed.
The reasonable time requirement of Article 6 ECHR may extend to execution, so convicted persons may still have rights to timely enforcement and clemency practice may need to be considered.

35320.s: This omnibus bill makes mainly technical and redactional amendments across education laws under the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, including renaming the minister's title, updating references, moving or repealing transitional provisions, and removing obsolete articles. It also adds a few substantive changes, such as allowing foreign qualifications to be recognised for teaching, creating a temporary suspension of repayment for student loans, and enabling the minister to set conditions on a funding budget for a student-organisation body.
35320.j: The memorandum justifies the new recognition power by pointing to a shortage of qualified staff in vocational education and the need to align with other sector laws.
q: That can contribute to the shortage of qualified staff in vocational education.
Dat kan bijdragen aan het tekort aan gekwalificeerd personeel in het beroepsonderwijs.
d: recognition of foreign teaching qualifications with conditions and restrictions set by the minister
rules implementing transitional teacher competence requirements for religious education
manner of suspending repayment where levenlanglerenkrediet and regular study debt overlap
rules on extra repayments of student loans and recalculation of instalments
adjusting monetary thresholds in line with wage developments
minister may attach conditions to contribution decisions and withdraw designation or funding
p: The minister may withdraw designation or funding of the consultative body for non-compliance with conditions set by the minister.
Suspension of student loan repayment is left to be determined by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute.

parties: The VVD has no questions or remarks on the bill.
The VVD members have taken note of the documents with interest and see no reason to ask questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van de stukken en zien daarin geen aanleiding voor het stellen van vragen.

The CDA asks how exemptions from physical education are applied, whether case-by-case assessment occurs, and what safeguards prevent unnecessary use of the exemption, which bears on discretion and overburdening of pupils.
Is it also examined whether physical education lessons can be arranged for these children so that the risk of overload is small?
Wordt daarbij ook gekeken of de lessen lichamelijke opvoeding zo kunnen worden ingericht voor deze kinderen dat het gevaar op overbelasting gering is?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against adding article 6d WVO (compulsory physical education) to the exemptions list of article 25 WVO, arguing the exemption is unnecessary for sport and dance talents and insufficiently justified for music talents, and it also raised drafting points and two delegation grounds on student finance. The government's reply disagrees that the exemption is unnecessary for sport and dance, maintains the exemption for music talents, accepts the risk of a broader exemption by limiting its use to exceptional cases, keeps the abbreviations, and adds clarifications and savings provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether an exemption from physical education is necessary for sport, dance and music talents, given existing training hours and school freedom in organising physical education.
The Afdeling notes the exemption could extend to a broader group of pupils than intended, which may conflict with the general public interest in physical education.
The Afdeling raised objections to two delegation grounds in the field of student finance.
The Afdeling advised removing abbreviations of statute names in the WTOS amendments, which the government declined to follow.
The Afdeling advised adding wording on the subject of the repayments in the proposed second paragraphs of articles 6.9a WSF 2000 and 4.9a WSF BES, which was a redactional point.

35401.s: The bill incorporates into the Wet publieke gezondheid (Wpg) a January 2020 ministerial regulation that classifies the novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV) as a Group A infectious disease, so that all Group A control powers, including isolation of infected persons, apply to it. It amends article 1 e group A of the Wpg to add the virus and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
35401.j: The memorandum justifies the incorporation as necessary to act in time and treat patients so the virus does not spread further, as required by article 20 paragraph 4 of the Wpg.
q: Secondly, with this all control powers (chapter V) under the Wpg are activated.
In de tweede plaats zijn hiermee alle bestrijdingsbevoegdheden (hoofdstuk V) uit de Wpg geactiveerd.
p: Adding the virus to Group A activates all Chapter V control powers of the Wpg, including isolation of infected or suspected persons, which the memorandum says may be applied by the safety region chair.

parties: Asks how the notification duty for suspected and close-contact cases works and how far the new powers reach, and whether they have already been used.
Can the government explain to what extent these powers are now being used in our country?
Kan de regering toelichten in hoeverre de genoemde bevoegdheden nu ingezet zijn in ons land?
Supports the bill but questions whether notification duties can be met given test shortages and GGD capacity, and asks how isolation orders are imposed, for how long, and how compliance is ensured.
How is it ensured that people also comply with this imposed isolation?
Hoe wordt ervoor gezorgd dat mensen zich ook aan deze opgelegde isolatie houden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill incorporating the 2019-nCoV Regulation into the Public Health Act, raising no substantive remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The opinion was published and forwarded to parliament by the Minister for Medical Care, with no separate government reply on any points.

35850-K.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (first supplementary budget), raising expenditure and commitments by about EUR 340.9 million relative to the original budget. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift authority between branches of government.
q: With this bill it is proposed to increase the 2021 revenue and expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) relative to the draft budget by EUR 340.9 million.

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld de ontvangsten- en uitgavenbegroting 2021 van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) ten opzichte van de ontwerpbegroting met een bedrag van € 340,9 miljoen te verhogen.

35975-C.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amount for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants. It makes the change effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2021.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2021

36004.s: The bill extends the right of pension providers to transfer or buy out small pension entitlements, including small net pensions and small net annuities, when accrual has ended for reasons other than termination of participation. It also amends related tax rules so that buying out small net annuities is not treated as an irregular act.
36004.j: The memorandum justifies the new buyout and transfer rights by reducing costs for pension providers and preserving the pension purpose, and it treats the citizen's consent as the protective step.
q: A pension provider has the right to buy out a net pension entitlement vis-à-vis the beneficiary if: [...] c. the beneficiary of the net pension agrees to the buyout.

Een pensioenuitvoerder heeft jegens de gerechtigde tot een nettopensioen het recht om een aanspraak op nettopensioen af te kopen indien: [...] c. de gerechtigde tot het nettopensioen instemt met de afkoop.
d: Artikel I, A (Pensioenwet art. 66, lid 3); Artikel II, A (Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling art. 78, lid 3)
conditions for buyout of small old-age pension entitlements
Artikel I, D (Pensioenwet art. 70a); Artikel II, D (Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling art. 81a) referring to art. 17f Besluit uitvoering
conditions and plan for transfer of existing small entitlements
Artikel III, B (Wet IB 2001 art. 5.16c, lid 5 reference to art. 3.133)
amount threshold for small net annuity buyout exemption
p: Artikel I, C (Pensioenwet art. 69, lid 2); Artikel II, C (art. 80a, lid 2)
Pension providers gain a right to buy out small net pensions, with the beneficiary's consent required as the main safeguard.

parties: Asks whether a buyout of small early-retirement pensions could be allowed and how automatic transfer applies to DC schemes at insurers.
The VVD members ask whether the government has considered making buyout of a small started old-age pension (with the participant's consent right) possible again in the present bill.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af of de regering heeft overwogen om de afkoop van een klein ingegaan ouderdomspensioen (met instemmingsrecht van de deelnemer) toch weer mogelijk te maken in de voorliggende wet.
Supports the bill's goals but asks how participants with low pensions will be informed in time and what the consequences are for them.
Buying out small pensions will not directly cause major problems for people when they reach pensionable age, although accumulated buyouts could have that effect.

Het afkopen van kleine pensioenen zal niet direct leiden tot forse problemen voor mensen zodra zij hun pensioenleeftijd bereiken, al kan een stapeling van het afkopen van kleine pensioenen dat effect wel hebben.
Asks for a fuller account of financial and cost consequences and an information duty so participants can make the right choice without facing a pension shortfall.
The CDA members ask whether there is an information duty on providers so participants can make the right choice and not later face a pension shortfall.
Deze leden vragen de regering of er een informatieplicht rust op de uitvoerders zodat deelnemers de juiste keuze kunnen maken en niet achteraf worden geconfronteerd met een pensioentekort.
Has taken note of the proposal and has no additional questions at this stage.
The SP members have taken note of the proposal and have no additional questions on it at this time.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorstel en hebben hierover op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.
Welcomes consolidation of small pensions but asks whether it truly yields higher returns, warns of incentives for providers to block transfers and of risks to partner and child coverage.
Does the government agree that a pension provider may have a financial incentive to ensure these attempts do not succeed?
Is de regering het eens dat er een (financiële) prikkel bij een pensioenuitvoerder kan zijn om deze pogingen niet te laten slagen?
Shares PvdA concerns about returns, provider incentives, risks for individuals and the default choice for pre-2007 small pensions.
Does the government agree that a pension provider may have a financial incentive to ensure these attempts do not succeed?
Is de regering het eens dat er een (financiële) prikkel bij een pensioenuitvoerder kan zijn om deze pogingen niet te laten slagen?
Warns that transfers can harm (former) participants and asks how sufficient insight into consequences before consenting is guaranteed.
Does the government believe (former) participants must have sufficient insight into the consequences before they can consent to a transfer?
Is de regering van mening dat (gewezen) deelnemers voldoende inzicht moeten hebben in de gevolgen, voordat zij in kunnen stemmen met een overdracht?
Asks for a guarantee that accrued entitlements are not impaired by transfers and that buyout costs are limited.
Warns that low-income participants may face very high marginal tax and benefit-loss rates on buyout, questioning the bill's practicality.
This member asks how the government sees the future of the net pension.
Wel vraagt dit lid zich af hoe de regering de toekomst van het nettopensioen ziet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill amending the Pensioenwet and related laws on transfer of value and buy-out of small pensions and small net pensions, and advised submitting it to the House. The government's reply notes that only a redactional remark was made, which was addressed by clarifying the tax aspects of the buy-out in the explanatory memorandum and removing an unwanted technical reference in the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to clarify and elaborate the tax aspects of the buy-out of small net pensions and small net annuities in the explanatory memorandum, which the government did.

36022.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (fourth supplementary budget), adjusting spending and commitment amounts for ventilation, self-test and national education programme items. It takes effect from 3 February 2022, with retroactive effect where published later.
q: This results in a commitment carried over from 2021 to 2023 under Article 3.
Dit resulteert in een overlopende verplichting van 2021 naar 2023 op Artikel 3.

36040.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/1023 on preventive restructuring and insolvency into the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet), amending provisions on curators, administrators, observers, restructuring experts, stays of enforcement, and homologation of arrangements. It also introduces court appointment and remuneration rules, a MKB (small and medium enterprise) exemption, and electronic communication requirements.
36040.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and changes as required to transpose the EU directive while leaving Member States flexibility in implementation.
q: The preventive restructuring framework may consist of one or more procedures and must in any event be available on the request of the debtor.
Het preventieve herstructureringsstelsel mag bestaan uit één of meerdere procedures en moet in ieder geval beschikbaar zijn op aanvraag van de schuldenaar.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel K en GG (artikel 222a, 294 Fw)
designation of further documents for registration in insolvency registers
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel II (artikel 315 lid 3 Fw)
designation of court and judge-commissioner decisions for register entry and information to be recorded
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel E and JJ (artikel 71 lid 3 and 320 lid 6 Fw)
Court sets curator and administrator remuneration using efficiency-based criteria, with a duty to hear the office-holder before deviating from proposals.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel M and Z (artikel 223a, 270 Fw)
Removes the requirement that a judge-commissioner be appointed in certain steps and drops article 270, reducing a layer of court supervision over the administrator's actions in surseance.

parties: Asks whether courts have sufficient guidance to assess shareholder obstruction before any restructuring expert acts, and whether the change adds workload for the judiciary, and questions the prejudicial-question route to the Court of Justice.
These members ask, however, whether the judge has sufficient guidance and reference points to assess in advance when no action by a restructuring expert has yet been taken.
Deze leden vragen echter of de rechter voldoende handvatten en aanknopingspunten heeft om vooraf te kunnen beoordelen als er nog geen enkele handeling van een herstructureringsdeskundige is verricht.
Raises the Rvdr concern that the right to submit written views could sharply increase court workload and asks whether a threshold should limit the number of views.
How does the government view the Rvdr's proposal to build in a threshold so that the number of written views can be limited to what is necessary?
Hoe staat de regering tegenover het voorstel van de Rvdr om een drempel in te bouwen, zodat het aantal zienswijzen beperkt kan worden tot de noodzakelijke?
Supports the bill in principle but asks whether appeal against court rulings on the WHOA homologation should be possible given the procedure's care requirements.
It is clear from the implementing bill that entrepreneurs will not be able to appeal a court ruling on the (formation of an) agreement under the WHOA.

Uit de voorliggende implementatiewet wordt duidelijk dat ondernemers niet de mogelijkheid krijgen om in hoger beroep te gaan tegen de uitspraak van een rechter over (de totstandkoming van) een akkoord op basis van de Wet homologatie onderhands akkoord (WHOA).
Argues that workers are insufficiently protected and that the directive's employee-information rights and the statutory framework for information disclosure to works councils are inadequate.
Does the government agree that the instrument of Article 31 WOR is not sufficient to give works councils a good knowledge position?
Is de regering het eens met de stelling dat het instrument van artikel 31 WOR niet afdoende is om de ondernemingsraden een goede kennispositie te geven?
Asks how employee rights and early warning for workers are safeguarded and whether the bill should add an early-warning instrument, since employees are informed too late in practice.
These members ask the government to supplement this bill on this point, for example with a specific early-warning instrument.
Deze leden vragen de regering onderhavige wet op dit punt aan te vullen, bijvoorbeeld met een specifiek instrument voor vroegtijdige waarschuwing.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementation Act for Directive (EU) 2019/1023 on restructuring, insolvency and debt discharge, raising no substantive remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister for Legal Protection's reply notes redactional changes, an explicit reference to EU instruments mentioned in Article 31 of the directive, a statutory rather than AMvB-based anchoring of insolvency practitioner appointment and fee standards, and a technical amendment to the court fees act.
concerns: Redactional comments were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36100-V.s: This bill adopts the Slotwet amending the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

36103.s: The bill inserts a temporary article 29a into the Awir so that, for certain benefit-overpayment debts whose recovery was suspended during COVID-19, no interest is charged if the debt is paid within the offered payment periods after recovery resumes. The provision lapses on 1 January 2026 and takes effect on 1 July 2022, with retroactive effect possible.
36103.j: The memorandum justifies the no-interest arrangement as an alternative to continuing the reduced 0.01% interest rate, citing system and implementation constraints and the need to encourage borrowers to use the offered payment options.
q: This prevents citizens from lacking an incentive to use the options offered when recovery resumes, because no collection interest is charged to them.

Hiermee wordt voorkomen dat burgers geen prikkel ervaren om gebruik te maken van de bij de hervatting van de invordering geboden mogelijkheden omdat aan hen geen invorderingsrente in rekening wordt gebracht.

parties: Asks for a timeline for full repayment, a breakdown of debt build-up, and a risk analysis of mass entitlement claims.
These VVD members ask whether the government can go into this risk analysis in more detail.
Deze leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering uitgebreider op deze risicoanalyse kan ingaan.
Stresses that the benefits system carries an inherent risk of problematic recovery and asks whether recoveries increased during the pandemic.
These members stress that the benefits system should be made redundant and abolished as soon as possible so people no longer get lost in complex rules or face high recoveries.

Deze leden hechten eraan te benadrukken dat het toeslagenstelsel zo snel mogelijk overbodig gemaakt en afgeschaft dient te worden, zodat mensen niet meer verdwalen in ingewikkelde regelingen of te maken krijgen met hoge terugvorderingen.
Asks about the number of affected citizens, uncollectable amounts, wrongful recoveries, and whether the inspector can use discretion to extend payment terms.
Can the inspector in this respect use a discretionary power to set a longer payment term, for example?
Kan de inspecteur op dit vlak gebruik maken van een discretionaire bevoegdheid om bijvoorbeeld een langere betalingstermijn vast te stellen?
Asks how the choice to pay without interest is communicated, what happens if citizens do not accept, and how the interest rate is set.
The CDA members ask what the consequence is if a citizen does not accept the offer and whether collection interest is then charged, and if so, how much.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen wat het gevolg is als een burger niet ingaat op het aanbod en of dan wel invorderingsrente wordt gerekend en zo ja, hoeveel.
Welcomes the pause on collection and the option to repay without interest, and asks how many citizens have tax debts and fall under the arrangement.

These members think it is good that collection of tax and benefit debts was paused during the pandemic and, now that collection is being phased back in, they also support the option this bill gives citizens.

Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak dat de invordering van belasting- en toeslagenschulden tijdens de coronapandemie is gepauzeerd en zijn, nu deze invordering in fases weer wordt opgestart en de invorderingsrente in stapsgewijs wordt verhoogd, tevens voorstander van de mogelijkheid die dit wetsvoorstel burgers biedt.
Asks about the size of the affected group, the expected completion timeline, and how affected debtors will be guided after collection resumes.
In what way will those involved be guided after the recoveries resume?
Op welke manier zullen betrokkenen na het hervatten van de terugvorderingen worden begeleid?
Asks whether collection starts only after full assessment, the maximum collection period, whether the minimum subsistence level is fully respected, and debt breakdowns by size.
Does the tax authority/benefits service now fully comply, at 100%, with the legally defined minimum subsistence level?
Voldoet de belastingdienst/toeslagen inmiddels voor de volle 100% aan de wettelijk vastgelegde beslagvrije voet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill suspending interest on Toeslagen debts when collection resumes, and offered only drafting remarks on article 29a of the Awir. The government reply states that the remarks were incorporated and that the explanatory memorandum was clarified and revised.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to replace 'indien' with 'voor zover' in article 29a(2) Awir or align the explanation with the statutory text.
The Afdeling asked to clarify the phrase 'binnen de termijnen, bedoeld in het eerste lid' in article 29a(2) Awir, including repayment timing relative to the notice letter.

36120-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget (first supplementary budget) for the other high state bodies, the governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adding about EUR 6.0 million in commitments and EUR 17.0 million in expenditure. The memorandum explains the increases as funding for the Council of State, Court of Audit, National Ombudsman and Electoral Council, largely tied to strengthening oversight bodies and new Electoral Council tasks.
36120-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by citing the coalition agreement's funding to strengthen oversight bodies and the cabinet's response to the Childcare Benefits inquiry.
q: In the coalition agreement 'Looking out for each other, looking ahead to the future', EUR 0.9 million is freed up for the Court of Audit within the framework of strengthening supervisory bodies.
In het Coalitieakkoord «Omzien naar elkaar, vooruitzien naar de toekomst» wordt € 0,9 mln. vrijgemaakt voor de Algemene Rekenkamer in het kader van het versterken van toezichthouders.

36130.s: The bill sets nationwide general rules of good landlordship for landlords and rental agents, including prohibitions on discrimination and intimidation and a written-contract requirement. It lets municipalities require rental permits in designated areas and for accommodation for migrant workers, impose sanctions up to taking over management (beheer) of rental properties, and publicly name sanctioned landlords.
36130.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers by documented misconduct by landlords (rent overcharging, intimidation, discrimination) harming tenants' right to adequate housing, and argues they are proportionate and subject to the Services Directive and privacy law.
q: This bill may have consequences for the judiciary.
Dit wetsvoorstel kan gevolgen hebben voor de rechtspraak.
d: municipal council rental ordinance requiring permits for designated housing categories
conditions attached to rental permits (rent caps, maintenance plans, facilities)
rules on data and procedure for public naming of sanctioned landlords
rules on processing and retention of personal data in complaints point
p: Mayor and aldermen may order a landlord's rental property placed under a third-party manager after prior fines, with the landlord barred from managing it.
Mayor and aldermen may refuse or withdraw rental permits based on prior violations or integrity assessments.
Municipality may publicly name landlords sanctioned for violations, subject to a balancing test and a possible interim injunction.
Mayor and aldermen may withdraw a rental permit for repeated non-compliance within four years.

parties: Asks how municipalities will be prevented from shifting problems to neighbours, how a permit procedure will be uniform, and what capacity municipalities need to enforce the rules.
To tackle the problems, municipalities must have sufficient administrative capacity.
Om de problematiek aan te pakken, moeten gemeenten over voldoende ambtelijke capaciteit beschikken.
Supports swift introduction to protect tenants, but questions whether municipalities can investigate landlords without a formal tenant report and asks why discrimination is not included.
These members attach great value to a swift introduction of the law so that tenants are better protected against malicious landlords.
Deze leden hechten grote waarde aan een vlotte invoering van de voorliggende wet, zodat huurders beter beschermd worden tegen kwaadwillende verhuurders.
Welcomes giving municipalities more tools against landlord misconduct, while asking how to prevent diverging municipal procedures and how workers and employers are involved.
These members are therefore pleased with this bill, which gives municipalities more options to protect tenants against abuses in renting out dwellings.
Deze leden zijn daarom blij met onderhavig wetsvoorstel die gemeenten meer mogelijkheden geeft om huurders te beschermen tegen misstanden bij het verhuren van woon- of verblijfruimten.
Raises discrimination on socio-economic grounds, questions whether housing corporations are adequately covered, and asks whether enforcement will be real rather than a paper tiger.
Supports the measures but argues for more national steering, a national inspection role, and that the burden of initiative should not rest on tenants alone.
The national government has no general supervisory body for the housing market; for private rental this supervision lies entirely with the municipality.
Het Rijk heeft geen algemeen toezichtsorgaan voor de woningmarkt, dit toezicht ligt voor particuliere huur in zijn geheel bij de gemeente.
Welcomes the bill but worries about waterbed effects, uneven sanctioning by municipalities, and tenants' limited awareness of their rights.
Asks whether the definition of arbeidsmigrant is too narrow and whether municipalities can act on high rents across the whole municipality.
These members ask whether the government is willing to broaden the definition of migrant workers.
Deze leden vragen zich af of de regering bereid is de definitie van arbeidsmigranten te verbreden?
Asks how varying municipal policies affect regional housing markets, whether the mandatory complaints desk is workable, and about the process and termination of management takeover (inbeheername).
How is it prevented that policy in one municipality has large negative consequences for other (surrounding) municipalities?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat beleid in een bepaalde gemeente grote negatieve gevolgen heeft voor andere (omliggende) gemeenten?
Criticises market thinking in housing, asks about accessibility of the Huurcommissie and whether enforcement is administrative rather than criminal with adequate capacity.
The BIJ1 member notes that the government intends to place supervision and enforcement of this bill as a responsibility of municipalities.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie constateert dat de regering voornemens is de toezicht en handhaving van dit wetsvoorstel als verantwoordelijkheid bij gemeenten te willen plaatsen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on the draft Wet goed verhuurderschap, finding the policy aims understandable but the necessity, effectiveness and proportionality of its instruments (licensing, inbeheername, fines, publication, meldpunt) inadequately justified, and raising concerns on primacy of the legislator, delegation to municipalities, property rights, privacy and EU law. The Minister's nader rapport accepts most points, moves the core norms into the statute, adds justification and amends the bill, but rejects the advice on judicial review of inbeheername.
concerns: The probleemanalyse and justification of the chosen instruments and alternatives was too thin; the government added analysis and a fuller account of alternatives.
The core meaning of goed verhuurderschap should be in the statute rather than an amvb; the government moved the rules into the wet.
Broad municipal discretion and uneven regimes across municipalities raise concerns; the government defended decentralisation and justified the vergunning as a targeted instrument.
Financial motivation of municipal implementation costs was missing; a Financiële-verhoudingswet study was added to the memorie.
The effectiveness and necessity of a mandatory municipal meldpunt was questioned; the government added justification and a delegation basis for data processing.

Inbeheername intrudes deeply on the landlord's property rights without judicial safeguards; the government rejected adding judicial review, pointing to ultimum remedium status and available court appeal.
Property rights (EP EVRM art. 1) and privacy (EVRM art. 8, publication of sanctions) assessment was incomplete; the memorie was supplemented and the Wob references replaced by Woo.
Assessment under the Dienstenrichtlijn and free movement of capital was incomplete or incorrect; the government expanded these sections.

36202.s: The bill implements a package of tax measures for 2023 onward, including raising income tax brackets and rates, abolishing the fiscal retirement reserve (oudedagsreserve), the averaging scheme, the start-up wage exemption, the owner-occupied home gift exemption and the BPM exemption for business vans, and adjusting excise duties, environmental taxes and the ODE levy. It also phases out and changes various child-related, housing, transfer and benefit rules and sets transitional provisions for existing arrangements.
36202.j: The memorandum justifies the abolition and changes mainly by evaluations showing the schemes are ineffective and by budgetary and equity considerations, not by new executive powers.
q: In addition, it is proposed to abolish the averaging scheme, the fiscal retirement reserve (FOR) and the start-up wage regulation, because evaluations or advice from the Council of State's Advisory Division show these schemes are not effective and efficient.

Daarnaast wordt voorgesteld de middelingsregeling, de fiscale oudedagsreserve (FOR) en de gebruikelijk-loonregeling voor start-ups af te schaffen, omdat uit evaluaties of advies van de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State blijkt dat deze regelingen niet doeltreffend en doelmatig zijn.
d: Artikel IX, onderdeel B (art. 31a, achttiende lid, Wet LB 1964 and ministerial/AMvB rules on extraterritorial costs)
rules for extraterritorial cost reimbursement and affiliated employers
Artikel X, onderdeel C (art. 31a, achtste lid, Wet LB 1964)
rules for applying the 30% ruling cap across affiliated employers
Artikel X, onderdeel C (art. 31a, achtste lid, derde zin, Wet LB 1964)
school fee allowances designated by general administrative order
