Artikel I, onderdeel II (art. 10a.18, vijfde lid, Wet IB 2001)
conditions for deferring annuity start under transitional rules
Artikel IX, onderdeel J (art. 38p, vijfde lid, Wet LB 1964)
conditions for tax-neutral conversion of pension entitlements into annuities
p: Artikel I, onderdelen A-B and Artikel II, onderdeel B
Tax rate and bracket changes are set directly in statute, with the Minister empowered to recalculate bracket amounts by ministerial regulation.
Routine adjustments of excise and environmental tax parameters through statutory amounts with limited discretion.

parties: Asks whether the Box 3 changes will trigger mass objections and litigation after the Christmas ruling, and whether the leegwaarderatio change is legally sound.
Does the government expect that citizens, in line with the Christmas ruling, will massively file objections against their income tax assessments regarding their share portfolios?
Verwacht de regering dan dat burgers, conform het Kerstarrest, massaal bezwaar zullen indienen tegen hun aangifte inkomstenbelasting ten aanzien van hun aandelenportefeuille
Asks about simplification, broad-welfare indicators and the effects of Box 3 and commuting allowance changes.
Cites the Raad van State advice on Tax Administration burden and asks the government to consider non-tax alternatives for measures that disrupt processes.
The CDA members ask the government to reflect on where it sees room to shape measures in this tax package that disrupt processes outside taxation, and their pros and cons.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering graag te reflecteren op waar de regering ruimte ziet om maatregelen uit dit Belastingplanpakket die de processen verstoren vorm te geven buiten de fiscaliteit
Questions the low taxation of capital relative to labour and whether Box 3 changes will reduce wealth concentration.
Does the government agree with these members that this should actually be taxed at least as heavily?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat dit eigenlijk op zijn minst even zwaar zou moeten worden belast?
Criticises the limited structural reform, concern over marginal burden and tax administration pressure, and asks for updated income-effect analyses.
These members ask whether the government will also make a new analysis of purchasing-power effects for the whole package in upcoming amendment notes.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bij de komende nota’s van wijziging over het gehele pakket ook een nieuwe analyse wil maken over de koopkrachteffecten.
Asks about the arbeidskorting design, inconsistent benefit eligibility and the complexity-driven arbitrariness of outcomes.
Does the government share the view of the GroenLinks members that this is an example of how the great complexity of our tax system leads to arbitrariness in outcomes?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie dat dit een voorbeeld is van hoe de grote complexiteit in ons belastingstelsel leidt tot willekeur in uitkomsten?
Supports targeted allowance increases but questions the rise in marginal tax burden in the 30,000–50,000 euro range.
Does the government, apart from the specific reason for this package, consider this rise an undesirable development, like these members do?
Vindt de regering deze stijging, los van de specifieke reden hiervoor bij dit pakket, met deze leden een onwenselijke ontwikkeling?
Questions the widening gap between single- and dual-earner households and calls for fundamental reform of the tax system.
Does the government agree with these members that a thorough revision is necessary?
Is de regering met deze leden van mening dat een grondige herziening noodzakelijk is?

Warns of mass objections and pressure on the Tax Administration, questions whether the government stays within its discretion after the Christmas ruling, and asks why non-objectors are not compensated.
Member Omtzigt asks how the government assesses its own room for judgement and why it believes the Box 3 bills do not conflict with the Christmas ruling.
Het lid Omtzigt vraagt hoe de regering de eigen beoordelingsruimte inschat en waarom de regering meent dat de wetsvoorstellen omtrent box 3 niet strijdig zijn met het Kerstarrest.
Asks whether the giftenaftrek cap solves the intended problem without harming philanthropy and whether the ANBI unit has enough staff to control charities.
The VVD members ask whether it is true that the ANBI unit is staffed with only five employees?
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of het klopt dat de ANBI-afdeling maar met vijf medewerkers is uitgerust?
Finds donations to self-managed foundations to fund children's studies undesirable and asks whether such constructions can be fully prevented, including tighter ANBI status rules.
The D66 members consider this undesirable and ask why donating by a taxpayer to their own foundation or association is not fully restricted and what options exist for that.`
De leden van de D66-fractie achten dit onwenselijk en vragen waarom het doneren aan de eigen stichting of vereniging door belastingplichtige niet volledig is beperkt en welke opties daartoe bestaan.
Supports tackling misuse of the gift deduction but asks for further justification and data on the 140 cases, and whether a double test on indirect involvement was considered.
They are in favour of tackling undesirable use of the gift deduction, because it is intended to stimulate giving, not to benefit oneself.`
Zij zijn voorstander van het aanpakken van ongewenst gebruik van de giftenaftrek, omdat deze bedoeld is om geven te stimuleren, niet om er zelf beter van te worden.
Questions the democratic legitimacy of tax-funded private philanthropy steering public money outside democratic decision-making and asks for evidence that the deduction matters.
In this way part of the central government budget is deployed based on the choices of wealthy individuals, rather than on the basis of democratic decision-making.`
Hiermee wordt een deel van het budget van de rijksoverheid ingezet op basis van de keuzes van rijke en vermogende individuen, in plaats van op basis van democratische besluitvorming.
Asks why the 250,000 euro cap was chosen and whether the government will enforce against improper use of gifts to own or affiliated ANBIs.
Furthermore, these members ask whether the government intends to additionally enforce against improper use of donations to one's own or affiliated ANBI, alongside this cap amount.`
Verder vragen deze leden of de regering voornemens is om naast aan dit aftoppingsbedrag aanvullend te handhaven op het oneigenlijk gebruik van schenkingen aan de eigen of gelieerde ANBI.
Asks why a generic cap was chosen rather than better enforcement and supervision against fraud, and what the impact is on civil society.
Why does the government consider this measure proportionate, and why was better enforcement and supervision of fraud not chosen instead of this generic measure?
Waarom acht de regering deze maatregel proportioneel, en waarom is niet gekozen voor betere handhaving en toezicht op fraude in plaats van deze generieke maatregel?
Argues the abolition of the fiscal old-age reserve (FOR) for entrepreneurs is unfair and reduces small firms' liquidity and investment, proposing alternatives.
According to the BBB member, abolition of the FOR therefore mainly disadvantages small and starting entrepreneurs who do not qualify for bank financing.`
Afschaffing van de FOR benadeelt volgens het lid van de BBB-fractie dus vooral de kleine en startende ondernemer die niet in aanmerking komt voor bancaire financiering.
Welcomes abolition of the wage-cost flexibility margin but questions the 48,000 euro minimum reasonable wage threshold.
However, these members have a question about the minimum salary (48,000 euro in 2022) that must be applied.`
Wel hebben deze leden een vraag over het minimale loon (48.000 euro in 2022) dat gerekend moet worden.
Asks for the budget implications of exempting four pre-1965 mining concessions from the cijns increase and for the basis of the expectation that high gas prices are temporary.
The PVV members request the government to further explain the basis for the expectation that the high gas price is temporary in nature.`
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om nader toe te lichten waarop de verwachting gebaseerd is dat de hoge gasprijs tijdelijk van aard is.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advises on the Belastingplan 2023 package, stressing that implementation capacity at the Belastingdienst is strained and that priorities must be set, and raising points on box 2 two-bracket design, the 30%-regeling cap, the BTW zero rate for solar panels, the zelfstandigenaftrek and the IACK phase-out. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the points, adjusting the explanatory memorandum and the 30%-regeling cap and transition, while keeping the other measures and defending the rationale.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a reasoned prioritisation of the package given strained Belastingdienst IT and staff capacity; the government provides an overview annex and says it will expand on implementation effects.

The Afdeling doubts the expected revenue of the box 2 two-bracket system and its spillover to box 3; the government explains the revenue estimate and behavioural effects but does not change the measure.

The Afdeling finds the 30%-regeling cap based on the WNT norm unmotivated and asks for justification of the cap level and transition period; the government adjusts the explanatory memorandum and evaluation timing.
The Afdeling asks that the BTW small-business registration exemption for solar panels be anchored in law; the government defers this to a separate bill.
The Afdeling asks for justification of keeping the starters' deduction unchanged while phasing out the zelfstandigenaftrek; the government explains its choice and refers to a 2023 evaluation.
The Afdeling questions phasing out the IACK in a tight labour market before the KOT reform; the government argues the KOT reform offsets the effect and timing is technically necessary.
Redactional points on the transitional date and consultation documentation; the government adopts the consultation and impact text changes but not the proposed date change.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a government amendment proposing a temporary increase of the cijns (gas production levy) for 2023 and 2024, plus capping periodic gifts deductions, abolishing the efficiency margin in the arm's-length salary rule, and related points. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepts most remarks by supplementing the explanatory memorandum and committing to examine hedge contracts, while keeping the core measures.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether taxing turnover not actually realised by licence holders, and the treatment of hedge contracts, is consistent with property protection under article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR, and asks for justification of the revenue estimates.
The exclusion of four old concessions from the cijns raises equal treatment and state aid questions; the government argues disproportionality of introducing a new levy for them and so no violation.

The temporary derogation from the stand-still provision of the Mijnbouwwet must be justified in light of legitimate expectations; the government supplements the reasoning on the exceptional situation.

Cumulative effects with other levies (oppervlakterecht, winstaandeel, vennootschapsbelasting) are not shown, so proportionality and fair balance cannot be assessed; the government supplements the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks to consider the proposed EU solidarity levy and possible cumulation; the government says it will take cumulative effects into account in implementing the regulation.
The gifts cap will be applied manually and disrupts procedures at the Belastingdienst; the explanatory memorandum is supplemented accordingly.
Abolishing the efficiency margin in the gebruikelijk loon rule is expected to increase discussions and reduce enforceability; the Afdeling asks for more explanation, which is added to the memorandum.

36211.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising the commitment amounts for general and special grants by 520 million euros, in connection with an energy allowance for low incomes. It sets the entry into force as 20 September 2022, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the municipal fund (B) for the year 2022 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36220.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for 2022, adding a 2.6 billion euro supplementary budget for a temporary energy price cap for small consumers. It sets the budget unit as thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 31 October of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2022

36301.s: The bill amends the Dutch housing allowance law so that Ukrainian displaced persons under the EU temporary protection decision of March 2022 are entitled to huurtoeslag, with retroactive effect to 4 March 2022. It also provides that the new article 10 will be repealed on a date to be set by royal decree, in line with the end of temporary protection.
36301.j: The memorandum explains that the repeal date is set by royal decree to match the end of temporary protection, with a short transitional period if needed.
q: That date is determined in line with the end date of the temporary protection, if necessary allowing for a short transitional period.
Dat tijdstip wordt bepaald overeenkomstig de einddatum van de tijdelijke bescherming, zo nodig met inachtneming van een korte overgangsperiode.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B / Artikel II
date of repeal of article 10 set by royal decree

parties: The CDA has no further questions or remarks on the bill.
These members have no further questions or comments.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen en opmerkingen.
The SP asks the government to explain the legal basis and justification for distinguishing Ukrainian displaced persons from other displaced groups in rental allowance entitlement.

They ask whether the government can explicitly state how it sees the differences between displaced persons from Ukraine and those from other conflict areas, and why a difference then follows in granting the right to rental allowance.

Zij vragen of expliciet kan worden aangegeven hoe de regering de verschillen ziet tussen ontheemden afkomstig uit Oekraïne en ontheemden uit andere conflictgebieden, en waarom dan een verschil volgt in het toekennen van het recht op huurtoeslag.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on 11 January 2023 on a bill amending the Wet op de huurtoeslag to grant rent allowance to Ukrainian displaced persons, finding no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport of 26 January 2023 accompanies the opinion but contains no substantive reply to any point since the Afdeling raised none.

36400.s: The bill postpones the market-exploration restriction in the Housing Act (Woningwet) by changing the deadline in article 136 from 1 January 2024 to 1 July 2025. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36400.j: The memorandum justifies the postponement by noting that the Aw supervises the non-DAEB activities and that practice agreements will make the playing field more transparent, and it mentions a planned evaluation of the suspension.
q: By making practice agreements about the plans housing corporations make during the suspension, the playing field becomes more transparent for market parties and for the Aw.
Door praktijkafspraken te maken over de plannen die corporaties gedurende de opschorting maken, wordt het speelveld bovendien inzichtelijker voor marktpartijen en voor de Aw.

parties: Asks for evidence of the effects of the suspension and for the evaluation to assess market distortion, citing the Raad van State's warning about oversight of a level playing field.
They urgently request the government to also include in the evaluation of the suspension of the market test what the effects are on distorting the market.
Zij willen de regering dringend verzoeken om ook in de evaluatie van het effect van de opschorting van de markttoets op te nemen wat de effecten zijn op het verstoren van de markt
Asks how the market test works in practice and what capacity and costs it involves, and why it is not abolished entirely.
These members wonder why it was not chosen to abolish the market test entirely.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen zich af waarom er niet voor gekozen is om de marktverkenning in zijn geheel af te schaffen.
Asks why full abolition was not chosen and proposes a periodic sample check of market distortion instead of a one-off evaluation.
They ask whether it would not be better to set up a sample instead of the evaluation to periodically test whether the non-DAEB activities of housing corporations distort the market.

Zij vragen of het niet beter is om in de plaats van de evaluatie een steekproef op te zetten om periodiek te toetsen of de niet-DAEB activiteiten van woningcorporaties al dan niet marktverstorend werken
Asks how the bill relates to the adopted motion calling for full abolition of the market test and whether the government will implement it.
How does the adoption of this motion relate to this bill?
Hoe staat het aannemen van deze motie in verhouding tot dit wetsvoorstel?
Argues the market test should be abolished rather than suspended and asks the government to amend the bill accordingly.
However, they are of the opinion that the market test should be abolished rather than suspended.
Zij zijn echter van mening dat de markttoets niet opgeschort maar afgeschaft moet worden.
Asks how the government will implement the motion on abolition and about broader financing options for non-DAEB activities.
Asks about the status, timing and results of the planned evaluation of the suspension.
These members ask whether the evaluation of the suspension has already started.
Deze leden vragen of er al is gestart met de evaluatie van de opschorting.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division understands the government's decision to extend the suspension of the market exploration procedure for housing corporations' commercial activities, given current market conditions, but asks that the evaluation of the suspension be framed more broadly around what is needed to resolve the housing shortage and the role of corporations and market parties. In its reply, the minister accepts this and adds in the explanatory memorandum the evaluation criteria requested (effects of related measures, legal and financial limits, and whether market interest has returned).
concerns: The evaluation of the suspension should be placed in a broader context, considering the causes of the housing shortage and the role of corporations and market parties, rather than examining the suspension in isolation.
The suspension should not last longer than necessary, and the market exploration procedure must be reinstated in time once market conditions allow market interest.

Any future change to the scope of corporations' tasks should be motivated and transparent and stay within EU state aid rules, and the goedkeuringsprocedure is regarded as a useful instrument to safeguard a level playing field.

36435-K.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund by adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across materiel categories in a supplementary budget presented on Prinsjesdag. It takes effect on 19 September 2023 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

36470-L.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds) by shifting 10,000 thousand euros of commitments and expenditure to the Research, Development and Innovation article, with a retroactive effective date of 1 December 2023. The explanatory memorandum notes that there are no changes to the Knowledge Development article.
q: There are no changes to this article.
Er zijn geen mutaties op dit artikel.

36560-L.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2023 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds, formally closing the budget year by recording the realised spending against the amended appropriations. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after Staatsblad publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year, with an underspend of EUR 10.3 million noted.
q: The budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (L) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (L) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36625-J.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) through a second supplementary budget, changing commitments, expenditure and receipts across articles on flood safety, freshwater supply, water quality and experiments. The explanatory memorandum explains the budget shifts, mainly lower realisation on large projects, and contains no delegation or new executive powers.
36625-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by lower realisation on specific projects and reserves not drawn upon in 2024, not by any new powers.
q: The lower realisation of EUR -8.1 million relates mainly to the risk reserves Grensmaas and Ruimte voor de Rivier, which were not drawn upon in 2024.
De lagere realisatie van € -8,1 miljoen heeft met name betrekking op de risicoreserveringen Grensmaas en Ruimte voor de Rivier waarop in 2024 geen beroep is gedaan.

36725-I.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the King (begrotingsstaat van de Koning I) by means of a first supplementary budget, changing expenditure and commitments for the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House and for functional expenditure and cross-charged costs. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 June 2025.

36740-L.s: This bill adopts the final budget adjustment (slotwet) for the Nationaal Groeifonds for 2024, amending the budget statement to reflect realised expenditure and commitments. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36820-M.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Climate Fund (Ministry of Climate and Green Growth), adjusting appropriations across policy articles through a first supplementary budget, a memorandum of amendment, and a September supplementary budget, with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025. It sets budget amounts and effective date but delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power away from parliament or checks.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Climate Fund (M) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van het Klimaatfonds (M) voor het jaar 2025

36850-J.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and revenue figures across articles on water safety, freshwater supply, exploitation and maintenance, experiments, and contributions to other budgets. The explanatory memorandum explains the budget shifts as reflecting lower realisation, postponed projects and reallocations, and it contains no delegation or new executive powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) for the year 2025
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2025
